items.subject: Movement and Coordination
items.en: Overview: This section describes motor and coordination skills, and related movement activities that extend and refine notions of body image and the body’s capabilities. It also provides opportunities for enhancing time, space and language concepts, as well as social development (when activities are carried out with others). The basic goals ask the child to stop and start movement according to a signal; maintain balance; move through space, with or without obstacles, in a variety of ways; throw and kick objects; and move cooperatively with others. These goals are achieved through a variety of tasks or traditional childhood games. The child is also asked to use the body to interpret music and to perform pantomimes.
items.zh: 概述：本节介绍动作与协调技能，以及拓展和完善身体意象与身体能力概念的相关活动。本节也为增强时间、空间和语言概念以及社会性发展（当活动与他人共同进行时）提供机会。基本目标要求儿童：根据信号停止和开始动作；保持平衡；以多种方式在有或无障碍物的空间中移动；投掷和踢物体；与他人合作移动。这些目标通过各种任务或传统儿童游戏来实现。此外还要求儿童用身体表现音乐，并表演哑剧。

items.subject: Movement and Coordination
items.en: I-MC1.1 Stop and/or start movement in response to a signal.
items.zh: I-MC1.1 根据信号停止和/或开始动作。

items.subject: Movement and Coordination
items.en: I-MC2.1 Ascend and descend steps, alternating feet.
items.zh: I-MC2.1 上下台阶，双脚交替。

items.subject: Movement and Coordination
items.en: I-MC2.2 Maintain balance while changing body position without moving through space.
items.zh: I-MC2.2 在原地改变身体姿势时保持平衡（不移动位置）。

items.subject: Movement and Coordination
items.en: I-MC2.3a Maintain balance while walking forward on a wide bench or beam.
items.zh: I-MC2.3a 向前行走时保持平衡。

items.subject: Movement and Coordination
items.en: I-MC2.4 Situate oneself within a space of defined boundaries, modifying body configuration and size to fit the space.
items.zh: I-MC2.4 在边界明确的空间内活动，调整身体形态和大小以适应空间。

items.subject: Movement and Coordination
items.en: I-MC2.5a Move through space with or without obstacles—avoiding touching or bumping other individuals or obstacles—by crawling, walking, running, galloping, hopping (same foot and alternate foot) or jumping.
items.zh: I-MC2.5a 在空间中移动（有或没有障碍物），避免触碰或撞到他人或障碍物：可采用爬行、行走、奔跑、策步跳、单脚跳（同一只脚或双脚交替）或跳跃。

items.subject: Movement and Coordination
items.en: I-MC1.2 Relax specific body muscles and/or the whole body, moving from a high activity level to a quiet, focused state.
items.zh: I-MC1.2 放松身体特定肌肉和/或全身，从高活动水平转为安静、专注的状态。

items.subject: Movement and Coordination
items.en: I-MC3.1a Throw or kick an object in the direction indicated.
items.zh: I-MC3.1a 朝指定方向投掷或踢物体。

items.subject: Movement and Coordination
items.en: I-MC3.2a Play catch with a bean bag, with a partner seated or standing 1.5 feet apart.
items.zh: I-MC3.2a 与同伴相距1.5英尺坐着或站着，玩沙包抛接游戏。

items.subject: Movement and Coordination
items.en: I-MC3.5 Coordinate motor activity to carry out a goal with a partner or group.
items.zh: I-MC3.5 协调动作活动，与同伴或小组共同完成一个目标。

items.subject: Movement and Coordination
items.en: I-MC4.1a Play group games such as Farmer in the Dell, Follow the Leader, Hot Potato, London Bridge, Mother May I?, Ring Around the Rosie, Simon Says.
items.zh: I-MC4.1a 玩团体游戏，如《农夫在谷仓里》（Farmer in the Dell）。

items.subject: Movement and Coordination
items.en: I-MC5.1 Imitate the position or action of another person.
items.zh: I-MC5.1 模仿他人的姿势或动作。

items.subject: Movement and Coordination
items.en: I-MC5.2 Act out a simple pantomime.
items.zh: I-MC5.2 表演简单的哑剧。

items.subject: Movement and Coordination
items.en: II-MC3.1b Throw or kick an object with increasing accuracy at identified targets varying in height and distance.
items.zh: II-MC3.1b 向高度和距离不同的指定目标投掷或踢物体，准确度逐步提高。

items.subject: Movement and Coordination
items.en: Note: For a full discussion, please see the “Language of Instruction” section in the “Using the Preschool Sequence” chapter.
items.zh: 注：完整讨论请参见《使用学前课程》一章中的“教学语言”部分。

items.subject: Movement and Coordination
items.en:
Adult: I want to see how many different ways you can move down this (pointing) incline.
Adult: Good—you can roll sideways down the incline. What’s another way? Child crawls down incline
Adult: Right—you can crawl down the incline on your hands and knees, etc.
items.zh:
成人：我想看看你能想出多少种不同的办法，从这个斜坡上（指着斜坡）下来。
成人：很好——你可以侧身从斜坡上滚下来。还有什么别的办法？（儿童爬下斜坡）
成人：对——你可以用手和膝盖爬下斜坡，等等。

items.subject: Movement and Coordination
items.en: catch climb dance fast jump kick loud move quiet run slow soft start stop throw walk act out aim backward balance crawl forward gallop hop imitate incline interpret ladder moving obstacle obstacle course rules sideways signal slide somersault speed still suspend target tricycle pantomime play catch pump legs relax relay race roll
items.zh: 接、爬、跳舞、快、跳、踢、大声、移动、安静、跑、慢、轻、开始、停止、投掷、走、表演出来、瞄准、向后、平衡、爬行、向前、策步跳、单脚跳、模仿、斜坡、演绎、梯子、移动中的、障碍物、障碍赛道、规则、侧身、信号、滑行、翻滚、速度、静止、悬吊、目标、三轮车、哑剧、玩抛接、蹬腿、放松、接力赛、滚动

items.subject: Social and Emotional Development
items.topic: Social and Emotional Development: Autonomy and Social Skills
items.en: Overview: The basic goals associated with this section focus on the development of those emotional and social skills that enable the young child to function independently within the social setting of the class group. These include developing a sense of who he or she is and his or her capacities, beginning with a sense of physical body image. The child will also learn those interpersonal, social skills essential to interacting with others, such as the “give and take” of being part of a group and the need to sometimes delay or defer his or her own immediate desires, given the demands of the group. These goals mark the beginning development of an individual who is independent and competent, able to assume responsibility for his or her actions within the context of the group.
items.zh: 概述：本节的基本目标聚焦于发展使幼儿能够在班级群体的社会环境中独立发挥作用的情绪与社会技能。这些技能包括发展对自我及其能力的认识，从身体意象开始。儿童还将学习与他人互动所必需的人际与社会技能，例如作为群体一员的“给予与索取”，以及根据群体要求有时延迟或推迟自己当下的愿望。这些目标标志着一个独立、有能力、能够在群体情境中为自己的行为负责的个体的初步发展。

items.subject: Social and Emotional Development
items.en: I-AS1.1 Recognize and respond to own first and last name, orally and in writing.
items.zh: I-AS1.1 识别并回应自己的姓和名（口头及书写形式）。

items.subject: Social and Emotional Development
items.en: I-AS1.2 Orally provide first name and last name.
items.zh: I-AS1.2 口头说出自己的名和姓。

items.subject: Social and Emotional Development
items.topic: Social and Emotional Development: Autonomy and Social Skills
items.en: Internalize and conceptualize an image of one’s body
items.zh: 内化并形成对自己身体的意象。

items.subject: Social and Emotional Development
items.en: I-AS2.1 Name parts of the body: arm, ear, eye, face, finger, foot, hair, hand, head, leg, mouth, neck, nose, stomach, toe.
items.zh: I-AS2.1 说出身体部位的名称：手臂、耳朵、眼睛、脸、手指、脚、头发、手、头、腿、嘴、脖子、鼻子、肚子、脚趾。

items.subject: Social and Emotional Development
items.en: I-AS2.2a Draw a simple line drawing (stick figure) of a person, such as a stick figure that includes a head (with eyes, nose, mouth), body, arms and legs.
items.zh: I-AS2.2a 画一个简单的人物线条画（火柴人），例如包括头（有眼睛、鼻子、嘴）、身体、胳膊和腿的火柴人。

items.subject: Social and Emotional Development
items.en: I-AS3.1a Practice good hygiene (use bathroom independently, wash hands, etc.), use appropriate table manners (feed self using fork, spoon and knife; appropriate use of napkin), put on clothing, etc.
items.zh: I-AS3.1a 练习良好的个人卫生习惯（独立上厕所、洗手等），使用适当的餐桌礼仪（自己用叉子、勺子和刀吃饭；正确使用餐巾），自己穿衣服等。

items.subject: Social and Emotional Development
items.en: I-AS5.1a Recognize and call classmates and teacher by name.
items.zh: I-AS5.1a 认出同学和老师，并叫出他们的名字。

items.subject: Social and Emotional Development
items.en: I-AS5.2 Greet adults as “Mr. (name),” “Ms. (name)” or “Mrs. (name).”
items.zh: I-AS5.2 用“某先生”“某女士”或“某太太”称呼成年人。

items.subject: Social and Emotional Development
items.en: I-AS5.3 Acknowledge and return greetings and farewells.
items.zh: I-AS5.3 回应并回以问候和道别。

items.subject: Social and Emotional Development
items.en: I-AS5.4 Make requests and acknowledge attempts to meet requests politely.
items.zh: I-AS5.4 礼貌地提出请求，并对别人满足请求的做法作出回应。

items.subject: Social and Emotional Development
items.en: I-AS5.6 Attend and listen while others speak during a group activity.
items.zh: I-AS5.6 小组活动中别人讲话时专心倾听。

items.subject: Social and Emotional Development
items.en: I-AS5.8 Wait turn to speak in a group.
items.zh: I-AS5.8 在小组中轮流等待发言。

items.subject: Social and Emotional Development
items.en: I-AS6.3a Carry out chores and responsibilities that contribute to the well-being and functioning of the group.
items.zh: I-AS6.3a 完成有助于群体福祉和运转的杂务与责任。

items.subject: Social and Emotional Development
items.en: I-AS6.4 Sit among other children during a group activity, remaining in own physical space.
items.zh: I-AS6.4 小组活动时坐在其他儿童中间，并保持自己的身体空间。

items.subject: Social and Emotional Development
items.en: I-AS6.7 With advance notice, stop when told and change activities, moving cooperatively to another activity.
items.zh: I-AS6.7 事先得到提醒后，听到指令就停下并转换活动，合作地转到另一项活动。

items.subject: Social and Emotional Development
items.en: II-AS5.1b Recognize, call by name and indicate role of school personnel.
items.zh: II-AS5.1b 认出学校工作人员，叫出他们的名字并说明其职责。

items.subject: Social and Emotional Development
items.en: I-AS6.8a Follow rules for simple childhood games.
items.zh: I-AS6.8a 遵守简单儿童游戏的规则。

items.subject: Social and Emotional Development
items.en: II-AS6.8b Follow rules for simple childhood games (board games and group circle games).
items.zh: II-AS6.8b 遵守简单儿童游戏的规则（棋盘游戏和团体圆圈游戏）。

items.subject: Social and Emotional Development
items.topic: Social and Emotional Development: Autonomy and Social Skills
items.en: ankle arm back body cheek chest chin ear elbow eye eyebrow eyelash face feet finger forehead foot hair hand head heel hip knee leg lip mouth nail neck nose shoulder stomach teeth toe tongue tooth waist wrist
items.zh: 脚踝、手臂、背、脸颊、胸、下巴、耳朵、肘、眼睛、眉毛、睫毛、脸、脚、手指、额头、脚、头发、手、头、脚跟、髋、膝、腿、嘴唇、嘴、指甲、脖子、鼻子、肩膀、肚子、牙齿、脚趾、舌头、牙、腰、手腕

items.subject: Social and Emotional Development
items.topic: Social and Emotional Development: Autonomy and Social Skills
items.en:
Child: I made a picture.
Adult: Let’s see. What can you tell me about your picture?
Child: It’s me.
Adult: Ahh, you drew a picture of yourself. Can you tell me about the different parts of the drawing—the different parts of the body; what is this (points to head)?
Child: The head.
Adult: You drew a picture of a head. And where is your head? Point to your head. That’s right. Now tell me about the different parts of the head you drew. Where are the eyebrows? Are these the eyebrows?
items.zh:
儿童：我画了一幅画。
成人：让我看看。你能跟我说说你的画吗？
儿童：这是我。
成人：啊，你画了一幅你自己。你能跟我说说画里的不同部分吗——身体的不同部位；这是什么（指着头部）？
儿童：头。
成人：你画了一个头。那你的头在哪里？指一指你的头。对了。现在跟我说说你画的头的各个部分。眉毛在哪里？这些是眉毛吗？

items.subject: Social and Emotional Development
items.topic: Social and Emotional Development: Work Habits
items.en: Overview: The foundation for the manner in which children will later approach academic work in kindergarten and beyond is established, step by step, through the experiences and expectations that children encounter in play and activities at the preschool level. This section focuses on gently guiding children to develop a methodology for approaching different activities, to develop memory skills, follow directions, persist at a task, identify the materials and steps needed to carry out an activity, evaluate and correct their own work, and so on.
items.zh: 概述：儿童日后在幼儿园及以后如何对待学业任务，其基础是在学前阶段的游戏和活动中，通过所遇到的经验与期望一步步奠定的。本节着重温和地引导儿童形成开展不同活动的方法：发展记忆技能、听从指令、坚持完成任务、确定活动所需的材料和步骤、评价并修正自己的工作等。

items.subject: Social and Emotional Development
items.en: I-AS8.1a Carry out single-step oral directions.
items.zh: I-AS8.1a 执行单步骤的口头指令。

items.subject: Social and Emotional Development
items.en: I-AS8.2a Choose and use a toy or do an activity independently for a sustained period of time (at least ten minutes).
items.zh: I-AS8.2a 独立选择并使用玩具或从事某项活动，持续一段时间（至少十分钟）。

items.subject: Social and Emotional Development
items.en: I-AS8.3 Return toys and materials to their proper location after use.
items.zh: I-AS8.3 使用后将玩具和材料放回原处。

items.subject: Social and Emotional Development
items.en: I-AS8.4 Work in an orderly, persistent fashion in completing a task, even if difficulty is encountered.
items.zh: I-AS8.4 即使遇到困难，也能有条理、坚持不懈地完成任务。

items.subject: Social and Emotional Development
items.en: II-AS7.1 Memorize address, phone number and date of birth.
items.zh: II-AS7.1 记住地址、电话号码和出生日期。

items.subject: Social and Emotional Development
items.topic: Social and Emotional Development: Work Habits
items.en:
Child: Uh oh! The milk spilled. It’s a big mess.
Adult: Oops, there was an accident and the milk spilled. That’s okay—sometimes accidents happen. Sometimes we make mistakes—everyone does. But now there is a mess. Let’s see—what do we need to do with the mess? What do we need to do to fix or correct what happened?
Child: Clean it up.
Adult: That’s right. And when we make a mess or spill something, it’s our responsibility to clean it up—that means that it’s our job to clean it up. I’ll help you by getting the sponge for you and then you can be responsible for wiping up the milk (hands child the sponge). Do you know how to wipe up the milk or should I show you how to get started?
items.zh:
儿童：哎呀！牛奶洒了。弄得一团糟。
成人：哎呀，不小心把牛奶洒了。没关系——有时候会发生意外。有时候我们会犯错——每个人都会。但现在弄脏了。让我想想——我们需要怎么处理这团糟？我们要怎么做才能弥补或纠正发生的事？
儿童：把它清理干净。
成人：对了。当我们弄脏或洒了东西时，把它清理干净是我们的责任——也就是说，清理干净是我们的分内之事。我来帮你拿海绵，然后由你负责把牛奶擦干净（把海绵递给儿童）。你知道怎么擦牛奶吗，还是我示范给你看怎么开始？

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: Expressing a Point of View/Imagining—giving an opinion, pretending, and assuming the role or perspective of another, making up a story
items.zh: 表达观点／想象——给出意见、假装、扮演他人的角色或从他人的视角出发、编故事。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: Predicting—anticipating and saying what is likely to happen next
items.zh: 预测——预期并说出接下来可能发生的事。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: Vocabulary—acquiring increasingly precise and varied ways to express nuances of meaning
items.zh: 词汇——获得越来越精确、多样的方式表达意义的细微差别。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: Syntax—learning the grammar of language word order in a sentence; word endings to reflect singular and plural, past and present; and specific ways of connecting words and phrases that indicate different relationships, e.g., cause-effect, temporal, etc.
items.zh: 句法——学习句子中词序的语法；用词的结尾形式表示单复数、过去和现在；以及用特定方式连接词和短语，表示不同关系，如因果、时间等。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: Overview: The basic goals in this section focus on understanding and using spoken language through the development of basic conversational skills, as well as more complex discourse skills: clearly communicating one’s needs; understanding or giving a verbal description of a person, object or experience; sequencing the events of a particular experience in chronological order; giving directions or explaining how to do something; offering a personal opinion; using pretend language; and so on. Children benefit from many experiences and opportunities to listen and talk in a variety of circumstances, moving from using language in strictly contextualized situations, referring to objects or events present in the immediate environment, to use decontextualized language, moving beyond the here and now. Language can then be used symbolically—to talk about the past, answer “what if” questions, link cause and effect, as well as to conceptually sort and classify. Additional goals in this section address mastering the form of oral language, both vocabulary and syntax. While it is beyond the intended purpose of the Preschool Sequence to provide suggestions and activities on how to teach the listed competencies, it is particularly important in this section on oral language to emphasize the teaching of these skills within the context of learning opportunities, in the form of child-adult interactions and conversations, that present themselves continuously on a daily basis. The manner in which adults respond to children’s utterances and subsequent opportunities offered for additional conversation and talk clearly influence children’s language development.
items.zh: 概述：本节的基本目标聚焦于通过发展基本会话技能以及更复杂的话语技能来理解和运用口语：清楚表达自己的需求；理解或口头描述一个人、物体或经历；按时间顺序排列某次经历的事件；给出指令或解释如何做某事；提出个人观点；使用假想语言等。儿童得益于在各种情境中大量倾听和说话的经验与机会，从在严格依赖语境的情境中使用语言（指称眼前环境中的物体或事件），逐步过渡到使用脱离语境的语言，超越此时此地。语言于是可以被象征性地使用——谈论过去、回答“如果……会怎样”的问题、建立因果联系，以及从概念上分类和归类。本节的其他目标涉及掌握口语的形式，包括词汇和句法。虽然《学前课程》的目的并不在于为如何教授所列能力提供建议和活动，但在口语这一节，尤其要强调在日常不断出现的成人—儿童互动与会话等学习机会中教授这些技能。成人如何回应儿童的话语、以及随后提供多少继续交谈的机会，显然会影响儿童的语言发展。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: Frequent language interaction, with many opportunities to listen and talk
items.zh: 频繁的语言互动，有大量倾听和说话的机会。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: Adult models of high quality talk that keep in mind children’s need to first hear many “language examples” in order to build a receptive language base: use of a variety of vocabulary, including occasional “rare words” (multi-syllable words that might normally be considered “outside a preschooler’s vocabulary”); use of a variety of syntactical forms such as complex sentences that relate ideas; talk that is informative and illustrates reflection and problem solving; etc.
items.zh: 成人提供高质量谈话的示范，并牢记儿童需要先听到大量“语言范例”以建立接受性语言基础：使用多种词汇，包括偶尔的“稀有词”（多音节词，通常可能被视为超出学前儿童词汇范围）；使用多种句法形式，如联系想法的复杂句；提供信息性强、体现反思和解决问题的谈话；等等。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: Adult responses that reflect and incorporate what the child has said but also expand upon his or her comments
items.zh: 成人的回应既反映并接纳儿童所说的话，也对其评论加以扩展。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: Adult comments and behaviors that invite further conversation on the child’s part:
items.zh: 成人引发儿童进一步交谈的评论和行为：

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: Rephrasing of questions, in the absence of a response by the child, in a manner that gives hints about how to respond, moving from open-ended questions to those that offer a structured choice: “Where is the pirate going?” (no answer) “Is he going to look for the buried treasure or is he going to chase the other pirate boat?”
items.zh: 如果儿童没有回应，以能提供作答提示的方式重述问题，从开放式问题逐步转为提供结构化选择的问题：“海盗要去哪里？”（无回答）“他是要去找埋藏的宝藏，还是去追另一艘海盗船？”

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: Opportunities and invitations to use language in decontextualized settings—to talk about objects, events or experiences that are not part of the immediate environment: “What did you do at grandma’s house?” “How did you make the pinwheel?” “What are you going to do when you go on vacation?”
items.zh: 提供并邀请儿童在脱离语境的情境中使用语言——谈论不属于眼前环境的物体、事件或经历：“你在奶奶家做了什么？”“你是怎么做出风车的？”“你度假时打算做什么？”

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: Minimal use of directives (“Do this …,” “Don’t do this …,” etc.)
items.zh: 尽量少用指令句（“做这个……”“别做这个……”等）。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL1.1a Adapt the volume of one’s voice to different settings and different purposes.
items.zh: I-OL1.1a 根据不同的场合和目的调整说话音量。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL2.1a Carry on a dialogue or conversation with an adult, initiating comments or responding to partner’s comments.
items.zh: I-OL2.1a 与成人进行对话或交谈，主动发表评论或回应对方的评论。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL2.2a Answer the telephone appropriately.
items.zh: I-OL2.2a 恰当地接听电话。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL3.1 Express personal needs and desires verbally in a comprehensible manner.
items.zh: I-OL3.1 以清晰易懂的方式用口头语言表达个人需求和愿望。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL4.1 Given a picture, individual object or person within view, indicate the object, person or picture that has been designated.
items.zh: I-OL4.1 给出一幅图片、视野内的某个物体或人时，指出被指定的物体、人或图片。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL4.2 Given a picture, individual object or person within view, describe the attributes of the object, person or picture so that someone else may identify it.
items.zh: I-OL4.2 给出一幅图片、视野内的某个物体或人时，描述该物体、人或图片的特征，使别人能识别出来。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL4.3a Sequence and describe three images of events or phases of a single event that have been experi enced, occurring at temporally distinct times of the day.
items.zh: I-OL4.3a 将亲身经历过的、发生在一天中不同时间的三幅事件图片或单一事件的三个阶段按顺序排列并描述。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL4.4a Describe an event or task that one is in the process of completing.
items.zh: I-OL4.4a 描述一件正在进行的事件或任务。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL4.5a Describe an event or task that one has just experienced in the immediate past.
items.zh: I-OL4.5a 描述刚刚（不久前）经历过的一件事件或任务。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL5.1a Give simple, single-step directions.
items.zh: I-OL5.1a 给出简单的单步骤指令。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: II-OL1.1b Understand and use intonation and emphasis to ask a question or express surprise, agreement, displeasure or urgency.
items.zh: II-OL1.1b 理解并运用语调和重音来提问，或表达惊讶、同意、不满或急切。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL7.1 Answer “what will happen if...” questions.
items.zh: I-OL7.1 回答“如果……会发生什么”的问题。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL8.1a Pair pictures depicting opposites: big-little, cold- hot, dry-wet, full-empty, happy-sad, open-close.
items.zh: I-OL8.1a 将描绘相反概念的图片配对：大—小、冷—热、干—湿、满—空、快乐—悲伤、开—关。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL9.1a Point to/understand increasingly precise nouns related to the home, family and food.
items.zh: I-OL9.1a 指认/理解与家庭、家人和食物有关的越来越精确的名词。

items.en: I-OL9.2a Use increasingly precise nouns related to the home, family and food.
items.zh: I-OL9.2a 使用与家庭、家人和食物有关的越来越精确的名词。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL9.3a Point to body parts: arm, ear, eye, face, finger, foot, hair, hand, head, leg, mouth, neck, stomach, toe.
items.zh: I-OL9.3a 指出身体部位：手臂、耳朵、眼睛、脸、手指、脚、头发、手、头、腿、嘴、脖子、肚子、脚趾。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL9.4a Name body parts: arm, ear, eye, face, finger, foot, hair, hand, head, leg, mouth, neck, nose, stomach, toe.
items.zh: I-OL9.4a 说出身体部位的名称：手臂、耳朵、眼睛、脸、手指、脚、头发、手、头、腿、嘴、脖子、鼻子、肚子、脚趾。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: II-OL7.2 Identify outcomes and possible causes.
items.zh: II-OL7.2 识别结果和可能的原因。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL9.6a Use increasingly precise verbs related to the five senses.
items.zh: I-OL9.6a 使用与五种感官有关的越来越精确的动词。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL9.7 Point to colors: black, blue, brown, green, orange, purple, red, white, yellow.
items.zh: I-OL9.7 指认颜色：黑、蓝、棕、绿、橙、紫、红、白、黄。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL9.8 Name colors: black, blue, brown, green, orange, purple, red, white, yellow.
items.zh: I-OL9.8 说出颜色名称：黑、蓝、棕、绿、橙、紫、红、白、黄。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL9.9a Point to shapes: circle, square, triangle.
items.zh: I-OL9.9a 指认形状：圆形、正方形、三角形。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL9.10a Name shapes: circle, square, triangle.
items.zh: I-OL9.10a 说出形状名称：圆形、正方形、三角形。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL9.11a Point to: more-less (fewer), one–four.
items.zh: I-OL9.11a 指认：多—少（更少）、一—四。

items.en: I-OL9.12a Use quantity words: more-less (fewer), one–four.
items.zh: I-OL9.12a 使用数量词：多—少（更少）、一—四。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL9.13 Point to sensory attributes: sweet-salty, loud- quiet, hard-soft, rough-smooth, hot-cold, wet-dry.
items.zh: I-OL9.13 指认感官属性：甜—咸、响—轻、硬—软、粗糙—光滑、热—冷、湿—干。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL9.14 Use sensory attributes: sweet-salty, loud-quiet, hard-soft, rough-smooth, hot-cold, wet-dry.
items.zh: I-OL9.14 使用感官属性词：甜—咸、响—轻、硬—软、粗糙—光滑、热—冷、湿—干。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL9.16a Demonstrate understanding of temporal words: today, before-after, now, first-last, day-night, current day, week.
items.zh: I-OL9.16a 理解时间词：今天、以前—以后、现在、第一—最后、白天—夜晚、当天、星期。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL9.17a Use temporal words: today, before-after, now, first-last, day-night, current day, week.
items.zh: I-OL9.17a 使用时间词：今天、以前—以后、现在、第一—最后、白天—夜晚、当天、星期。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL9.18a Demonstrate understanding of spatial words: in-out, in front of-behind, at the top of-at the bottom of, under-over, in a line/row, up-down.
items.zh: I-OL9.18a 理解空间词：里—外、前面—后面、顶部—底部、下面—上面、排成一行/一列、上—下。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL9.19a Use spatial words: in-out, in front of-behind, at the top of-at the bottom of, under-over, in a line/row, up-down.
items.zh: I-OL9.19a 使用空间词：里—外、前面—后面、顶部—底部、下面—上面、排成一行/一列、上—下。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL9.20a Use present and past verb tense.
items.zh: I-OL9.20a 使用动词的现在时和过去时。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: II-OL9.5b Understand increasingly precise verbs related to eating, movement and the five senses.
items.zh: II-OL9.5b 理解与吃、动作和五种感官有关的越来越精确的动词。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL9.21 Understand and use increasingly detailed, elaborated declarative sentences.
items.zh: I-OL9.21 理解并使用越来越详细、扩展的陈述句。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL9.23 Ask or answer questions beginning with: who, what, where, when, why.
items.zh: I-OL9.23 提出或回答以“谁、什么、哪里、什么时候、为什么”开头的问题。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL9.24 Ask or answer increasingly detailed, elaborated questions (other than those beginning with who, what, where, when, why).
items.zh: I-OL9.24 提出或回答越来越详细、扩展的问题（不包括以“谁、什么、哪里、什么时候、为什么”开头的问题）。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL9.25 Understand and use increasingly detailed, elaborated imperatives
items.zh: I-OL9.25 理解并使用越来越详细、扩展的祈使句。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL9.26 Understand and use the negative forms of declarative sentences, questions and imperatives.
items.zh: I-OL9.26 理解并使用陈述句、疑问句和祈使句的否定形式。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL9.27a Combine simple sentences using “and.”
items.zh: I-OL9.27a 用“和”把简单句连接起来。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-OL9.28 Use personal pronouns correctly, especially “I” when referring to oneself.
items.zh: I-OL9.28 正确使用人称代词，尤其是自称时用“我”。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: II-OL9.22 Understand and use complex sentences with clauses introduced by: because, if, as soon as, so that, while, before, after, who, that, when, (verb)+ing.
items.zh: II-OL9.22 理解并使用由下列词引导从句的复杂句：因为、如果、一……就、以便、当……时、在……之前、在……之后、谁、那个、什么时候、（动词）+ing。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en:
Adult: Here are some pictures of different things. See—here’s a picture of an apple, an ice cream cone, a dress, a cookie, a pair of shoes, a jacket, a pair of pants and a hamburger. Some of these pictures “go together.” They belong to the same group of things; they belong to the same category. See—I can put the apple, the ice cream cone and the cookie all together in a group: they are all things that we can eat; they belong to the food category. Do you see another picture that belongs to the food category?
Child: (points to picture of the hamburger)
Adult: That’s right—we can eat an apple, an ice cream cone, a cookie or a ...? (points to picture of hamburger and pauses expectantly)
Child: Hamburger.
Adult: (nods) ...So they all belong to the food category. Here are some other pictures that belong to another group or category.
items.zh:
成人：这里有一些不同东西的图片。看——这是一张苹果的图片，一个冰淇淋蛋筒、一条裙子、一块饼干、一双鞋、一件夹克、一条裤子和一个汉堡包。有些图片是“归为一类”的。它们属于同一组东西；属于同一类别。看——我可以把苹果、冰淇淋蛋筒和饼干放在一起组成一组：它们都是我们可以吃的东西；属于食物类别。你看到另一张属于食物类别的图片了吗？
儿童：（指着汉堡包的图片）
成人：对了——我们可以吃苹果、冰淇淋蛋筒、饼干或者……？（指着汉堡包的图片，期待地停顿）
儿童：汉堡包。
成人：（点头）……所以它们都属于食物类别。这里还有一些属于另一组或另一类别的图片。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.topic: Nursery Rhymes, Poems, Fingerplays and Songs
items.en: Overview: The goals in this section introduce young children to nursery rhymes, poems, fingerplays and songs—listening to and keeping the beat, listening to and interpreting the simple words of a given selection with gestures and actions, as well as learning about rhyming words. In addition to the sheer enjoyment of listening to and repeating the rhythmic and musical combination of words, learning these selections provides skill and discipline in developing the ability to memorize and further extends children’s understanding and use of both the form and function of language. By listening to and reciting these poems and songs, children have an opportunity to model and practice various oral language skills, including pronunciation, vocabulary and syntax. They can then build upon their familiarity with certain well known rhymes by experimenting with rhyming words. This competency, in turn, focuses attention on the sounds of language, a skill that will enhance later efforts in initial reading. In addition to providing experiences with the form of language, these selections introduce children to hearing some more formal written language. The language of the “little stories” of these poems and songs differs from contextualized language of daily conversations. Their brevity makes them an ideal transition to the narrative language of storybooks.
items.zh: 概述：本节的目标向幼儿介绍童谣、诗歌、手指谣和歌曲——听并跟着打节拍，听并用动作和手势理解所选内容的简单词句，以及学习押韵词。除了欣赏并重复富有节奏和音乐性的词句组合所带来的纯粹乐趣外，学习这些内容还能培养记忆能力并训练自律，进一步拓展儿童对语言形式和语言功能的理解与运用。通过听和朗诵这些诗歌与歌曲，儿童有机会模仿并练习各种口语技能，包括发音、词汇和句法。他们还能在熟悉某些著名童谣的基础上，尝试押韵词的玩法。这种能力反过来又把注意力引向语言的声音，这项技能将有助于日后最初的阅读学习。这些选段除了提供语言形式方面的经验，还让儿童接触到一些较正式的书面语言。诗歌和歌曲中“小故事”的语言不同于日常会话中依赖语境的语言。它们篇幅短小，是通向故事书叙事语言的理想过渡。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.topic: Nursery Rhymes, Poems, Fingerplays and Songs
items.en: I-NR1.1a Memorize and recite with others a simple nursery rhyme, poem or song
items.zh: I-NR1.1a 与他人一起记忆并朗诵简单的童谣、诗歌或歌曲。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.topic: Nursery Rhymes, Poems, Fingerplays and Songs
items.en: I-NR2.1 With hands and/or feet, clap or tap the beat of a familiar rhyme, poem or finger play.
items.zh: I-NR2.1 用手和/或脚，为熟悉的童谣、诗歌或手指谣拍手或打节拍。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.topic: Nursery Rhymes, Poems, Fingerplays and Songs
items.en: I-NR2.2a Perform previously taught hand and body gestures associated with a familiar rhyme, poem or fingerplay.
items.zh: I-NR2.2a 表演学过的、与熟悉童谣/诗歌/手指谣相配的手部和身体动作。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.topic: Nursery Rhymes, Poems, Fingerplays and Songs
items.en: II-NR1.1b Memorize and recite independently a simple nursery rhyme, poem or song.
items.zh: II-NR1.1b 独立记忆并朗诵简单的童谣、诗歌或歌曲。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.topic: Nursery Rhymes, Poems, Fingerplays and Songs
items.en:
Adult: Listen to this nursery rhyme while I recite it—it has rhyming words: To market, to market, to buy a fat pig (emphasis on pig) Home again, home again, jiggety-jig. (emphasis on jig). Pig and jig are rhyming words. Try to say or echo the rhyming words with me: To market, to market, to buy a fat (pause—child and adult together): p…ig Home again, home again, jiggety (pause—child and adult together): j…ig. Did you hear the two rhyming words? pig and …
Child: jig.
Adult: That’s right—pig and jig are rhyming words. Now listen while I recite another verse—there are some other rhyming words: To market, to market, to buy a fat hog (emphasis on hog) Home again, home again, jiggety-jog. (emphasis on jog), etc.
items.zh:
成人：听我念这首童谣——里面有押韵的词：去集市呀去集市，买一只肥猪（重读 pig），回家转呀回家转，跳呀跳个不停（重读 jig）。pig 和 jig 是押韵词。试着跟我一起说、跟着念这些押韵词：去集市呀去集市，买一只肥（停顿——儿童和成人一起）p…ig；回家转呀回家转，跳呀跳个（停顿——儿童和成人一起）j…ig。你听到那两个押韵的词了吗？pig 和……
儿童：jig。
成人：对了——pig 和 jig 是押韵词。现在听我念另一段——里面还有别的押韵词：去集市呀去集市，买一只肥猪（重读 hog），回家转呀回家转，跳呀跳个不停（重读 jog），等等。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: Overview: The goals of this section focus on the language skills that children acquire when given the opportunity to hear the language of storybooks. In listening to and talking about stories that are read aloud, children build both listening and speaking skills. They are introduced to new vocabulary and formal written syntax, ways of linking and relating ideas. They also refine skills in: Narrating: understanding and describing illustrations, understanding and describing the setting, characters and events of stories and so on. Predicting: telling what will happen next in a story or suggesting a possible alternative ending. Imagining: telling their own stories, either based on illustrations or creating a story using their imagination. In addition, early experiences with books also lay the foundation for concepts and skills that children will later use as they begin to read and write. They learn about book format—the arrangement of covers, pages, individual printed words and letters—and they gain insight into the elements of a story—setting, characters, the pursuit of a goal or the resolution of a problem in a sequential series of events—an understanding that is instrumental for reading comprehension.
items.zh: 概述：本节的目标聚焦于儿童在有机会听故事书语言时获得的语言技能。通过听朗读的故事并谈论这些故事，儿童发展听和说的技能。他们接触新词汇和正式的书面句法，学习连接和关联想法的方式，并进一步打磨以下技能：叙述——理解并描述插图，理解并描述故事的背景、人物和事件等；预测——说出接下来可能发生的事，或提出可能的另一种结局；想象——根据自己的想象，或基于插图讲述自己的故事。此外，早期接触书籍也为儿童日后开始读写所需的技能和概念打下基础。他们学习书籍的形式——封面、书页、单个印刷词和字母的排列——并理解故事要素——背景、人物、目标的追求或问题的解决，以及按一系列事件展开的过程；这种理解有助于阅读理解。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-SR1.1a Attend and listen to illustrated picture books with simple story lines.
items.zh: I-SR1.1a 专心听有简单情节的插图图画书。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-SR1.2 Hold a book correctly, turning the pages in accordance with the story being read aloud, from beginning to end.
items.zh: I-SR1.2 正确拿书，随着朗读书上的故事从头到尾翻页。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-SR1.3 Find the illustration, or object within the illustration of a book, that is being described.
items.zh: I-SR1.3 找到书中正在被描述的插图，或插图中正在被描述的物体。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-SR1.4a Answer who, what and where questions about a read-aloud.
items.zh: I-SR1.4a 回答关于朗读内容的“谁、什么、在哪里”问题。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-SR2.1 Describe an illustration.
items.zh: I-SR2.1 描述一幅插图。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-SR2.2 Provide or join in repeating the refrain in books with repetitive phrases.
items.zh: I-SR2.2 在有重复短语的书中提供或跟着重复副歌。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: II-SR1.1b Attend and listen to picture books with story lines (30 minutes), as well as books of other genres, such as nonfiction (15 minutes).
items.zh: II-SR1.1b 专心听有情节的图画书（30分钟），以及其他体裁的书，如非虚构类图书（15分钟）。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-SR3.1a “Retell” a story that has been read aloud, including characters, a beginning and an ending.
items.zh: I-SR3.1a “复述”一个朗读过的故事，包括人物、开头和结尾。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-SR3.2a Sequence illustrations of three story events.
items.zh: I-SR3.2a 将三个故事事件的插图按顺序排列。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-SR3.3a “Read”/tell a story using a wordless picture book.
items.zh: I-SR3.3a 用无字图画书“读”故事/讲故事。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: I-SR4.1 Identify previously read books by the title and cover.
items.zh: I-SR4.1 通过书名和封面识别之前读过的书。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en: II-SR3.1b “Retell” a story that has been read aloud, including character(s), setting (time, place), the plot (central idea) of the story, the sequence of events and an ending.
items.zh: II-SR3.1b “复述”一个朗读过的故事，包括人物、背景（时间、地点）、故事的情节（中心思想）、事件顺序和结尾。

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.en:
Adult: Do you remember that yesterday we read the story, The Red Balloon? Today, we are going to look at the illustrations in The Red Balloon, the pictures. I want you to retell the story of The Red Balloon. We’ll look at each illustration in order and you’ll tell me what was happening in the story. Here’s the first illustration—tell me about the characters—who you see in the picture—and what was happening.
Child: This is Pascal and, etc.
items.zh:

items.subject: Language and Literacy
items.topic: Emerging Literacy Skills in Reading and Writing
items.en: Overview: This section builds on the language skills described in the preceding sections. The competencies described here go beyond oral language skills to early reading and writing skills. The goals ask children to add to their prior experiences with printed words in books by recognizing print in the daily environment and some ways it is used: to identify, to name or label (food, toys, streets, stores, etc.), to make lists, to report events, to give directions, to communicate messages, etc. The section focuses on the relation between oral language and print. The goals ask children to associate specific familiar spoken words, such as their own names or names of familiar objects, with specific written words. Children then go on to recognize that the distinct marks that make up each word are letters in our alphabet. Children learn that these letters have names through such means as singing the alphabet song. They learn to identify and name the specific letters in their own names. A crucial part of learning to read is developing phonemic awareness, the understanding that individual sounds are associated with individual letters and combinations of letters. To help children begin to develop phonemic awareness, the goals in this section ask children not only to refine their visual recognition of print but also to attend to the spoken sounds of language (for related topics, see the clapping and rhyming skills described in Nursery Rhymes, Poems, Fingerplays and Songs). Children are asked to take apart and put together smaller and smaller units of sound, from individual words in a sentence, to syllables in words, to the beginning sounds in individual words. The goals here also include the skills needed to produce print, that is, to write. At first, children are asked to perform manual activities that enhance both hand-eye coordination and small muscle control of the hand and fingers. They learn the proper way to hold a writing implement, as well as a variety of small designs and strokes that will eventually be combined to form letters. They are also asked to write their own names.
items.zh: 概述：本节以前面几节描述的语言技能为基础。这里所描述的能力超越了口语技能，进入早期读写技能。目标要求儿童在以往书中印刷文字经验的基础上，认识日常环境中的印刷文字及其一些用途：用于识别、命名或标注（食物、玩具、街道、商店等）、列清单、报告事件、给出指示、传递信息等。本节关注口语与印刷文字之间的关系。目标要求儿童把特定的熟悉口语词，如自己的名字或熟悉物体的名称，与特定的书面形式对应起来。接着儿童认识到构成每个词的不同记号是字母表中的字母。儿童通过唱字母歌等方式学习这些字母有名称。他们学会识别并说出自己名字中的具体字母。学习阅读的一个关键部分是发展音位意识，即理解单个声音与单个字母及字母组合相对应。为帮助儿童开始发展音位意识，本节目标不仅要求儿童完善对印刷文字的视觉识别，还要求他们注意语言的声音（相关主题见“童谣、诗歌、手指谣和歌曲”中描述的拍手和押韵技能）。要求儿童把声音单位不断拆分和组合，从句子中的单个词，到词中的音节，再到单词的起始音。这里的目标还包括产生印刷文字所需的技能，也就是书写。起初，要求儿童完成一些手工活动，这些活动能增强手眼协调以及手和手指小肌肉的控制。他们学习握笔的正确方式，以及各种最终会组合成字母的小图案和笔画。还要求儿童书写自己的名字。

items.en: Note: For clarity in working and communicating with young children, some descriptive terms should be consistently used in describing the individual writing strokes listed on page 32. The specific terms selected have no intrinsic value; the arbitrary names on page 32 are but one possibility. Undue effort should not be expended in teaching these terms to young children as part of their speaking vocabulary. However, when formal writing instruction in letter formation begins (for example, when the child learns to write his or her own name), the same names may be used by the teacher in describing these strokes as the various component elements of individual letters.
items.zh: 注：为了在与幼儿一起工作和交流时表述清晰，描述第32页所列的各个书写笔画时应始终使用某些描述性术语。所选的具体术语本身并无内在价值；第32页上那些任意的名称只是可能性之一。不应花费过多精力把这些术语作为幼儿口语词汇来教。不过，当正式的书写教学开始教字母字形时（例如孩子学写自己的名字），教师可以用同样的名称来描述这些笔画，作为构成各个字母的不同组成要素。

Adult: I’m going to draw some points. Here are two points. I want you to connect these points with a straight line. Can you start at this point and, with your finger, show me how you would connect these points using a straight line?

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Overview: Young children seem to be naturally drawn to touching, manipulating and examining the objects they find around them. The goals of this section build upon this curiosity and desire to explore. In the context of experiences with concrete objects and then with pictures, the child is asked to recognize similarities and differences, classify objects and shapes, recognize/create patterns in sequences of objects and make comparisons among objects, using simple measurement skills. He or she is also asked to quantify small groups of objects, to count and to demonstrate a basic understanding of addition and subtraction as “putting together” and “taking away.” In each instance, the child is asked to move from the concrete experience to representing knowledge symbolically using mathematical language, such as “more than,” “less than,” “longer,” “shorter,” number words (“three” and “four”), numerical symbols (“3” and “4”), and so on.
items.zh: 概述：幼儿似乎天生就会被周围可以触摸、操作和观察的物体所吸引。本节的目标建立在这种好奇心和探索欲望之上。在先接触具体物体、再接触图片的过程中，儿童被要求识别异同、对物体和形状分类、在物体序列中识别或创造规律，并使用简单的测量技能进行比较。他们还被要求量化小组物体、计数，并展示对“合起来”和“拿走”式加减法的基本理解。在每一种情况下，儿童都被要求从具体经验出发，过渡到用数学语言进行符号化表征，例如“多于”“少于”“更长”“更短”、数词（“三”“四”）、数字符号（“3”“4”）等。

items.en:
Adult: This group is different from this group. Can you tell me how they are different?
Child: This has red things and this has blue things.
Adult: Right—this group has red beads and this group has blue beads. You sorted the beads into two different groups according to their color. If I give you these other beads (pile of yellow and green beads), can you also sort them into two different groups according to their color?
items.zh:
成人：这一组和那一组不一样。你能告诉我它们怎么不一样吗？
儿童：这一堆是红色的东西，那一堆是蓝色的东西。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.topic: History and Geography: Orientation in Time
items.en: Overview: The focus of this section is on the development of an inner sense of time; this orientation in time is essential not just as a referent point for future instruction in history, but also as another step towards personal autonomy, which requires that children be able to organize time, monitor behavior and independently accomplish given activities throughout the day, week and so on. The child is asked first to organize and think about everyday experiences in regards to various indices of time: he or she is asked to classify experiences according to the time of day in which they occur, sequence events chronologically and begin to use standard measures of time, such as daily schedules and calendars. The child is also asked to consider the passage of time on a larger scale, developing a sense of the relationship of past-present-future, by sequencing events in his or her own life, considering the relationships within his or her own family, as well as sequencing stages within the life cycle. He or she is also asked to assume a historical perspective outside of his or her immediate experiences by examining familiar contemporary objects with similar objects from the past. Finally, the child is asked to represent these experiences symbolically, both with words and schematically in timelines and drawings.
items.zh: 概述：本节的焦点是内在时间感的发展；这种时间定向不仅是日后历史教学的参照点，也是通向个人自主的又一步，因为儿童需要能够安排时间、监控行为，并在一天、一周等时间中独立完成给定活动。首先要求儿童围绕各种时间线索组织和思考日常经验：按一天中的时段分类经历、按时间顺序排列事件，并开始使用日程表和日历等标准时间工具。还要求儿童从更大尺度思考时间的流逝，通过排列自己生活中的事件、思考家庭内部的关系以及生命历程中的阶段，发展过去—现在—未来的关系感。儿童还被要求通过把熟悉的当代物品与过去相似物品进行比较，从直接经验之外采取历史视角。最后，要求儿童用语言以及时间线和图画等图示方式象征性地表达这些经验。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: I-OT1.1a Understand and use temporal words to describe day-to-day occurrences: today-tomorrow, before after, now, first-last, day-morning-afternoon evening-night, current day, week, weekend, once upon a time, finally.
items.zh: I-OT1.1a 理解并使用时间词描述日常发生的事情：今天—明天、以前—以后、现在、第一—最后、白天—早晨—下午—傍晚—夜晚、当天、星期、周末、从前、最终。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: I-OT2.1 Classify and describe images of everyday activities according to the time of day with which they are associated: day-night, morning afternoon-evening.
items.zh: I-OT2.1 按一天中的时段对日常活动图片进行分类并描述：白天—夜晚、早晨—下午—傍晚。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: I-OT2.2a Sequence chronologically and describe three images of events or phases of a single event, occurring at temporally distinct times that have actually been experienced.
items.zh: I-OT2.2a 按时间顺序排列并描述三幅亲身经历过的、发生在不同时间的事件图片，或单一事件的三个阶段。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: I-OT2.3a Name the current day of the week.
items.zh: I-OT2.3a 说出今天是星期几。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: I-OT2.7 Identify the following by name: clock, schedule, calendar.
items.zh: I-OT2.7 说出以下名称：时钟、日程表、日历。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: II-OT1.1b Understand and use temporal words to describe day-to-day occurrences: today-tomorrow-yesterday, always-never-sometimes, before-after, now immediately, first-last, beginning-middle-end, then-next, already, soon, during-while, etc.
items.zh: II-OT1.1b 理解并使用时间词描述日常发生的事情：今天—明天—昨天、总是—从不—有时、之前—之后、现在—立刻、第一—最后、开始—中间—结束、然后—接下来、已经、很快、在……期间—当……时等。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: I-OT2.9a Use a schedule of daily activities represented in images to describe the order of events for the day.
items.zh: I-OT2.9a 使用以图片呈现的日常活动表来描述一天中事件的顺序。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: I-OT2.10 Use a weekly calendar to locate and name the current day of the week.
items.zh: I-OT2.10 使用周历找出并说出今天是星期几。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.topic: History and Geography: Orientation in Time
items.en:
Child: (showing photos brought from home) This is me when I was little.
Adult: Let’s look at them together. Can you tell me about each of these pictures that were taken when you were a baby?
Child: This is me in my crib. I’m drinking a bottle. This is me too.
Adult: What were you doing in that picture?
Child: Don’t know.
Adult: It looks like you were crawling on the floor.
Child: Yeah—crawling. And this is me—outside.
Adult: Ahh, you were going for a ride in the stroller. Who is this adult? Who is pushing the stroller?
Child: Mommy.
Adult: So when you were a baby, Mommy took you for a ride in the stroller? I’m glad you have these pictures of things that you did when you were a baby. They’re things that already happened—they’re things you did in the past. It’s fun to remember things you did in the past. Can you remember any other things you did in the past when you were a baby?
Child: No.
Adult: Here are some drawings of babies doing different things. Maybe, they’ll help you remember something you did in the past when you were a baby (pointing). How about this?
Child: Diapers.
Adult: When you were a baby, you wore diapers. That was something you did in the past. You don’t wear diapers now!
items.zh:
儿童：（展示从家里带来的照片）这是我小时候。
成人：我们一起看看吧。你能跟我说说这些你还是小宝宝时拍的照片吗？每一张都讲讲。
儿童：这是我在婴儿床里。我在喝奶瓶。这也是我。
成人：那张照片里你在做什么？
儿童：不知道。
成人：看起来你当时在地板上爬。
儿童：对——在爬。这是我在——外面。
成人：啊，你当时坐着婴儿车出去玩。这位大人是谁？谁在推婴儿车？
儿童：妈妈。
成人：所以你还是小宝宝的时候，妈妈推着婴儿车带你出去玩？我很高兴你有这些你小时候做过的事情的照片。这些都是已经发生过的事——是你过去做的事。回忆过去做过的事很有趣。你还记得小时候过去做过的其他事情吗？
儿童：不记得。
成人：这里有一些画着宝宝做各种事情的图。也许它们能帮你想起你小时候过去做过的某件事（指着）。这个怎么样？
儿童：尿布。
成人：你小时候穿尿布。那是你过去的事。现在你不穿尿布啦！

items.subject: History and Geography
items.topic: History and Geography: Orientation in Space
items.en: Overview: The focus in this section is on the development of a sense of orientation in space, which enables the child to situate himself or herself in space in relation to his or her physical movements, as well as provides a context and vocabulary for later instruction in geometry and geography. The child is asked to situate first his or her own body, and then objects, in three-dimensional space in relation to other objects, as well as to follow and give spatially referenced directions. He or she is asked to establish reference points in two-dimensional space, copying various grid-like designs and completing mazes. The child is asked to demonstrate an understanding of several basic geographic features, such as ocean, mountain, island and so on. Finally, he or she is asked to represent these experiences symbolically, both with words and schematically on maps and simple drawings.
items.zh: 概述：本节的焦点是空间定向感的发展，它使儿童能根据自己的身体动作把自己定位在空间中，也为日后几何和地理教学提供背景和词汇。要求儿童先把自己的身体、再把物体定位在三维空间中与其他物体的相对位置上，并能听从和给出带空间参照的指令。要求儿童在二维空间中建立参照点，临摹各种网格状图案并走迷宫。要求儿童理解若干基本地理特征，如海洋、山脉、岛屿等。最后，要求儿童用语言以及用地图和简单图画以图示方式把这些经验象征性地表达出来。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: I-OS1.1a Situate oneself in space or situate objects in relation to one another according to the indications given by spatial terms: there-here, in on, in front of-behind, at the top of-at the bottom of, under, next to-in the middle of, near-far, around, etc.
items.zh: I-OS1.1a 根据空间词给出的提示把自己定位在空间中，或把物体彼此相对定位：那里—这里、里—上、前面—后面、顶部—底部、下面、旁边—中间、近—远、周围等。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: I-OS2.1a Reproduce a design, using parquetry blocks, mosaic toys or pegs, by placing the objects directly on top of a design card.
items.zh: I-OS2.1a 用拼花积木、马赛克玩具或小木钉，把物体直接放在图案卡上来复制一个图案。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: II-OS1.1b Situate oneself in space or situate objects in relation to one another according to the indi cations given by spatial terms: here-there, in-on, in front of-behind, at the top of-at the bottom of, under-over, above-below, next to-in the middle of, etc.
items.zh: II-OS1.1b 根据空间词给出的提示把自己定位在空间中，或把物体彼此相对定位：这里—那里、里—上、前面—后面、顶部—底部、下面—上面、上方—下方、旁边—中间等。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: I-OS3.1a On a simple map of a single room showing furniture arrangement, indicate one’s own position with an “X.”
items.zh: I-OS3.1a 在一张显示家具摆放的单个房间的简易地图上，用“X”标出自己的位置。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: I-OS4.1a Identify these geographic features and environments by name in real life, photos or drawings: land, water, river, lake, ocean, farm, city.
items.zh: I-OS4.1a 在现实生活、照片或图画中说出这些地理特征和环境的名称：陆地、水、河流、湖泊、海洋、农场、城市。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.topic: History and Geography: Orientation in Space
items.en:
Child: Look what I made.
Adult: What did you make?
Child: I colored.
Adult: Yes, you made a very pretty design on the graph paper. In your design, did you use the same color or a different color for each little box?
Child: Different colors.
Adult: Your design is very colorful because you used a lot of different colors—each box is different. Danny made a design on graph paper today, too. Maybe tomorrow you can exchange designs—you can see if you can copy Danny’s design and he can try to copy your design.
items.zh:
儿童：看我做的。
成人：你做了什么？
儿童：我涂了颜色。
成人：是啊，你在方格纸上做了一个非常漂亮的图案。在你的图案里，每个小格子用的是相同的颜色还是不同的颜色？
儿童：不同的颜色。
成人：你的图案五颜六色，因为你用了很多不同的颜色——每个格子都不一样。丹尼今天也在方格纸上做了一个图案。也许明天你们可以交换图案——看看你能不能照着画丹尼的图案，他也试着照着画你的图案。

items.subject: Science
items.topic: Scientific Reasoning and the Physical World
items.en: Overview: This section introduces children to a systematic way of looking at, describing and explaining the world around them. Children should be given many opportunities for systematic observation and hands-on investigation of both the living and material world. Building on these experiences, children can progress from describing and explaining what is observed to making predictions based on these observations.
items.zh: 概述：本节向儿童介绍一种系统观察、描述和解释周围世界的方法。应给予儿童大量机会，对生命世界和物质世界进行系统观察与动手探究。在这些经验的基础上，儿童可以从描述和解释所观察到的内容，进一步根据这些观察作出预测。

items.subject: Science
items.topic: Scientific Reasoning and the Physical World
items.en: I-SC1.1 Identify and describe objects on the basis of specific properties discerned through the five senses.
items.zh: I-SC1.1 根据通过五种感官辨识出的具体属性来识别和描述物体。

items.subject: Science
items.topic: Scientific Reasoning and the Physical World
items.en: Human bodies are made of many different parts
items.zh: 人体由许多不同的部分组成。

items.subject: Science
items.topic: Scientific Reasoning and the Physical World
items.en: I-SC1.2 Name body parts: arm, ear, eye, face, finger, foot, hair, hand, head, leg, mouth, neck, nose, stomach, toe (Same objective as 3LD-LA-D1B and 3SD-AS-A3).
items.zh: I-SC1.2 说出身体部位的名称：手臂、耳朵、眼睛、脸、手指、脚、头发、手、头、腿、嘴、脖子、鼻子、肚子、脚趾（与 3LD-LA-D1B 和 3SD-AS-A3 目标相同）。

items.subject: Science
items.topic: Scientific Reasoning and the Physical World
items.en: Humans need to do certain things to grow and stay healthy
items.zh: 人类需要做一些事情才能成长并保持健康。

items.subject: Science
items.topic: Scientific Reasoning and the Physical World
items.en: I-SC3.2a Select and use scissors to cut straight lines.
items.zh: I-SC3.2a 选择并使用剪刀沿直线剪。

items.subject: Science
items.topic: Scientific Reasoning and the Physical World
items.en:
Child: Oh, look—there are green things coming out of the dirt!
Adult: Ahh, you’re right! I see a little green stem. Look carefully—what do these two little things on the top of the stem look like?
Child: Other parts.
Adult: Yes, each one is a little leaf. Can you gently point to the leaf on each side of the stem?
Child: Here and here?
Adult: That’s right, those are the leaves. Now, where do you suppose the stem came from? How did it get here in the soil?
Child: (silence)
items.zh:
儿童：哦，看——有绿色的东西从土里冒出来了！
成人：啊，你说得对！我看到一根绿色的小茎。仔细看——茎顶上这两个小东西像什么？
儿童：是别的部分。
成人：是的，每一个都是一片小叶子。你能轻轻指着茎两边的叶子吗？
儿童：这里和这里？
成人：对了，那些就是叶子。那么，你觉得这根茎是从哪里来的？它是怎么长到土里来的？
儿童：（沉默）

items.subject: Science
items.topic: Scientific Reasoning and the Physical World
items.en: air alive light living not living sun water wind birth development flow growth life cycle sense temperature weather
items.zh: 空气、活着、光、有生命、无生命、太阳、水、风、出生、发育、流动、生长、生命周期、感觉、温度、天气

items.subject: Science
items.topic: Scientific Reasoning and the Physical World
items.en: development growth life cycle shoot soil sprout temperature weather ice light source liquid shadow solid state steam
items.zh: 发育、生长、生命周期、嫩枝、土壤、发芽、温度、天气、冰、光源、液体、影子、固体、状态、蒸汽

items.subject: Science
items.topic: Scientific Reasoning and the Physical World
items.en: describe explain observation observe record report predict science
items.zh: 描述、解释、观察（名词）、观察（动词）、记录、报告、预测、科学

items.subject: Science
items.topic: Scientific Reasoning and the Physical World
items.en:
Child: A seed.
Adult: That’s right. Look at the drawings you’ve made so far to record your observations. See, in the first picture, you drew a picture of the seed in the soil. Tell me about this next picture. What did you draw?
Child: It’s the seed in the dirt. I’m giving it some water.
Adult: (pointing) What else is the seed getting in your picture?
Child: The sun.
Adult: Right. The sun and water made this green stem grow from the seed. Do you think it would be a good idea to draw another picture of your observations today?
items.zh:
儿童：一颗种子。
成人：对。看看你到目前为止为了记录观察而画的画。看，第一幅画里，你画的是土里的种子。跟我说说下一幅画。你画了什么？
儿童：是土里的种子。我在给它浇水。
成人：（指着）在你的画里，种子还得到了什么？
儿童：阳光。
成人：对。阳光和水让这根绿色的茎从种子里长了出来。你觉得今天再画一幅你观察的画是个好主意吗？

items.subject: Music
items.en: Overview: This section includes goals that focus both on listening to, enjoying, and appreciating music in all its various forms, as well as producing music. Experiences in listening to and singing songs and fingerplays also provide opportunities to practice oral language skills. Music affords the opportunity to expand and clarify various concepts, such as loud and soft, fast and slow, etc. In addition, efforts that focus attention on discriminating differences in discrete environmental or musical sounds facilitate subsequent attention to phonemic awareness, awareness of the discrete sounds of language. Group musical experiences, performing or singing together, also offer the opportunity to practice social skills. The basic goals of this section ask the child to listen to and identify sounds, indicate whether certain sound pairs are the same or different, imitate sounds and rhythm sequences, sing songs individually and with others, and move interpretatively to music.
items.zh: 概述：本节的目标既包括聆听、欣赏各种形式的音乐，也包括创作音乐。听歌、唱歌和做手指谣也为练习口语技能提供机会。音乐有助于扩展和澄清各种概念，如大声与小声、快与慢等。此外，把注意力集中在辨别不同的环境声音或音乐声音上，有助于日后发展音位意识，即意识到语言由离散的声音组成。集体音乐活动、共同表演或演唱，也提供练习社交技能的机会。本节的基本目标要求儿童聆听并识别声音，判断成对声音是否相同，模仿声音和节奏序列，单独和与他人一起唱歌，并随音乐进行表现性动作。

items.subject: Music
items.en: I-MU1.1 Identify the direction from which a sound originates.
items.zh: I-MU1.1 识别声音传来的方向。

items.subject: Music
items.en: I-MU1.2 Listen to and identify environmental sounds.
items.zh: I-MU1.2 聆听并识别环境中的声音。

items.subject: Music
items.en: I-MU1.3a Listen to pairs of sounds that are either identical or grossly different and indicate whether they are the same or different.
items.zh: I-MU1.3a 听成对的声音，判断它们是完全相同还是明显不同，并指出相同还是不同。

items.subject: Music
items.en: I-MU1.4 Indicate the number of sounds heard (up to four sounds).
items.zh: I-MU1.4 指出听到声音的数量（最多四个）。

items.subject: Music
items.en: I-MU2.1 Vocally or with musical instruments, produce sounds that are loud or soft and long or short according to verbal direction.
items.zh: I-MU2.1 用声音或乐器，根据口头指令发出响或轻、长或短的声音。

items.subject: Music
items.en: I-MU2.2 Vocally imitate isolated sounds produced by others, approximating intensity, duration and pitch.
items.zh: I-MU2.2 用声音模仿他人发出的孤立声音，近似地表现其强度、时长和音高。

items.subject: Music
items.en: II-MU1.3b Listen to pairs of sounds that are either identical or slightly different and indicate whether they are the same or different.
items.zh: II-MU1.3b 听成对的声音，判断它们是完全相同还是略有不同，并指出相同还是不同。

items.subject: Music
items.en: I-MU2.3a Imitate clapping pattern sequences of no more than three claps per pattern.
items.zh: I-MU2.3a 模仿拍手节奏序列，每个模式不超过三下拍手。

items.subject: Music
items.en: I-MU2.4a Use musical instruments or other objects to imitate a sequence of no more than a musical motif of three sounds made by a single instrument or object.
items.zh: I-MU2.4a 用乐器或其他物体模仿一段序列，不超过由单一乐器或物体发出的三声音乐动机。

items.subject: Music
items.en: I-MU2.5 Accompany a story or musical piece by introducing sound effects at the appropriate moment.
items.zh: I-MU2.5 在适当的时刻加入音效，为故事或乐曲伴奏。

items.subject: Music
items.en: I-MU3.1a Listen to, sing and perform children’s songs and fingerplays with others.
items.zh: I-MU3.1a 与他人一起聆听、演唱和表演儿童歌曲与手指谣。

items.subject: Music
items.en: I-MU3.2a Sing a musical dialogue in which two or more groups answer one another.
items.zh: I-MU3.2a 演唱音乐对话，由两组或两组以上互相应答。

items.subject: Music
items.en: I-MU4.1 Move to music individually, interpreting and modifying movements according to the tempo, intensity and rhythm.
items.zh: I-MU4.1 独自随音乐移动，根据速度、力度和节奏演绎并调整动作。

items.subject: Music
items.en: I-MU4.2 Move to music with a partner or group, performing very simple movements.
items.zh: I-MU4.2 与同伴或小组随音乐移动，做非常简单的动作。

items.subject: Music
items.en: II-MU2.3b Imitate clapping pattern sequences of at least four claps per pattern that vary in tempo, number, length of pause between claps, etc.
items.zh: II-MU2.3b 模仿拍手节奏序列，每个模式至少四下拍手，且在速度、次数、拍手间隔长短等方面有变化。

items.subject: Music
items.en:
Adult: Listen—I’m going to clap my hands—I’m going to make a clapping pattern. Listen carefully. When I finish, I’m going to ask you to try to copy it. (clap pattern)
Adult: Okay, I’m going to repeat the clapping pattern, but this time, you try to do it with me. (adult and child clap together)
Adult: Now I’m going to make a new clapping pattern. Listen carefully. When I finish, I will ask you to repeat it by yourself.
items.zh:
成人：听——我要拍手——我要拍出一个拍手节奏。仔细听。我拍完后，会请你试着跟着拍出来。（拍手节奏）
成人：好，我再把拍手节奏拍一遍，不过这次，你试着和我一起拍。（成人和儿童一起拍手）
成人：现在我要拍一个新的拍手节奏。仔细听。我拍完后，会请你自己重复一遍。

items.subject: Visual Arts
items.en: Overview: This section focuses not only on producing art, but also on examining and appreciating examples of various art forms. The use of various media and techniques provides rich opportunities for sensory exploration and manipulation, as well as the development of fine motor skills. In addition, through painting and drawing, children make their first attempts at graphic representation, a precursor to writing. The guided examination of works of art provides practice in focusing attention on visual detail, important for developing skill in discriminating visual differences in objects, images, print and letters, as well as appreciating basic elements of art. The further examination and discussion of works of art also afford rich opportunities for language development. The basic goals of this section ask children to attend to visual details, identify images that are the same or different, create both representational and nonrepresentational art using various media and techniques, create art in the style of a known artist and examine and talk about selected works of art, including their own creations.
items.zh: 概述：本节不仅关注创作艺术作品，也关注观察和欣赏各种艺术形式的作品。使用各种媒介和技术为感官探索、动手操作以及精细动作技能的发展提供丰富机会。此外，通过绘画，儿童首次尝试图形表征，这是书写的先兆。引导儿童观察艺术作品，有助于练习把注意力集中在视觉细节上；这对区分物体、图像、印刷文字和字母的视觉差异，以及欣赏艺术的基本要素都很重要。进一步观察和讨论艺术作品也为语言发展提供丰富机会。本节的基本目标要求儿童注意视觉细节，识别相同或不同的图像，使用各种媒介和技术创作具象和非具象艺术作品，以已知艺术家的风格创作，并观察、谈论包括自己作品在内的选定艺术作品。

items.subject: Visual Arts
items.en: I-VA1.1 Identify pairs of objects or images as the same or different.
items.zh: I-VA1.1 识别成对的物体或图像是相同还是不同。

items.subject: Visual Arts
items.en: I-VA1.2a Play games requiring matching of like images, such as lotto games.
items.zh: I-VA1.2a 玩需要配对相同图像的游戏，如宾果游戏。

items.subject: Visual Arts
items.en: I-VA1.3a Identify the colors red, yellow, blue, green, orange, purple, brown, black, white.
items.zh: I-VA1.3a 识别红、黄、蓝、绿、橙、紫、棕、黑、白等颜色。

items.subject: Visual Arts
items.en: I-VA1.4a Demonstrate memory of visual details by identifying what is different after a collection of objects is examined, removed from sight, altered and reintroduced.
items.zh: I-VA1.4a 观察一组物体，将其移开视线、改动后再呈现，识别不同之处，以展示对视觉细节的记忆。

items.subject: Visual Arts
items.en:
Adult: This is a picture of a sculpture that was created by the artist Edgar Degas. Can you tell me about this sculpture? What do you see?
Child: It’s a person.
Adult: Uh huh, it’s a sculpture of a person. What kind of person? Is it a man or woman? Or is it a girl or boy?
Child: It looks like a girl ‘cause she has a pony tail.
Adult: So it’s a sculpture of a girl. How is she dressed? Is she wearing regular clothes?
Child: No—she looks like she’s wearing a funny short skirt
Adult: Yes, she is. She’s wearing a special costume that’s used for dancing, etc.
items.zh:
成人：这是一张艺术家埃德加·德加创作的雕塑的图片。你能跟我说说这座雕塑吗？你看到了什么？
儿童：是一个人。
成人：嗯，是一座人物的雕塑。是什么样的人？是男人还是女人？还是女孩或男孩？
儿童：看起来像个女孩，因为她扎着马尾辫。
成人：所以是一座女孩的雕塑。她穿着什么？穿的是普通衣服吗？
儿童：不是——她看起来穿着一条滑稽的短裙。
成人：是的。她穿着一种专门用来跳舞的特殊服装，等等。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: NOTE: The objectives listed in sections I–IV of Language Arts below are consistent with the Core Knowledge Language Arts program and embed all of the skills and concepts within the Common Core State Standards for English Language Arts.
items.zh: 注：以下语言艺术第 I—IV 节所列的目标与“核心知识语言艺术”课程一致，并涵盖了《共同核心州立标准》英语语言艺术中的全部技能和概念。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Shortly after a baby is born, an amazingly complex, interactive communication process begins between the infant and others in his/her environment. While it may seem like an obvious statement, it is nonetheless worth making the point that listening and speaking are the primary means of communication throughout the early years of a young child’s development. It should be equally obvious that reading and writing competencies are predicated on competencies in listening and speaking. When a child enters kindergarten, however, traditional language arts instruction has typically accorded little, if any, attention to the ongoing development of children’s listening and speaking ability. We have acted as if listening and speaking competencies are fully and firmly established and can be left behind as reading and writing instruction begins. Nothing could be further from the truth. This omission in language arts instruction has been a serious oversight. We must remedy this oversight, deliberately elaborating and extending listening and speaking skills, while we simultaneously begin to introduce reading, and then writing. Children who are fortunate enough to participate in language arts instruction that recognizes the importance of continuing to build listening and speaking competency while also beginning reading and writing instruction will, in the end, be far more literate adults.
items.zh: 婴儿出生后不久，婴儿与其周围环境中的人之间就开始了极其复杂、互动的交流过程。虽然这似乎不言自明，但仍值得指出：在幼儿发展的早期岁月里，听和说是主要的交流方式。同样显而易见的是，读写能力建立在听说能力之上。然而，当孩子进入幼儿园时，传统的语言艺术教学通常很少甚至根本不关注儿童听说能力的持续发展。我们一直仿佛认为听说能力已经完全牢固地确立，可以在开始读写教学时抛在一边。事实再清楚不过并非如此。语言艺术教学中的这一遗漏是严重的疏忽。我们必须补救这一疏忽，有意地拓展和延伸听说技能，同时开始引入阅读，继而是写作。那些有幸参与语言艺术教学、既认识到在启动读写教学的同时继续培养听说能力的重要性、又开始读写教学的孩子，最终将成为文化素养高得多的成年人。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Recite a nursery rhyme, poem or song independently. C. Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—All Texts Teachers: Written text makes use of richer vocabulary and more complex syntax than conversational language. It is important that young children be exposed not only to the language of everyday conversation but also to the richer and more formal language of books. This can be done through frequent reading aloud. Helping young children develop the ability to listen to and understand written texts when they are read aloud must be an integral part of any initiative designed to build literacy. At the kindergarten level, a students’ ability to understand what they hear far outpaces their ability to independently read and understand written text. By listening to stories or nonfiction selections read aloud, students can experience the complexities of written language without expending cognitive energy on decoding; they can likewise access deeper and more complex content knowledge than they are presently able to read independently. Careful consideration should be given to the selection of books read aloud to ensure that the vocabulary and syntax presented is rich and complex. Leveled texts will not provide the rich language experience desired during read-alouds and should only be used as a starting point with students for whom English is a second language. Grade appropriate read-aloud selections for poetry and fiction are included in the Sequence. Nonfiction read-alouds should be selected on the basis of the history, science, music and visual art topics identified for kindergartners in the Core Knowledge Sequence, with emphasis on history and science read-alouds. It is strongly recommended that daily read-alouds focus on a single topic over a sustained period of time—about two weeks—rather than intermingling read-alouds on a variety of subjects. Careful consideration should be given to the order in which nonfiction read-alouds are presented to ensure that knowledge about a topic builds in a progressive and coherent way. Following any read-aloud, students should participate in rich, structured conversations with an adult in response to the written text that has been read aloud. In this way, they can begin to orally practice comparing, analyzing, and synthesizing ideas in written text in much the same way as they will be expected to do as independent readers in the later grades.
items.zh: 独立朗诵一首童谣、诗歌或歌曲。C. 朗读的理解与讨论——所有文本 教师：书面文本使用的词汇比会话语言更丰富，句法更复杂。重要的是，幼儿不仅要接触日常会话语言，还要接触书籍中更丰富、更正式的语言。这可以通过经常朗读来实现。帮助幼儿发展在书面文本被朗读时倾听并理解的能力，必须是任何旨在培养读写能力的举措的组成部分。在幼儿园阶段，学生理解所听到内容的能力远远超过他们独立阅读和理解书面文本的能力。通过听朗读的故事或非虚构作品，学生可以体验书面语言的复杂性，而不必把认知精力花在解码上；他们同样可以获取比自己目前独立阅读所能达到的更深、更复杂的内容知识。应仔细考虑朗读书籍的选择，确保所呈现的词汇和句法丰富而复杂。分级读物无法提供朗读所期望的丰富语言体验，只应作为英语为第二语言的学生的起点。与本序列中适合幼儿园的诗歌和虚构作品朗读选段已列入其中。非虚构类的朗读应根据《核心知识序列》中为幼儿园确定的历史、科学、音乐和视觉艺术主题来选，重点放在历史和科学的朗读上。强烈建议每日朗读在一段较长时间（约两周）内聚焦单一主题，而不是把各种主题的朗读混在一起。应仔细考虑非虚构类朗读的顺序……

items.subject: English Language Arts

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use narrative language to describe people, places, things, locations, events, actions, a scene or facts in a read-aloud.
items.zh: 使用叙事性语言描述朗读中的人物、地点、事物、位置、事件、动作、场景或事实。
