items.subject: Music
items.en: Play simple rhythms and melodies.
items.zh: 演奏简单的节奏和旋律。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Recognize like and unlike phrases.
items.zh: 辨认相同或不同的乐句。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Recognize that music has timbre or tone color.
items.zh: 认识到音乐具有音色（音质）。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Sing unaccompanied, accompanied, and in unison.
items.zh: 能无伴奏演唱、有伴奏演唱，以及齐唱。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Recognize (aurally) the following frequently used Italian terms:
items.zh: 通过听觉辨认以下常用意大利语术语：

items.subject: Music
items.en: adagio (slow)
items.zh: 柔板（adagio，慢）

items.subject: Music
items.en: moderato (medium) allegro (fast)
items.zh: 中板（moderato，中速）；快板（allegro，快）

items.subject: Music
items.en: Understand that music is written down in a special way and become familiar with the following notation: Teachers: Consider introducing the count system for each note (i.e., “ta” for quarter notes and “ti ti” for eighth notes).
items.zh: 理解音乐是以特殊方式记录下来的，并熟悉以下记谱法：教师须知：可考虑引入每种音符的读法（例如四分音符读“ta”，八分音符读“ti ti”）。

items.subject: Music
items.en: 𝅘𝅥 quarter note, 𝅘𝅥𝅮 eighth note
items.zh: 𝅘𝅥 四分音符，𝅘𝅥𝅮 八分音符

items.subject: Music
items.en: Expose students to a wide range of music, including children’s music, popular instrumental music, and music from various cultures.
items.zh: 让学生接触广泛的音乐，包括儿童音乐、通俗器乐以及各国文化音乐。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Composers
items.zh: 作曲家

items.subject: Music
items.en: Know that a composer is someone who writes music.
items.zh: 知道作曲家是创作音乐的人。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Become familiar with Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart as a composer who wrote what is known as classical music, and listen to the Allegro (first movement) from A Little Night Music (Eine kleine Nachtmusik). Also known as Che Che Koolay Note to Teachers: The expectation is that students understand what these words mean when spoken. It is not expected that they recognize the written words.
items.zh: 熟悉作曲家沃尔夫冈·阿马德乌斯·莫扎特，他创作了所谓的古典音乐；聆听《弦乐小夜曲》（Eine kleine Nachtmusik）中的《快板》（第一乐章）。该曲也称作 Che Che Koolay。教师注意：要求学生理解这些词在口语中的含义，不要求认出书面文字。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Orchestra
items.zh: 管弦乐队

items.subject: Music
items.en: Become familiar with the families of instruments in the orchestra: strings, brass, woodwinds, percussion.
items.zh: 熟悉管弦乐队中的乐器组别：弦乐器、铜管乐器、木管乐器、打击乐器。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Know that the leader of the orchestra is called the conductor. Listen to Sergei Prokofiev, Peter and the Wolf.
items.zh: 知道管弦乐队的指挥者称为指挥。聆听谢尔盖·普罗科菲耶夫的《彼得与狼》。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Opera
items.zh: 歌剧

items.subject: Music
items.en: Understand that opera combines music, singing, and acting.
items.zh: 理解歌剧融合了音乐、歌唱和表演。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Listen to selections from Humperdinck’s Hansel and Gretel: “Brother, Come Dance with Me,” “I Am the Little Sandman,” “Children’s Prayer.”
items.zh: 聆听洪佩尔丁克歌剧《汉塞尔与格莱特》选段：“哥哥，来和我跳舞”“我是小沙人”“孩子们的祈祷”。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Instrumental Music
items.zh: 器乐

items.subject: Music
items.en: Listen to Paul Dukas, The Sorcerer’s Apprentice.
items.zh: 聆听保罗·杜卡的《魔法师的学徒》。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Ballet
items.zh: 芭蕾舞

items.subject: Music
items.en: Understand that ballet combines music and movement, often to tell a story.
items.zh: 理解芭蕾舞融合了音乐与动作，常用来讲述故事。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Listen to Tchaikovsky’s Nutcracker Suite.
items.zh: 聆听柴可夫斯基的《胡桃夹子组曲》。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Teachers: Familiarize students with other types of dance, such as square dancing and tap dancing.
items.zh: 教师须知：让学生了解其他舞蹈类型，例如方块舞和踢踏舞。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Jazz
items.zh: 爵士乐

items.subject: Music
items.en: Understand that jazz is a kind of music that developed in America, with African and African American roots, and that jazz musicians improvise.
items.zh: 理解爵士乐是在美国发展起来的一种音乐，根植于非洲及非裔美国人文化，爵士乐手会即兴演奏。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Recognize Louis Armstrong as a great early jazz musician. Listen to What a Wonderful World
items.zh: 认识路易斯·阿姆斯特朗是伟大的早期爵士乐音乐家；聆听《What a Wonderful World》（多么美好的世界）。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Listen and dance to Doin' the Suzie Q (Lil Hardin Armstrong)
items.zh: 聆听并随《Doin' the Suzie Q》跳舞（莉尔·哈丁·阿姆斯特朗）

items.subject: Music
items.en: You may also wish to teach students the song “Brother, Come Dance with Me” in connection with their introduction to the opera Hansel and Gretel. And you may wish to teach the poem “Thanksgiving Day” (“Over the river and through the wood”) as a song (see Language Arts Grade 1: Poetry). “My Country Tis of Thee” “Dry Bones” “For He’s a Jolly Good Fellow” “Frère Jacques” “La Raspa” “Make New Friends” “Michael, Row the Boat Ashore” “Oh, Dear, What Can the Matter Be?” “On Top of Old Smokey” “She’ll Be Comin’ ’Round the Mountain” “Skip to My Lou” “Take Me Out to the Ball Game” “There’s a Hole in the Bucket” “When the Saints Go Marching In” “Yankee Doodle” Note: Students will review families of instruments and specific instruments in later grades
items.zh: 也可结合歌剧《汉塞尔与格莱特》教学生唱《Brother, Come Dance with Me》（哥哥，来和我跳舞）。还可将诗歌《感恩节》（Over the river and through the wood）作为歌曲教唱（见一年级语言艺术：诗歌）。《My Country 'Tis of Thee》《Dry Bones》《For He's a Jolly Good Fellow》《Frère Jacques》《La Raspa》《Make New Friends》《Michael, Row the Boat Ashore》《Oh, Dear, What Can the Matter Be?》《On Top of Old Smokey》《She'll Be Comin' 'Round the Mountain》《Skip to My Lou》《Take Me Out to the Ball Game》《There's a Hole in the Bucket》《When the Saints Go Marching In》《Yankee Doodle》。注：学生将在后续年级复习乐器组别和具体乐器。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Note: If resources are available, read aloud to students the story behind Tchaikovsky’s Nutcracker, and either attend a performance or show scenes from the ballet, which is available on videotape. You may also wish to introduce students to the Suite from Tchaikovsky’s Sleeping Beauty, in relation to the story in Language Arts Grade 1, “Sleeping Beauty.”
items.zh: 注：如有条件，可给学生朗读柴可夫斯基《胡桃夹子》背后的故事，并带他们观看演出或芭蕾舞录像片段。还可结合一年级语言艺术中的《睡美人》故事，向学生介绍柴可夫斯基的《睡美人组曲》。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Teachers: Mathematics has its own vocabulary and patterns of thinking. It is a discipline with its own language and conventions. Thus, while some lessons may offer occasional opportunities for linking mathematics to other disciplines, it is critically important to attend to math as math. From the earliest years, mathematics requires incremental review and steady practice: not only the diligent effort required to master basic facts and operations, but also thoughtful and varied practice that approaches problems from a variety of angles, and gives students a variety of opportunities to apply the same concept or operation in different types of situations. While it is important to work toward the development of “higher-order problem-solving skills,” it is equally important—indeed, it is prerequisite to achieving “higher order” skills—to have a sound grasp of basic facts, and an automatic fluency with fundamental operations.
items.zh: 教师须知：数学有其自身的词汇和思维方式，是一门有自己语言和规范的学科。因此，虽然有些课程偶尔可以把数学与其他学科联系起来，但把数学当作数学来讲至关重要。从最初几年起，数学就需要循序渐进的复习和持续练习：既要努力掌握基本事实和运算，也要进行深思熟虑、形式多样的练习，从多种角度处理问题，让学生在不同类型的情境中多次运用同一概念或运算。虽然培养“高阶解题技能”很重要，但牢固掌握基本事实、对基本运算达到自动化熟练程度同样重要——事实上，这是达到“高阶”技能的前提。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Represent and solve problems involving addition and subtraction.
items.zh: 表征并解决涉及加法和减法的问题。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Use addition and subtraction within 20 to solve word problems, with unknowns in all positions, involving situations of • adding to • taking from • putting together • taking apart • comparing
items.zh: 运用20以内的加减法解决应用题，未知数可出现在任何位置，涉及以下情境：增加、减少、合并、拆分、比较

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Solve word problems that call for
items.zh: 解决需要以下运算的应用题：
details: addition of three whole numbers (whose sum is less than or equal to 20)
equations with a symbol for the unknown number to represent the problem

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Understand and apply properties of operations and the relationship between addition and subtraction.
items.zh: 理解并运用运算性质以及加法与减法之间的关系。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Apply properties of operations (commutative and associative) as strategies to add and subtract.
items.zh: 运用运算性质（交换律和结合律）作为加减法的策略。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Understand subtraction as an unknown-addend problem.
items.zh: 把减法理解为求未知加数的问题。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Add and subtract up to 20.
items.zh: 进行20以内的加减法。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Relate counting to addition and subtraction.
items.zh: 将数数与加减法联系起来。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Add and subtract within 20 using strategies such as counting on, making ten, decomposing a number to a ten, and creating equivalent known sums.
items.zh: 运用接着数、凑十、把数拆成十和几、构造已知的等价和等策略，进行20以内的加减法。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Demonstrate fluency for addition and subtraction within 10.
items.zh: 熟练掌握10以内的加减法。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Work with addition and subtraction equations.
items.zh: 学习加减法算式。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Understand the meaning of the equal sign.
items.zh: 理解等号的含义。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Determine if equations involving addition and subtraction are true or false.
items.zh: 判断含有加减法的算式是否成立（真或假）。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Determine the unknown whole number in an addition or subtraction equation relating three whole numbers.
items.zh: 在涉及三个整数的加减法算式中，求出未知的整数。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.topic: Number and Operations in Base Ten
items.en: Extend the counting sequence.
items.zh: 扩展数数序列。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.topic: Number and Operations in Base Ten
items.en: Count to 120, starting at any number less than 120.
items.zh: 从任意小于120的数开始，数到120。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.topic: Number and Operations in Base Ten
items.en: Read and write numerals from 1–120.
items.zh: 读写1–120的数字。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.topic: Number and Operations in Base Ten
items.en: Represent a number of objects with a written numeral.
items.zh: 用数字表示物体的数量。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.topic: Number and Operations in Base Ten
items.en: Understand place value.
items.zh: 理解数位（位值）。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.topic: Number and Operations in Base Ten
items.en: Understand that the two digits of a two-digit number represent amounts of tens and ones: 10 as a bundle of ones, the numbers from 11–19 are a ten and ones, and that the multiples of ten refer to the number of tens.
items.zh: 理解两位数的两个数位分别表示几个十和几个一：10是一个“十”（由10个一组成）；11–19是一个十和几个一；整十数表示十的个数。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.topic: Number and Operations in Base Ten
items.en: Compare two two-digit numbers based on meanings of the tens and ones digits.
items.zh: 根据十位和个位的含义比较两个两位数。
details: Record the results of comparisons with the symbols >, =, and <. Using objects and drawings

items.subject: Mathematics
items.topic: Number and Operations in Base Ten
items.en: Using objects and drawings.
items.zh: 使用实物和画图。
details: Record the results of comparisons with the symbols >, =, and <. Using objects and drawings

items.subject: Mathematics
items.topic: Number and Operations in Base Ten
items.en: Use place value understanding and properties of operations to add and subtract.
items.zh: 运用位值理解和运算性质进行加减法。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.topic: Number and Operations in Base Ten
items.en: Add within 100, including
items.zh: 进行100以内的加法，包括：
details: adding a two-digit number and a one-digit number
adding a two-digit number and a multiple of 10

items.subject: Mathematics
items.topic: Number and Operations in Base Ten
items.en: Relate the strategy to a written method and explain the reasoning used.
items.zh: 将策略与书面计算方法联系起来，并解释所用推理。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.topic: Number and Operations in Base Ten
items.en: Understand that in adding two-digit numbers sometimes it is necessary to compose a ten.
items.zh: 理解两位数相加时有时需要进位（凑成一个十）。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.topic: Number and Operations in Base Ten
items.en: Given a two-digit number, mentally find 10 more or 10 less than the number.
items.zh: 给定一个两位数，心算比它大10或小10的数。
details: Explain the reasoning used.

items.subject: Mathematics
items.topic: Number and Operations in Base Ten
items.en: Subtract multiples of 10 in the range 10–90 from multiples of 10 in the range 10–90 (positive or zero differences). • Use concrete models or drawings and strategies based on
items.zh: 用10–90范围内的整十数减去10–90范围内的整十数（差为正数或零）。使用实物模型或画图，以及基于以下内容的策略：

items.subject: Mathematics
items.topic: Number and Operations in Base Ten
items.en: place value
items.zh: 位值

items.subject: Mathematics
items.topic: Number and Operations in Base Ten
items.en: properties of operations
items.zh: 运算性质

items.subject: Mathematics
items.topic: Number and Operations in Base Ten
items.en: the relationship between addition and subtraction
items.zh: 加法与减法之间的关系
details: Relate the strategy to a written method and explain the reasoning used.

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Measure lengths indirectly and by iterating length units.
items.zh: 用间接方法和重复摆放长度单位来测量长度。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Order three objects by length.
items.zh: 按长度给三个物体排序。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Compare the lengths of two objects indirectly by using a third object.
items.zh: 借助第三个物体间接比较两个物体的长度。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Express the length of an object as a whole number of length units
items.zh: 用整数个长度单位表示物体的长度

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Understand that the length measurement of an object is the number of same-size length units that span it with no gaps or overlaps when laid end to end.
items.zh: 理解物体的长度就是首尾相接、无空隙无重叠地铺满它所需的同样大小的长度单位的个数。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Tell and write time.
items.zh: 认读并书写时间。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Tell and write time in hours and half-hours using analog and digital clocks.
items.zh: 用指针钟表和电子钟表认读并书写整点和半点。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Represent and interpret data.
items.zh: 表示并解读数据。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Organize, represent, and interpret data with up to three categories.
items.zh: 整理、表示并解读最多分为三类的数据。
details: Ask and answer questions about the total number of data points.

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Reason with shapes (rectangles, squares, trapezoids, triangles, half-circles, quarter-circles, cubes, right rectangular prisms, right circular cones and right circular cylinders) and their attributes.
items.zh: 对图形（长方形、正方形、梯形、三角形、半圆、四分之一圆、正方体、直长方体、直圆锥和直圆柱）及其属性进行推理。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Distinguish between defining attributes (e.g., triangles are closed and three-sided) versus non-defining attributes (e.g., color, orientation, overall size). • Build and draw shapes to possess defining attributes.
items.zh: 区分本质属性（例如三角形是封闭的三边形）与非本质属性（例如颜色、方向、整体大小）。搭建并画出具有本质属性的图形。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Compose two-dimensional and three-dimensional shapes to create a composite shape. • Compose new shapes from the composite shape.
items.zh: 用二维和三维图形拼组出组合图形，再用组合图形拼出新的图形。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Partition circles and rectangles into two and four equal shares.
items.zh: 把圆形和长方形分成二等份和四等份。
details: Describe shares using the words halves, fourths, and quarters.
Use the phrases half of, fourth of, and quarter of.
Describe the whole as two of, or four of the shares.

Understand for these examples that decomposing into more equal shares creates smaller shares. Use concrete models or drawings and strategies based on place value, properties of operations, and/ or the relationship between addition and subtraction

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Example questions: how many in each category, or how many more or less are in one category than in another.
items.zh: 示例问题：每一类有多少，或某一类比另一类多多少、少多少。
details: Describe shares using the words halves, fourths, and quarters.
Use the phrases half of, fourth of, and quarter of.
Describe the whole as two of, or four of the shares.

Understand for these examples that decomposing into more equal shares creates smaller shares. Use concrete models or drawings and strategies based on place value, properties of operations, and/ or the relationship between addition and subtraction

items.subject: Science
items.en: Teachers: Effective instruction in science requires hands-on experience and observation. In the words of the report from the National Academies of Science, A Framework for K-12 Science Education, “...children have surprisingly sophisticated ways of thinking about the world, based in part on their direct experiences with the physical environment, such as watching objects fall or collide and observing plants and animals. They also learn about the world through everyday activities, such as talking with their families, pursuing hobbies, watching television, and playing with friends. As children try to understand and influence the world around them, they develop ideas about their role in that world and how it works. In fact, the capacity of young children—from all backgrounds and socioeconomic levels—to reason in sophisticated ways is much greater than has long been assumed. Although they may lack deep knowledge and extensive experience, they often engage in a wide range of subtle and complex reasoning about the world. Thus, before they even enter school, children have developed their own ideas about the physical, biological, and social worlds and how they work. By listening to and taking these ideas seriously, educators can build on what children already know and can do.”
items.zh: 教师须知：有效的科学教学需要动手体验和观察。用美国国家科学院报告《K-12 科学教育框架》的话来说：“……孩子们以令人惊讶的复杂方式思考世界，这部分基于他们对物质环境的直接体验，比如观看物体下落或碰撞、观察动植物。他们也通过日常活动了解世界，比如与家人交谈、从事爱好、看电视、和朋友玩耍。当孩子们试图理解和影响周围的世界时，他们会形成关于自己在世界中的角色以及世界如何运作的想法。事实上，幼儿——无论来自何种背景、何种社会经济水平——进行复杂推理的能力远超长期以来的设想。尽管他们可能缺乏深入知识和丰富经验，但他们常常对世界进行广泛而细致的复杂推理。因此，甚至在入学之前，孩子们就已经对物理、生物和社会世界及其运作方式形成了自己的想法。通过倾听并认真对待这些想法，教育者可以在儿童已有知识和能力的基础上进行教学。”

items.subject: Science
items.en: Through reading aloud, observation, and activities such as describing how the moon appears to change at different times of the month, explore the following with students:
items.zh: 通过朗读、观察以及描述月亮在一个月的不同时间看起来的变化等活动，与学生一起探究以下内容：

items.subject: Science
items.subtopic: The Sun and Its Predictable Patterns
items.en: The sun is a star.
items.zh: 太阳是一颗恒星。

items.subject: Science
items.subtopic: The Sun and Its Predictable Patterns
items.en: Earth gets light and heat (thermal energy) from the sun.
items.zh: 地球从太阳获得光和热（热能）。

items.subject: Science
items.subtopic: The Sun and Its Predictable Patterns
items.en: An Earth day (daytime and night together) is twenty-four hours.
items.zh: 地球上的一天（白天和夜晚合在一起）是24小时。

items.subject: Science
items.subtopic: The Sun and Its Predictable Patterns
items.en: Sunrise and sunset happen because Earth, which is ball-shaped, rotates.
items.zh: 日出和日落是因为球形的地球在自转。

items.subject: Science
items.subtopic: Annual Patterns of Sunrise and Sunset
items.en: The times of sunrise and sunset vary a little each day and occur in predictable patterns.
items.zh: 日出和日落的时间每天略有变化，并呈现出可预测的模式。

items.subject: Science
items.topic: The Moon and Its Predictable Patterns
items.en: The moon, which is ball-shaped, is visible in the sky at night and often during the day.
items.zh: 月球是球形的，夜晚在天空中可见，白天也常常可见。

items.subject: Science
items.topic: The Moon and Its Predictable Patterns
items.en: The moon appears to change shape over about a month; these changes are called the moon’s phases (new, crescent, half, full).
items.zh: 月球的形状在大约一个月里似乎会变化；这些变化称为月相（新月、月牙、半月、满月）。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Stars are distant objects that give off their own light.
items.zh: 恒星是遥远的、自身发光的天体。

items.subject: Science
items.en: The positions of some stars are used to draw imagined patterns called constellations (Big Dipper, Orion).
items.zh: 人们利用一些恒星的位置画出想象中的图案，称为星座（北斗七星、猎户座）。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Stars appear to rotate across the sky in the course of a night.
items.zh: 在同一个夜晚，恒星似乎会在天空中转动。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Through reading aloud, observation, and activities such as investigating how various animals respond to different stimuli in their environment, help students to explore the following:
items.zh: 通过朗读、观察以及探究各种动物如何对环境中的不同刺激作出反应等活动，帮助学生探究以下内容：

items.subject: Science
items.subtopic: Structure and Function in Plants and Animals
items.en: Plants and animals are composed of parts (structures), which they use in support of their survival. B. Information Processing: Plant and Animal Stimulus and Response
items.zh: 动植物由各种部分（结构）组成，它们利用这些部分来维持生存。B. 信息处理：动植物的刺激与反应

items.subject: Science
items.subtopic: Structure and Function in Plants and Animals
items.en: Animals and plants have parts that enable them to obtain and process information about their environment through their senses.
items.zh: 动植物具有某些部分，使它们能通过感官获取和处理有关环境的信息。

items.subject: Science
items.subtopic: Structure and Function in Plants and Animals
items.en: Animals and plants respond to environmental inputs (stimuli) with behaviors that help them survive.
items.zh: 动植物会对环境输入（刺激）作出反应，这些行为有助于它们生存。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Adult plants and animals reproduce.
items.zh: 成年的动植物会繁殖。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Many kinds of animal parents take care of their offspring until the offspring become mature enough to care for themselves.
items.zh: 许多种类的动物父母会照顾后代，直到后代成熟到能照顾自己。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Traits are the characteristics of living things.
items.zh: 性状是生物体的特征。

items.subject: Science
items.en: The emphasis in Grade 1 should be on observation, description, and explanation of real world experiences of light and sound, including how they can be used to solve problems; technical explanations of light and sound should be taken up in later grades; see Grades 4, 6, and 8 for an increasingly more detailed study of energy and waves:
items.zh: 一年级的重点应放在对现实世界中光和声的观察、描述和解释，包括如何利用它们解决问题；光和声的技术性解释应在后续年级学习；关于能量和波的内容可参见四、六、八年级，研究逐步深入：

items.subject: Science

items.subject: Science

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: NOTE: The objectives listed in sections I–IV of Language Arts below are consistent with the Core Knowledge Language Arts program and embed all of the skills and concepts within the Common Core State Standards for English Language Arts.

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Traditional language arts instruction has typically accorded little, if any, attention to the ongoing development of children’s listening and speaking ability. This failure to focus on the development of oral language in language arts instruction has been a serious oversight. Literacy, the ability to read and write written language, is highly correlated with students’ oral language proficiency, and the ability to understand a text read aloud is a prerequisite for making sense of the same text in printed form. It is therefore essential that children build listening and speaking competency while also developing reading and writing skills.
items.zh: 传统的语言艺术教学通常很少甚至根本不关注儿童听说能力的持续发展。这种在语言艺术教学中忽视口语能力发展的做法是一个严重的疏漏。读写能力，即阅读和书写书面语言的能力，与学生的口语水平高度相关；而听懂朗读文本的能力，是理解同一印刷文本的前提。因此，儿童在发展读写技能的同时，必须培养听说能力。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Give oral presentations about personal experiences, topics of interest, stories, and summaries of factual information that have been presented orally, visually or through multimedia, using appropriate eye contact, volume and clear enunciation. C. Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—All Texts Teachers: Written text makes use of richer vocabulary and more complex syntax than conversational language. It is important that young children be exposed not only to the language of everyday conversation but also to the richer and more formal language of books. This can be done through frequent reading aloud. Helping young children develop the ability to listen to and understand written texts read aloud must be an integral part of any initiative designed to build literacy. At the second grade level, students are becoming increasingly skilled as independent readers. Nevertheless, research indicates that reading comprehension ability does not catch up to listening comprehension until the middle school grades. It is therefore still important to provide second graders with extensive read aloud experiences of both fiction and nonfiction texts. Careful consideration should be given to the selection of books read aloud to ensure that the vocabulary and syntax presented is rich and complex. Leveled texts will not provide the rich language experience desired during read-alouds and should only be used as a starting point with students for whom English is a second language. Nonfiction read-alouds should be selected on the basis of the history, science, music and visual art topics identified for Grade 2 students in the Core Knowledge Sequence, with emphasis on history and science read-alouds. It is strongly recommended that daily read-alouds focus on a single topic over a sustained period of time—about two weeks—rather than intermingling read-alouds on a variety of subjects. Careful consideration should be given to the order in which nonfiction read-alouds are presented to ensure that knowledge about a topic builds in a progressive and coherent way. Following any read-aloud, students should participate in rich, structured conversations with an adult in response to the written text that has been read aloud. In this way, they can begin to orally practice comparing, analyzing, and synthesizing ideas in written text in much the same way as they will be expected to do as independent readers in the later grades.
items.zh: 就个人经历、感兴趣的话题、故事，以及对通过口头、视觉或多媒体呈现的事实信息进行概述，做口头报告，眼神交流、音量和吐字清晰恰当。C. 朗读的理解与讨论——所有文本 教师须知：书面文本使用的词汇比日常会话更丰富，句法更复杂。幼儿不仅应接触日常会话语言，也应接触书籍中更丰富、更正式的语言，这可以通过经常朗读来实现。帮助幼儿培养听懂朗读的书面文本的能力，必须成为一切培养读写能力举措的组成部分。到了二年级，学生作为独立阅读者的能力日益提高。然而研究表明，阅读理解能力直到中学阶段才能赶上听力理解能力。因此，仍有必要让二年级学生大量接触虚构类和非虚构类文本的朗读。应仔细选择朗读书目，确保所呈现的词汇和句法丰富而复杂。分级读物无法提供朗读所需的丰富语言体验，只应作为英语为第二语言学生的起点。非虚构类朗读材料应根据核心知识序列中为二年级学生确定的历史、科学、音乐和视觉艺术主题来选择，并侧重历史和科学类朗读。强烈建议每日朗读在较长一段时间（约两周）内专注于单一主题，而不是混合朗读多种主题。还应仔细考虑非虚构类朗读的呈现顺序，确保关于某一主题的知识以渐进、连贯的方式积累。每次朗读之后，学生应与成人围绕所朗读的书面文本进行丰富、有结构的对话。这样，他们就能开始口头练习比较、分析和综合书面文本中的观点，就像日后作为独立阅读者被期望做到的那样。

items.section_zh: 把握具体细节与关键思想

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Interpret information that is presented orally and then ask additional questions to clarify information or the topic in the read-aloud.
items.zh: 理解口头呈现的信息，然后进一步提问以澄清朗读中的信息或主题。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Identify who is telling a story or providing information in a text.
items.zh: 识别文本中谁在讲故事或提供信息。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
items.en: Retell a story, using narrative language to describe characters, setting(s), and the plot of the story in proper sequence.
items.zh: 复述故事，用叙述性语言按正确顺序描述人物、场景和故事情节。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
items.en: Compare and contrast characters from different stories.
items.zh: 比较和对比不同故事中的人物。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
items.en: Describe characters in increasing depth by referring to their dialogue and/or actions in the story.
items.zh: 通过引用人物的对话和/或故事中的行为，越来越深入地描述人物。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
items.en: Change some story events and provide a different story ending.
items.zh: 改动某些故事事件，并给出一个不同的故事结局。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
items.en: Create and tell an original story, using narrative language to describe characters, setting(s), and the plot of the story in proper sequence.
items.zh: 创作并讲述原创故事，用叙述性语言按正确顺序描述人物、场景和情节。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
items.en: Distinguish fantasy from realistic text in a story.
items.zh: 区分故事中的幻想情节与现实情节。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
items.en: Identify the moral or lesson of a fable, folktale, or myth.
items.zh: 找出寓言、民间故事或神话的寓意或教训。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
items.en: Demonstrate understanding of literary language (e.g., author, illustrator, characters, setting, plot, dialogue, personification, simile, and metaphor) and use some of these terms in retelling stories or creating their own stories.
items.zh: 理解文学语言（如作者、插画家、人物、场景、情节、对话、拟人、明喻和暗喻），并在复述故事或创作自己的故事时使用其中一些术语。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
items.en: Identify repetitions in phrases, refrains, or sounds in poems or songs.
items.zh: 找出诗歌或歌曲中重复的短语、副歌或声音。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
items.en: Identify sensory language and how it is used to describe people, objects, places, and events.
items.zh: 识别感官语言及其如何用于描述人物、物体、地点和事件。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
items.en: Describe the use of rhyme, rhythm and sensory images used in poetry. E. Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Nonfiction and Informational Text Teachers: Select nonfiction read-aloud topics from the second grade history, science, music, and visual arts topics, with emphasis on history and science.
items.zh: 描述诗歌中押韵、节奏和感官意象的运用。E. 朗读的理解与讨论——非虚构与说明性文本 教师须知：从二年级的历史、科学、音乐和视觉艺术主题中选择非虚构类朗读主题，并侧重历史和科学。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
items.en: Generate questions and seek information from multiple sources to answer questions.
items.zh: 提出问题，并从多个来源寻找信息来回答问题。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
items.en: Answer questions about the details of a nonfiction text, indicating which part of the text provided the information needed to answer specific questions.
items.zh: 回答有关非虚构文本细节的问题，并指出文本的哪一部分提供了回答特定问题所需的信息。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
items.en: With assistance, categorize and organize facts and information within a given topic.
items.zh: 在帮助下，将给定主题范围内的事实和信息分类整理。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
items.en: With assistance, create and interpret timelines and lifelines related to read-alouds.
items.zh: 在帮助下，制作并解读与朗读内容相关的时间线和生平线。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
items.en: Interpret information presented in diagrams, charts, graphs, etc.
items.zh: 解读图表、曲线图等呈现的信息。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
items.en: Distinguish read-alouds that describe events that happened long ago from those that describe contemporary or current events.
items.zh: 区分描述很久以前发生的事件的朗读与描述当代或当前事件的朗读。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
items.en: Demonstrate understanding that a systematic, predictable relationship exists between written letters (graphemes) and spoken sounds (phonemes).
items.zh: 理解书面字母（字素）与口头语音（音素）之间存在系统、可预测的关系。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
items.en: Blend individual phonemes to pronounce printed words.
items.zh: 将单个音素拼合起来读出印刷文字。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
items.en: Understand that sometimes two or more printed letters stand for a single sound.
items.zh: 理解有时两个或更多印刷字母代表一个音。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
items.en: Read multi-syllable words containing any of the grapheme-phoneme correspondences listed below.
items.zh: 读出包含以下任一字素—音素对应关系的多音节词。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
items.en: Read and write words with inflectional endings, i.e., -s, -ed, -ing, -er, -est.
items.zh: 读写带屈折词尾的单词，即 -s、-ed、-ing、-er、-est。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
items.en: Read, understand, and write contractions, i.e., isn’t, I’m, can’t, etc.
items.zh: 读写并理解缩写形式，例如 isn't、I'm、can't 等。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
items.en: Sort and classify words according to the spelling used to represent a specific phoneme.
items.zh: 根据表示特定音素的拼写方式对单词进行分类。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
items.en: Read tricky spellings that can be sounded two ways, e.g., the letter ‘s’ sounded /s/ as in cats and /z/ as in dogs.
items.zh: 读出有两种发音的棘手拼写，例如字母“s”在 cats 中发 /s/，在 dogs 中发 /z/。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
items.en: Read and spell chains of one-syllable words in which one sound is added, substituted, or omitted, i.e., read at > cat > bat > bad > bid.
items.zh: 读写单音节词词链，每次增加、替换或去掉一个音，例如读 at > cat > bat > bad > bid。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
items.en: Read at least 100 words generally identified as high frequency words. Consonant Sounds and Spellings Taught in Second Grade /b/ spelled ‘b’ as in boy, ‘bb’, as in tubby /d/ spelled ‘d’ as in dog, ‘dd’ as in madder, ‘ed’ as in filled /f/ spelled ‘f’ as in fun, ‘ff’ as in stuff /g/ spelled ‘g’ as in get, ‘gg’ as in egg /h/ spelled ‘h’ as in him /j/ spelled ‘j’ as in jump, ‘g’ as in gem, ‘ge’ as in fringe /k/ spelled ‘c’ as in cat, ‘k’ as in kitten, ‘ck’ as in sick, ‘cc’ as in moccasin /l/ spelled ‘l’ as in lip, ‘ll’ as in sell /m/ spelled ‘m’ as in mad, ‘mm’ as in hammer /n/ spelled ‘n’ as in net, ‘nn’ as in funny, ‘kn’ as in knock /p/ spelled ‘p’ as in pet, ‘pp’ as in happy /r/ spelled ‘r’ as in red, ‘rr’ as in earring, ‘wr’ as in wrist /s/ spelled ‘s’ as in sit, ‘ss’ as in dress, ‘c’ as in cent, ‘ce’ as in prince, ‘se’ as in rinse /t/ spelled ‘t’ as in top, ‘tt’ as in butter, ‘ed’ as in asked /v/ spelled ‘v’ as in vet, ‘ve’ as in twelve /w/ spelled ‘w’ as in wet, ‘wh’ as in when /x/ spelled ‘x’ as in tax /y/ spelled ‘y’ as in yes /z/ spelled ‘z’ as in zip, ‘zz’ as in buzz, ‘s’ as in dogs /ch/ spelled ‘ch’ as in chop, ‘tch’ as in itch /sh/ spelled ‘sh’ as in ship /th/ spelled ‘th’ as in thin /th/ spelled ‘th’ as in then /qu/ spelled ‘qu’ as in quick /ng/ spelled ‘ng’ as in sing, ‘n’ as in pink Vowel Sounds and Spellings Taught in Second Grade /a/ spelled ‘a’ as in cat /e/ spelled ‘e’ as in get, ‘ea’ as in head /i/ spelled ‘i’ as in hit, ‘y’ as in myth /o/ spelled ‘o’ as in hot, ‘a’ as in wall /u/ spelled ‘u’ as in but, ‘o’ as in son /ae/ spelled ‘a\_e’ as in cake, ‘ai’ as in wait, ‘ay’ as in day, ‘a’ as in paper, ‘ey’ as in hey, ‘ei’ as in weight, ‘ea’ as in great /ee/ spelled ‘ee’ as in bee, ‘e’ as in me, ‘y’ as in funny, ‘ea’ as in beach, ‘e\_e’ as in Pete, ‘ie’ as in cookie, ‘i’ as in ski, ‘ey’ as in key /ie/ spelled ‘i\_e’ as in bike, ‘i’ as in biting, ‘y’ as in try, ‘ie’ as in tie, ‘igh’ as in night
items.zh: 认读至少100个通常被认为是高频词的单词。二年级教授的辅音发音与拼写：/b/ 拼作 'b'（如 boy）、'bb'（如 tubby）；/d/ 拼作 'd'（如 dog）、'dd'（如 madder）、'ed'（如 filled）；/f/ 拼作 'f'（如 fun）、'ff'（如 stuff）；/g/ 拼作 'g'（如 get）、'gg'（如 egg）；/h/ 拼作 'h'（如 him）；/j/ 拼作 'j'（如 jump）、'g'（如 gem）、'ge'（如 fringe）；/k/ 拼作 'c'（如 cat）、'k'（如 kitten）、'ck'（如 sick）、'cc'（如 moccasin）；/l/ 拼作 'l'（如 lip）、'll'（如 sell）；/m/ 拼作 'm'（如 mad）、'mm'（如 hammer）；/n/ 拼作 'n'（如 net）、'nn'（如 funny）、'kn'（如 knock）；/p/ 拼作 'p'（如 pet）、'pp'（如 happy）；/r/ 拼作 'r'（如 red）、'rr'（如 earring）、'wr'（如 wrist）；/s/ 拼作 's'（如 sit）、'ss'（如 dress）、'c'（如 cent）、'ce'（如 prince）、'se'（如 rinse）；/t/ 拼作 't'（如 top）、'tt'（如 butter）、'ed'（如 asked）；/v/ 拼作 'v'（如 vet）、've'（如 twelve）；/w/ 拼作 'w'（如 wet）、'wh'（如 when）；/x/ 拼作 'x'（如 tax）；/y/ 拼作 'y'（如 yes）；/z/ 拼作 'z'（如 zip）、'zz'（如 buzz）、's'（如 dogs）；/ch/ 拼作 'ch'（如 chop）、'tch'（如 itch）；/sh/ 拼作 'sh'（如 ship）；/th/ 拼作 'th'（如 thin）；/th/ 拼作 'th'（如 then）；/qu/ 拼作 'qu'（如 quick）；/ng/ 拼作 'ng'（如 sing）、'n'（如 pink）。二年级教授的元音发音与拼写：/a/ 拼作 'a'（如 cat）；/e/ 拼作 'e'（如 get）、'ea'（如 head）；/i/ 拼作 'i'（如 hit）、'y'（如 myth）；/o/ 拼作 'o'（如 hot）、'a'（如 wall）；/u/ 拼作 'u'（如 but）、'o'（如 son）；/ae/ 拼作 'a_e'（如 cake）、'ai'（如 wait）、'ay'（如 day）、'a'（如 paper）、'ey'（如 hey）、'ei'（如 weight）、'ea'（如 great）；/ee/ 拼作 'ee'（如 bee）、'e'（如 me）、'y'（如 funny）、'ea'（如 beach）、'e_e'（如 Pete）、'ie'（如 cookie）、'i'（如 ski）、'ey'（如 key）；/ie/ 拼作 'i_e'（如 bike）、'i'（如 biting）、'y'（如 try）、'ie'（如 tie）、'igh'（如 night）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
items.en: Read decodable stories that incorporate the specific code knowledge that has been taught.
items.zh: 阅读包含已教授的特定拼读知识的可解码故事。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
items.en: Demonstrate increased accuracy, fluency, and expression on successive reading of a decodable text (90 wpm by the end of the year).
items.zh: 在反复朗读同一篇可解码文本时，表现出准确度、流利度和表达力的提升（到学年末达到每分钟90词）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
items.en: Use phonics skills in conjunction with context to confirm or self-correct word recognition and understanding, rereading as necessary.
items.zh: 结合拼读技能与上下文，确认或自我纠正字词识别与理解，必要时重读。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
items.en: Demonstrate understanding of and use commas and end punctuation while reading orally.
items.zh: 在朗读时理解并正确使用逗号和句末标点。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
items.en: Read aloud, alone, or with a partner at least 20 minutes each day.
items.zh: 每天至少朗读20分钟，可独自朗读，也可与同伴一起朗读。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: At the second grade level, students should be demonstrating ever-increasing code knowledge and fluency in their independent reading, allowing them to focus more intently on the meaning of what they are reading. This increased focus on reading comprehension is reflected in the number and complexity of the objectives below, as compared to earlier grades. However, it is important to remember that listening comprehension still far exceeds reading comprehension and that students’ ability to talk about what they have heard and/or read will exceed their ability to demonstrate that understanding in writing.
items.zh: 在二年级阶段，学生的独立阅读应展现出不断增强的解码知识和流利度，从而能更专注地理解所读内容。与更早的年级相比，以下目标的数量和复杂性正体现了这种对阅读理解日益增强的重视。但要记住，听力理解仍远远超过阅读理解；学生谈论所听和/或所读内容的能力，会超过他们以书面形式展示这种理解的能力。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Demonstrate understanding of text—the majority of which is decodable—after independent reading.
items.zh: 独立阅读后，能展示对文本的理解（所读文本大多为可拼读文本）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Sequence four to six pictures illustrating events from a text that has been read independently.
items.zh: 将四到六幅描绘所读文本中事件的图片按顺序排列。
items.section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
items.section_zh: 掌握具体细节与关键观点

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Answer questions requiring literal recall and understanding of the details and/or facts (i.e., who, what, where, when, etc.) about a text that has been read independently.
items.zh: 回答需要逐字回忆并理解所读文本细节和/或事实的问题（即谁、什么、哪里、何时等）。
items.section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
items.section_zh: 掌握具体细节与关键观点

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Retell key details from a text that has been read independently.
items.zh: 复述独立阅读文本中的关键细节。
items.section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
items.section_zh: 掌握具体细节与关键观点

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Summarize in one’s own words selected parts of a text.
items.zh: 用自己的话概括文本的选定部分。
items.section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
items.section_zh: 掌握具体细节与关键观点

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Ask questions to clarify information about a text that has been read independently.
items.zh: 通过提问来澄清所读独立文本中的信息。
items.section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
items.section_zh: 掌握具体细节与关键观点

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use narrative language to describe people, places, things, locations, events, actions, a scene or facts from a text that has been read independently.
items.zh: 运用叙述性语言，描述独立阅读文本中的人物、地点、事物、方位、事件、动作、场景或事实。
items.section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
items.section_zh: 掌握具体细节与关键观点

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Identify basic text features and what they mean, including title, table of contents, chapter headings and captions.
items.zh: 识别基本的文本特征及其含义，包括标题、目录、章节标题和图注。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Understand and use words and phrases from a text that has been read independently.
items.zh: 理解并运用独立阅读文本中的单词和短语。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Compare and contrast similarities and differences within a single text or between multiple texts read independently.
items.zh: 比较并对比单篇文本内部或多篇独立阅读文本之间的异同。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Make personal connections to events or experiences in a text that has been read. independently and/or make connections among several texts that have been read independently.
items.zh: 把所读文本中的事件或经历与个人建立联系，和/或在多篇独立阅读文本之间建立联系。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Prior to reading, identify what they know and have learned that may be related to the specific story or topic to be read.
items.zh: 阅读前，识别出自己已知的、可能与将要阅读的故事或主题相关的内容。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use pictures accompanying the written text to check and support understanding.
items.zh: 利用文本所配的图片来检验并支持理解。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Make predictions prior to and while reading, based on the title, pictures, and/or text read thus far and then compare the actual outcomes to predictions.
items.zh: 根据标题、图片和/或迄今读到的文本，在阅读前和阅读中作出预测，然后将实际结果与预测进行比较。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Answer questions that require making interpretations, judgments, or giving opinions about what is read independently, including answering “why” questions that require recognizing cause/effect relationships.
items.zh: 回答需要作出解释、判断或对独立阅读内容发表看法的问题，包括需要识别因果关系的“为什么”类问题。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Interpret information that is read independently and then ask questions to clarify this information.
items.zh: 解读独立阅读获得的信息，然后提问以澄清这些信息。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Identify who is telling a story or providing information in a text.
items.zh: 识别文本中是谁在讲故事或提供信息。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Identify temporal words that link and sequence events, i.e., first, next, then, etc.
items.zh: 识别连接并排序事件的时序词，即 first（首先）、next（接着）、then（然后）等。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Identify words that link ideas, i.e., for example, also, in addition.
items.zh: 识别连接观点的词语，即 for example（例如）、also（也）、in addition（此外）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Retell a story, using narrative language to describe characters, setting(s), and the plot of the story in proper sequence.
items.zh: 复述故事，运用叙述性语言按正确顺序描述人物、场景和故事情节。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Compare and contrast characters from different stories.
items.zh: 比较和对比不同故事中的人物。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Describe characters in increasing depth by referring to dialogue and/or their actions in the story.
items.zh: 通过引用对话和/或人物在故事中的行为，越来越深入地描述人物。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Change some story events and provide a different story ending.
items.zh: 改动某些故事事件，并给出一个不同的故事结局。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Distinguish fantasy from realistic text in a story.
items.zh: 区分故事中的幻想内容与写实内容。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Identify the moral or lesson of a fable, folktale, or myth.
items.zh: 找出寓言、民间故事或神话中的寓意或教训。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Demonstrate understanding of literary language (e.g., author, illustrator, characters, setting, plot, dialogue, personification, simile, and metaphor) and use some of these terms in retelling stories or creating their own stories.
items.zh: 理解文学语言（例如 author 作者、illustrator 插画家、characters 人物、setting 背景、plot 情节、dialogue 对话、personification 拟人、simile 明喻、metaphor 暗喻），并在复述故事或创作自己的故事时使用其中一些术语。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Identify sensory language and how it is used to describe people, objects, places, and events.
items.zh: 识别感官语言及其如何用于描写人物、物体、地点和事件。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Identify repetitions in phrases, refrains, or sounds in poems or songs.
items.zh: 识别诗歌或歌曲中短语、副歌或声音的重复。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Describe the use of rhyme, rhythm and sensory images used in poetry.
items.zh: 描述诗歌中押韵、节奏和感官意象的运用。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Select nonfiction topics from the second grade history, science, music and visual arts topics with emphasis on history and science.
items.zh: 从二年级的历史、科学、音乐和视觉艺术主题中选择非虚构类主题，重点放在历史和科学上。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Generate questions and seek information from multiple sources to answer questions.
items.zh: 提出问题，并从多种来源寻找信息以回答问题。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Answer questions about the details of a nonfiction text, indicating which part of the text provided the information needed to answer specific questions.
items.zh: 回答关于非虚构文本细节的问题，并指出文本的哪一部分提供了回答特定问题所需的信息。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Interpret information presented in diagrams, charts, graphs, etc.
items.zh: 解读图表、曲线图、图形等所呈现的信息。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: With assistance, categorize and organize facts and information for a given topic.
items.zh: 在协助下，对给定主题的事实和信息进行归类和整理。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: With assistance, create and interpret timelines and lifelines related to text read independently.
items.zh: 在协助下，创建并解读与独立阅读文本相关的时间轴和生命线（lifelines）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Distinguish text that describes events that happened long ago from text that describes contemporary or current events.
items.zh: 区分描述很久以前发生的事件的文本与描述当代或当前事件的文本。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Students develop ever increasing code knowledge and fluency in reading during second grade and, as a result, most will also become increasingly comfortable and competent in expressing their thoughts and ideas in writing.
items.zh: 二年级期间，学生的解码知识和阅读流利度不断提升，因此大多数学生在用书面表达思想和想法方面也会变得越来越自如、越来越胜任。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Add details to writing.
items.zh: 为写作添加细节。
items.section: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose and Task
items.section_zh: 写作要体现读者对象、目的和任务

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Begin to use tools, including technology, to plan, draft, and edit writing.
items.zh: 开始使用各种工具（包括技术工具）来规划、起草和修改写作。
items.section: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose and Task
items.section_zh: 写作要体现读者对象、目的和任务

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Gather information from experiences or provided text sources.
items.zh: 从经历或提供的文本来源中收集信息。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Write a familiar story that includes setting(s), character(s), dialogue, and if appropriate, several events, using temporal words and phrases to indicate the chronology of events.
items.zh: 写一个熟悉的故事，包含场景、人物、对话，如合适还包含若干事件，并用时序词和短语表明事件的先后顺序。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Write a personal narrative.
items.zh: 写一篇个人叙述文。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Create a title and an ending that are relevant to the narrative
items.zh: 拟一个与叙述内容相关的标题和结尾。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Write about a topic, including a beginning and ending sentence, facts and examples. relevant to the topic, and specific steps (if writing explanatory text).
items.zh: 围绕一个主题写作，包括开头句和结尾句、与该主题相关的事实和例子，以及具体步骤（如果是说明性文字）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Group similar information into paragraphs.
items.zh: 把相似的信息归入同一段落。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use linking words such as also, another, and, etc. to connect ideas within a paragraph.
items.zh: 使用 also、another、and 等连接词连接段落中的观点。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Express an opinion or point of view in writing, providing reasons and supporting details for preference or opinion.
items.zh: 在写作中表达观点或看法，并为偏好或观点提供理由和支持性细节。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use words to link opinions with reasons or supporting details, such as because, also, another.
items.zh: 使用 because、also、another 等词语将观点与理由或支持性细节连接起来。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Create a title that is relevant to the topic or subject of the text.
items.zh: 创作一个与文本主题相关的标题。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: If writing about a specific book or read-aloud, refer to the content of the text.
items.zh: 如果写某本具体的书或某次朗读，要提及文本内容。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Form sentences and paragraphs to communicate thoughts and ideas.
items.zh: 组织句子和段落来交流思想和想法。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Apply basic spelling conventions.
items.zh: 运用基本的拼写规则。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use basic capitalization and punctuation in sentences to convey meaning.
items.zh: 在句子中使用基本的大小写和标点来传达意思。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Write phonemically plausible spellings for words using current code knowledge, e.g., write doller for dollar, wate for wait or weight.
items.zh: 根据当前掌握的解码知识，写出在音形上说得通的拼写，例如把 dollar 写成 doller，把 wait 或 weight 写成 wate。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Write words, phrases, and sentences from dictation, applying phonics knowledge.
items.zh: 运用自然拼读知识，根据听写写出单词、短语和句子。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Alphabetize words to the second letter.
items.zh: 按字母顺序排序单词直到第二个字母。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use a children’s dictionary, with assistance, to check spelling and verify the meaning of words.
items.zh: 在协助下使用儿童词典检查拼写并确认词义。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Identify and use synonyms, antonyms, homophones, and compound words.
items.zh: 识别并使用同义词、反义词、同音词和复合词。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Parts of Speech and Sentence Structure
items.en: Recognize, identify and use subject, object, and possessive pronouns, i.e., I, me, my, they, them, orally, in written text and in own writing.
items.zh: 在口语、书面文本和自己的写作中，识别并使用主格、宾格和所有格代词，即 I、me、my、they、them。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Parts of Speech and Sentence Structure
items.en: Recognize, identify and use correct noun-pronoun agreement orally, in written text, and in own writing.
items.zh: 在口语、书面文本和自己的写作中，识别并使用正确的名词—代词一致关系。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Parts of Speech and Sentence Structure
items.en: Recognize, identify and use common and proper nouns, orally, in written text, and in own writing.
items.zh: 在口语、书面文本和自己的写作中，识别并使用普通名词和专有名词。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Parts of Speech and Sentence Structure
items.en: Recognize, identify, and use the articles a and an appropriately orally, in written text, and in own writing.
items.zh: 在口语、书面文本和自己的写作中，正确识别并使用冠词 a 和 an。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Parts of Speech and Sentence Structure
items.en: Recognize, identify and use selected regular and irregular plural nouns orally, in written text, and in own writing.
items.zh: 在口语、书面文本和自己的写作中，识别并使用选定的规则和不规则复数名词。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Parts of Speech and Sentence Structure
items.en: Recognize, identify and use selected regular and irregular past, present, and future tense verbs orally, in written text, and in own writing.
items.zh: 在口语、书面文本和自己的写作中，识别并使用选定的规则和不规则过去式、现在式和将来式动词。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Parts of Speech and Sentence Structure
items.en: Recognize, identify, and use adjectives orally, in written text, and in own writing.
items.zh: 在口头表达、阅读文本和自己的写作中识别并使用形容词。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Parts of Speech and Sentence Structure
items.en: Recognize, identify, and use adverbs orally, in written text, and in own writing.
items.zh: 在口语、书面文本和自己的写作中，识别并使用副词。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Parts of Speech and Sentence Structure
items.en: Recognize, identify and use subjects and predicates, orally, in written text, and in own writing.
items.zh: 在口语、书面文本和自己的写作中，识别并使用主语和谓语。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Parts of Speech and Sentence Structure
items.en: Recognize, identify, and use statements, questions, and exclamations orally, in written text, and in own writing.
items.zh: 在口头表达、阅读文本和自己的写作中识别并使用陈述句、疑问句和感叹句。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Parts of Speech and Sentence Structure
items.en: Recognize, identify, and use complete simple and compound sentences.
items.zh: 识别并使用完整的简单句和并列句。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Capitalize the first word in a sentence, the pronoun I, and proper nouns (names and places,) months, days of the week, titles of people, and addresses.
items.zh: 句首字母、代词 I、专有名词（人名和地名）、月份、星期、人的头衔以及地址的首字母要大写。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Recognize, identify and use abbreviations with correct punctuation for the months, days of the week, titles of people, and addresses.
items.zh: 识别并使用月份、星期、人的头衔和地址的缩写，并加上正确的标点。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Identify and use end punctuation, including periods, question marks, and exclamation points.
items.zh: 识别并使用句末标点，包括句号、问号和感叹号。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use commas appropriately in greetings and closings of letters, dates, items in a series, and addresses.
items.zh: 在书信的称呼和落款、日期、一系列并列项以及地址中正确使用逗号。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Write a simple friendly letter.
items.zh: 写一封简单的友好书信。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use apostrophes to create contractions and indicate possession, i.e., cat’s meow.
items.zh: 使用撇号构成缩写和表示所有格，如 cat’s meow。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use quotation marks appropriately to designate direct speech.
items.zh: 恰当使用引号表示直接引语。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: The titles listed below are available in a variety of editions, including both adaptations for novice readers and others that lend themselves to reading aloud to children—for example, Charlotte’s Web or “How the Camel Got His Hump.” It is recommended that you provide a mixture of texts. Editions designed for beginning readers can help students practice decoding skills. Read-aloud texts, which the students may not be capable of reading on their own, can be understood when the words are read aloud and talked about with a helpful adult. Such active listening to vocabulary and syntax that go beyond the limits of grade-level readability formulas is an important part of developing an increasingly sophisticated verbal sense.
items.zh: 下面列出的书名有多种版本，既有为初学者改编的版本，也有适合给孩子朗读的版本——例如《夏洛的网》(Charlotte's Web) 或《骆驼是怎么长出驼峰的》("How the Camel Got His Hump")。建议提供多种文本的组合。为初级读者设计的版本可以帮助学生练习解码技能。朗读书籍（学生自己可能还无法阅读）在朗读者读出词语并与有帮助的成人一起讨论时是可以理解的。这种积极聆听超出年级可读性公式限制的词汇和句法的过程，是培养日益成熟的语感的重要部分。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Every culture has phrases and proverbs that make no sense when carried over literally into another culture. For many students, this section may not be needed; they will have picked up these sayings by hearing them at home and among friends. But the sayings have been one of the categories most appreciated by teachers who work with students from home cultures that differ from the standard culture of literate American English. Back to the drawing board Better late than never Cold feet Don’t cry over spilled milk. Don’t judge a book by its cover. Easier said than done Eaten out of house and home Get a taste of your own medicine. Get up on the wrong side of the bed. In hot water Note: Students will read more myths in third grade; see Language Arts Grade 3.
items.zh: 每种文化都有一些习语和谚语，直译到另一种文化中会毫无意义。对许多学生来说，这一节可能并非必需；他们会在家里和朋友之间听到这些说法而自然习得。然而，对于来自不同于标准美式英语书面文化的家庭背景的学生，这些说法一直是老师们最欣赏的类别之一。推倒重来（Back to the drawing board）；迟做总比不做好（Better late than never）；临阵退缩（Cold feet）；别为打翻的牛奶哭泣／覆水难收（Don't cry over spilled milk.）；不要以貌取人（Don't judge a book by its cover.）；说起来容易做起来难（Easier said than done）；把家吃空（Eaten out of house and home）；自食其果（Get a taste of your own medicine.）；一大早就心情不好（Get up on the wrong side of the bed.）；陷入麻烦（In hot water）注意：学生将在三年级阅读更多神话；见《语言艺术三年级》。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Teachers: In second grade, students often study aspects of the world around them: the family, the school, the community, etc. The following guidelines are meant to broaden and complement that focus. The goal of studying selected topics in World History in second grade is to foster curiosity and the beginnings of understanding about the larger world outside the student’s locality, and about varied civilizations and ways of life. This can be done through a variety of means: story, drama, art, music, discussion, and more.
items.zh: 教师：二年级时，学生常常学习周围世界的各个方面：家庭、学校、社区等。以下指南旨在拓宽和补充这一重点。二年级学习世界历史中选定主题的目标，是培养孩子的好奇心，并初步理解其所在地区之外的广阔世界，以及各种文明和生活方式。这可以通过多种方式实现：故事、戏剧、艺术、音乐、讨论等等。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Since religion is a shaping force in the story of civilization, the Core Knowledge Sequence introduces students in the early grades to major world religions, beginning with a focus on geography and major symbols and figures. The purpose is not to explore matters of theology but to provide a basic vocabulary for understanding many events and ideas in history. The goal is to familiarize, not proselytize; to be descriptive, not prescriptive. The tone should be one of respect and balance: no religion should be disparaged by implying that it is a thing of the past. To the question, “Which one is true?” an appropriate response is: “People of different faiths believe different things to be true. The best people to guide you on this right now are your parents or someone at home.”
items.zh: 由于宗教是文明故事中一股塑造性的力量，核心知识序列在低年级向学生介绍世界主要宗教，首先从地理和主要象征与人物入手。目的不是探讨神学问题，而是提供理解历史上许多事件和思想的基本词汇。目标是让学生熟悉而非传教，是描述而非规定。语气应尊重且平衡：不应暗示任何宗教是过去的事物而贬低它。对于“哪一个才是真的？”这一问题，恰当的回答是：“不同信仰的人相信不同的事物为真。眼下最能引导你的是你的父母或家里的长辈。”

items.en: Teachers: The study of American history begins in grades K-2 with a brief overview of major events and figures, from the earliest days to recent times. A more in-depth, chronological study of American history begins again in Grade 3 and continues onward. The term “American” here generally, but not always, refers to the lands that became the United States. Other topics regarding North, Central, and South America may be found in the World History and Geography sections of this Sequence.
items.zh: 教师提示：美国历史的学习从幼儿园到二年级开始，先简要概览从早期到近现代的重大事件和人物。更深入、按时间顺序的美国历史学习从三年级重新开始并继续推进。这里“美国”一词通常（但不总是）指后来成为美国的那片土地。关于北美、中美和南美的其他主题可参见本序列的世界历史与地理部分。

items.en: Through analogies to familiar settings—the family, the school, the community—discuss some basic questions regarding American government, such as: ”What is government?“ ”What are some basic functions of American government?“ (Making and enforcing laws; settling disputes; protecting rights and liberties, etc.) Only basic questions need to be addressed at this grade level. In fourth grade students will examine in more detail specific issues and institutions of American government, including, for example, the separation of powers, and the relation between state and federal government.
items.zh: 通过类比学生熟悉的环境——家庭、学校、社区——讨论有关美国政府的一些基本问题，例如：“什么是政府？”“美国政府有哪些基本职能？”（制定和执行法律；解决争端；保护权利与自由等）。在这个年级只需涉及基本问题。四年级时学生将更详细地考察美国政府的具体议题和制度，包括例如分权制衡以及州政府与联邦政府的关系。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Students will study Immigration and Urbanization in greater depth and detail in Grade 6. Second grade teachers should examine the sixth grade American History guidelines to see how these topics build in the later grade. In second grade, it is recommended that teachers use narrative, biography, and other accessible means to introduce students to the idea that many people have come to America (and continue to come here) from all around the world for many reasons: to find freedom, to seek a better life, to leave behind bad conditions in their native lands, etc. Discuss with students: What is an immigrant? Why do people leave their home countries to make a new home in America? What is it like to be a newcomer in America? What hardships have immigrants faced? What opportunities have they found?

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Through narrative, biography, and other accessible means, introduce students to the idea that while America is a country founded upon “the proposition that all men are created equal,” equality has not always been granted to all Americans. Many people, however, have dedicated themselves to the struggle to extend equal rights to all Americans. Specific figures and issues to study include:
items.zh: 通过叙事、传记及其他通俗易懂的方式，向学生介绍这样一个观念：虽然美国建立在“人人生而平等”这一主张之上，但平等并非一直惠及所有美国人。然而，许多人致力于为所有美国人争取平等权利而斗争。要学习的具体人物和议题包括：

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Note: In Grade 4, students will study, in the historical context of antebellum reform, early pioneers in the women’s movement in America, including Elizabeth Cady Stanton, Lucretia Mott, Margaret Fuller, and Sojourner Truth.
items.zh: 注意：四年级学生将在内战前改革的历史背景下，学习美国妇女运动的早期先驱，包括伊丽莎白·卡迪·斯坦顿（Elizabeth Cady Stanton）、露克丽霞·莫特（Lucretia Mott）、玛格丽特·富勒（Margaret Fuller）和索杰纳·特鲁斯（Sojourner Truth）。

items.subject: History and Geography

items.zh: 注意：学生将在初中阶段更深入、详细地学习现代美国民权运动。

items.subject: Visual Arts
items.en: Teachers: In schools, lessons on the visual arts should illustrate important elements of making and appreciating art, and emphasize important artists, works of art, and artistic concepts. When appropriate, topics in the visual arts may be linked to topics in other disciplines. The following guidelines specify a variety of artwork in different media and from various cultures in order to expose students to a wide range of art and artists. While the list is robust, it may require teachers to narrow the selection in order to adequately address the works and related skills within an academic year.
items.zh: 教师：学校的视觉艺术课程应展示艺术创作与欣赏的重要元素，并重点介绍重要艺术家、艺术作品和艺术概念。在适当的时候，视觉艺术主题可以与其他学科主题相联系。以下指导方针列举了不同媒介和不同文化的多种艺术作品，以让学生接触广泛的艺术和艺术家。这份清单内容相当丰富，教师可能需要缩小选择范围，以便在一个学年内充分讲解这些作品及相关技能。

items.subject: Visual Arts
items.en: The generally recognized elements of art include line, shape, form, space, light, texture, and color. In second grade, continue when appropriate to discuss qualities of line, shape, color, and texture that students learned about in kindergarten and first grade.
items.zh: 公认的艺术要素包括线条、形状、形体、空间、光线、质感和色彩。在二年级，在适当的时候继续讨论学生在幼儿园和一年级学过的线条、形状、色彩和质感的特征。

In discussing the following works, ask the students about their first impressions—what they notice first, and what the picture makes them think of or feel. Go on to discuss lines, shapes, colors, and textures; details not obvious at first; why they think the artist chose to depict things in a certain way, etc.

items.subject: Visual Arts
items.en: Note: Also known as the Katsura Imperial Villa or Katsura Detached Palace. Call attention to the inspiration of Asian Gardens and the shift from symmetry to asymmetry that occurred at the time in the 19th century European Architecture in the Gothic Revival (see Grade 6) The way space is organized inspired 20th century architects (see Frank Lloyd Wright in Grade 7).
items.zh: 注：它也称桂离宫御所（Katsura Imperial Villa）或桂离别宫（Katsura Detached Palace）。要引导学生留意亚洲园林带来的灵感，以及19世纪欧洲建筑在哥特复兴时期由对称转向不对称的变化（见六年级）。这种空间组织方式启发了20世纪的建筑师（见七年级的弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特）。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Teachers: In schools, lessons on music should feature activities and works that illustrate important musical concepts and terms, and should introduce important composers and works. When appropriate, topics in music may be linked to topics in other disciplines. The following guidelines focus on content, not performance skills, though many concepts are best learned through active practice (singing, clapping rhythms, playing instruments, etc.).
items.zh: 教师：学校的音乐课应包含能够体现重要音乐概念和术语的活动与作品，并应介绍重要作曲家和作品。在适当的时候，音乐主题可以与其他学科主题相联系。以下指导方针侧重内容而非表演技能，不过许多概念最好通过积极实践来学习（唱歌、拍节奏、演奏乐器等）。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Through participation, become familiar with basic elements of music (rhythm, melody, harmony, form, timbre, etc.).
items.zh: 通过参与，熟悉音乐的基本要素（节奏、旋律、和声、曲式、音色等）。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Recognize a steady beat, accents, and the downbeat; play a steady beat.
items.zh: 辨认稳定的节拍、重音和强拍；能打出稳定的节拍。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Move responsively to music (marching, walking, hopping, swaying, etc.).
items.zh: 随着音乐做出相应动作（列队行进、走、单脚跳、摇摆等）。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Recognize short and long sounds.
items.zh: 分辨短音和长音。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Discriminate between fast and slow; gradually slowing down and getting faster.
items.zh: 区分快与慢；能逐渐减速和加速。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Discriminate between differences in pitch: high and low.
items.zh: 区分音高差异：高与低。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Discriminate between loud and soft; gradually increasing and decreasing volume.
items.zh: 区分响与轻；能逐渐增强和减弱音量。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Understand that melody can move up and down.
items.zh: 理解旋律可以上行和下行。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Teachers: Mathematics has its own vocabulary and patterns of thinking. It is a discipline with its own language and conventions. Thus, while some lessons may offer occasional opportunities for linking mathematics to other disciplines, it is critically important to attend to math as math. From the earliest years, mathematics requires incremental review and steady practice: not only the diligent effort required to master basic facts and operations, but also thoughtful and varied practice that approaches problems from a variety of angles, and gives students a variety of opportunities to apply the same concept or operation in different types of situations. While it is important to work toward the development of “higher-order problem-solving skills,” it is equally important—indeed, it is prerequisite to achieving higher order skills— to have a sound grasp of basic facts, and an automatic fluency with fundamental operations.
items.zh: 教师提示：数学有其自身的词汇和思维方式，是一门拥有自己语言与规范的学科。因此，虽然有些课程偶尔会有机会将数学与其他学科联系起来，但把数学当作数学来对待至关重要。从最初几年起，数学就需要循序渐进的复习和持续不断的练习：既要努力掌握基本事实和运算，也要进行周密而多样的练习，从不同角度处理问题，并让学生有多种机会在不同类型的情境中运用同一概念或运算。虽然努力培养“高阶解题技能”很重要，但同样重要的是——事实上这是达成高阶技能的前提——牢固掌握基本事实，并对基本运算达到自动化的熟练程度。
