items.subject: Science
items.en: Teachers: Effective instruction in science requires hands-on experience and observation. In the words of the report from the National Academies of Science, A Framework for K-12 Science Education, “...children have surprisingly sophisticated ways of thinking about the world, based in part on their direct experiences with the physical environment, such as watching objects fall or collide and observing plants and animals. They also learn about the world through everyday activities, such as talking with their families, pursuing hobbies, watching television, and playing with friends. As children try to understand and influence the world around them, they develop ideas about their role in that world and how it works. In fact, the capacity of young children—from all backgrounds and socioeconomic levels—to reason in sophisticated ways is much greater than has long been assumed. Although they may lack deep knowledge and extensive experience, they often engage in a wide range of subtle and complex reasoning about the world. Thus, before they even enter school, children have developed their own ideas about the physical, biological, and social worlds and how they work. By listening to and taking these ideas seriously, educators can build on what children already know and can do.”
items.zh: 教师须知：有效的科学教学需要动手体验和观察。用美国国家科学院报告《K-12 科学教育框架》的话来说：“……孩子们以令人惊讶的复杂方式思考世界，这部分基于他们对物质环境的直接体验，比如观看物体下落或碰撞、观察动植物。他们也通过日常活动了解世界，比如与家人交谈、从事爱好、看电视、和朋友玩耍。当孩子们试图理解和影响周围的世界时，他们会形成关于自己在世界中的角色以及世界如何运作的想法。事实上，幼儿——无论来自何种背景、何种社会经济水平——进行复杂推理的能力远超长期以来的设想。尽管他们可能缺乏深入知识和丰富经验，但他们常常对世界进行广泛而细致的复杂推理。因此，甚至在入学之前，孩子们就已经对物理、生物和社会世界及其运作方式形成了自己的想法。通过倾听并认真对待这些想法，教育者可以在儿童已有知识和能力的基础上进行教学。”

items.subject: Science
items.en: Through reading aloud, observation, and activities such as describing and sorting different kinds of matter, explore the following with students:
items.zh: 通过朗读、观察以及描述和分类不同种类物质等活动，与学生一起探究以下内容：

items.subject: Science
items.en: Matter is anything that has mass and takes up space.
items.zh: 物质是任何有质量并占据空间的东西。

items.subject: Science
items.en: There are many types of matter;
items.zh: 物质有很多种；

items.subject: Science
items.en: solid, liquid, gas
items.zh: 固态、液态、气态

items.subject: Science
items.en: Matter has properties that can be measured:
items.zh: 物质具有可以测量的属性：

items.subject: Science
items.en: size, weight, volume
items.zh: 大小、重量、体积

items.subject: Science
items.en: Matter can be sorted, or classified, by properties.
items.zh: 物质可以按属性进行分类。

items.subject: Science
items.en: The state of matter depends on temperature.
items.zh: 物质的状态取决于温度。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Heating or cooling a substance can change its properties.
items.zh: 加热或冷却一种物质会改变其属性。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Water has three states: liquid, solid (ice), and gas (water vapor).
items.zh: 水有三种状态：液态、固态（冰）和气态（水蒸气）。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Some objects are made from a single type of matter.
items.zh: 有些物体由单一种类的物质构成。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Other objects are made from different types of matter being combined or placed together.
items.zh: 另一些物体由不同种类的物质组合或放在一起构成。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Through reading aloud, observation, and activities such as investigating differences in the variety of plants and animals in different environments, help students to explore the following:
items.zh: 通过朗读、观察以及考察不同环境中动植物种类差异等活动，帮助学生探究以下内容：

items.subject: Science
items.en: Plants have body parts (roots, stems, leaves) to survive and grow.
items.zh: 植物具有根、茎、叶等身体部位，以生存和生长。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Plants are living organisms and typically grow in fixed locations. Review and extend learning from Kindergarten, Needs of Plants and Animals.
items.zh: 植物是生物，通常生长在固定的位置。复习并拓展幼儿园“动植物的需求”所学内容。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Though there are many different types of plants, they have common needs (air, water, minerals, light).
items.zh: 虽然植物种类繁多，但它们有共同的需求（空气、水、矿物质、光）。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Plants are diverse in size, structure, and ecological needs.
items.zh: 植物在大小、结构和生态需求方面各不相同。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Plants live in environments to which they are suited; those environments also differ:
items.zh: 植物生长在适合它们的环境中；这些环境也各不相同：

items.subject: Science
items.en: Deciduous forests (oak trees)
items.zh: 落叶林（橡树）

items.subject: Science
items.en: Tropical forests (vines, epiphytes)
items.zh: 热带森林（藤本植物、附生植物）

items.subject: Science
items.en: Meadows and prairies (grasses)
items.zh: 草甸与草原（草本植物）

items.subject: Science
items.en: Deserts (cacti)
items.zh: 沙漠（仙人掌）

items.subject: Science
items.en: Tundra (plants of small size)
items.zh: 苔原（小型植物）

items.subject: Science
items.en: Ponds, lakes, rivers, and streams
items.zh: 池塘、湖泊、河流与小溪

items.subject: Science
items.en: Oceans are home to less than a dozen known species of plants.
items.zh: 已知的海洋植物种类不到十二种。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Many plant habitats change in cycles over time—seasons—and plants are adapted to survive during those changes.
items.zh: 许多植物的生境会随季节更替而周期性变化，植物已适应在这些变化中生存。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Adult plants and animals reproduce.
items.zh: 成年的动植物会繁殖。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Many kinds of animal parents take care of their offspring until the offspring become mature enough to care for themselves.
items.zh: 许多种类的动物父母会照顾后代，直到后代成熟到能独立照顾自己。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Animals are diverse in size, shape, and ecological needs.
items.zh: 动物在大小、形状和生态需求方面各不相同。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Animals vary in their structure:
items.zh: 动物的身体结构各不相同：

items.subject: Science
items.en: Invertebrates: without backbones (snails, insects, coral)
items.zh: 无脊椎动物：没有脊椎（蜗牛、昆虫、珊瑚）

items.subject: Science
items.en: Vertebrates: with backbones (mammals, birds, fish, reptiles, and amphibians)
items.zh: 脊椎动物：有脊椎（哺乳动物、鸟类、鱼类、爬行动物和两栖动物）

items.subject: Science
items.en: Animals live in environments to which they are suited; those environments differ:
items.zh: 动物生活在适合它们的环境中；这些环境各不相同：

items.subject: Science
items.en: Deciduous forests (squirrels, raccoons)
items.zh: 落叶林（松鼠、浣熊）

items.subject: Science
items.en: Tropical forests (moles, worms)
items.zh: 热带森林（鼹鼠、蠕虫）

items.subject: Science
items.en: Meadows and prairies (prairie dogs)
items.zh: 草甸与草原（草原土拨鼠）

items.subject: Science
items.en: Deserts (lizards, scorpions)
items.zh: 沙漠（蜥蜴、蝎子）

items.subject: Science
items.en: Tundra (arctic fox, polar bears)
items.zh: 苔原（北极狐、北极熊）

items.subject: Science
items.en: Ponds, lakes, rivers, and streams (fish, oysters)
items.zh: 池塘、湖泊、河流与小溪（鱼类、牡蛎）

items.subject: Science
items.en: Oceans (There are numerous species of animals in the world’s oceans such as sea stars and whales.)
items.zh: 海洋（世界海洋中有众多动物物种，如海星和鲸。）

items.subject: Science
items.en: Many plants and animals live in a specific habitat.
items.zh: 许多动植物生活在特定的栖息地。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Organisms that share a given space affect each other.
items.zh: 生活在同一空间中的生物会相互影响。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Animals depend on plants for food and shelter.
items.zh: 动物依靠植物获取食物和栖息场所。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Plants depend on animals (for example, pollination, seed dispersal).
items.zh: 植物依靠动物（例如传粉、种子传播）。

items.subject: Science
items.en: There are also groups of living things that are neither plants nor animals (fungi, algae, bacteria).
items.zh: 还有一些生物既不是植物也不是动物（真菌、藻类、细菌）。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Through reading aloud, observation, and activities such as developing models of the shapes and kinds of land and water in an area, help students to explore the following:
items.zh: 通过朗读、观察以及制作某一地区陆地和水域形状与种类的模型等活动，帮助学生探究以下内容：

items.subject: Science
items.en: Earth’s surface has various landforms such as:
items.zh: 地球表面有多种地貌，例如：

items.subject: Science
items.en: plains, hills, plateaus, mountains, valleys, canyons, buttes, basins, cliffs, beaches, dunes, underwater mountains and valleys
items.zh: 平原、丘陵、高原、山脉、山谷、峡谷、孤丘、盆地、悬崖、海滩、沙丘、水下山脉与山谷。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Maps are models of Earth’s surface.
items.zh: 地图是地球表面的模型。

items.subject: Science
items.en: A globe is a spherical map of Earth that helps to visualize locations of continents, the poles, and the equator.
items.zh: 地球仪是地球的球形地图，有助于直观了解各大洲、两极和赤道的位置。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Most of Earth’s surface is covered with water.
items.zh: 地球表面大部分被水覆盖。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Most of Earth’s water is liquid; some is solid (ice); some is fresh water (rivers, lakes, groundwater, glaciers); most is salt water (ocean).
items.zh: 地球上的水大部分是液态；有些是固态（冰）；有些是淡水（河流、湖泊、地下水、冰川）；大部分是咸水（海洋）。

items.subject: Science
items.topic: Effects of Wind and Water on Land
items.en: Wind and water can change the shape of land.
items.zh: 风和水可以改变土地的形状。

items.subject: Science
items.topic: Effects of Wind and Water on Land
items.en: Wind and water produce many distinctive landforms:
items.zh: 风和水造就许多独特的地貌：

items.subject: Science
items.topic: Effects of Wind and Water on Land
items.en: dunes, beaches, cliffs, hoodoos, arches, oxbows and meanders, canyons, mesas
items.zh: 沙丘、海滩、悬崖、石柱（hoodoos）、拱门、牛轭湖与曲流、峡谷、方山

items.subject: Science
items.topic: Effects of Wind and Water on Land
items.en: Wind and water cause relatively slow changes to Earth’s crust.
items.zh: 风和水使地壳发生较为缓慢的变化。

items.subject: Science
items.topic: Effects of Wind and Water on Land
items.en: Scientists and engineers work together to design solutions that slow or prevent unwanted weathering and erosion.
items.zh: 科学家与工程师合作设计解决方案，减缓或防止不需要的风化和侵蚀。

items.subject: Science
items.en: The emphasis in Grade 2 should be on observation, description, and explanation of real world applications of electricity and magnetism; technical explanations of electromagnetism should be taken up in later grades; see Grades 4, 5, 6, and 8 for an increasingly detailed study of energy, electricity, and magnetism. Students should also engage with the engineering design process and its relationship to scientific knowledge. Contextualized design challenges should be embedded across multiple topics of study such as this domain, including in the later grades; for example, see Grades 3, 4, and 5 for an increasingly detailed study of engineering design. At this grade level, explore the following with students:
items.zh: 二年级的重点应放在观察、描述和解释电与磁在现实世界中的应用；电磁学的机理性解释应留到以后年级学习；关于能量、电和磁逐步深入的学习见四、五、六和八年级。学生还应参与工程设计过程，并理解其与科学知识的关系。情境化的设计挑战应融入多个学习主题之中，包括本主题，并延续到以后的年级；例如，工程设计逐步深入的学习见三、四、五年级。在本年级，与学生一起探究以下内容：

items.subject: Science
items.en: Electricity is a form of energy; it can cause changes.
items.zh: 电是能量的一种形式；电可以引起变化。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Matter contains two types of electrical charges: positive and negative.
items.zh: 物质含有两种电荷：正电荷和负电荷。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Types of electricity:
items.zh: 电的种类：

items.subject: Science
items.en: Static electricity: electric charges on the surface of things
items.zh: 静电：物体表面的电荷

items.subject: Science
items.en: Current electricity: electrical charges flowing in a circuit through wires and other devices
items.zh: 电流：电荷在电路中通过导线和其他装置流动

items.subject: Science
items.en: Magnet: a metal object that can exert a force through a distance on certain types of metal objects.
items.zh: 磁铁：一种金属物体，能对某些种类的金属物体产生远距离作用力。

items.subject: Science
items.en: A magnet has two poles: north and south.
items.zh: 磁铁有两个磁极：北极和南极。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Similar magnetic poles attract each other; opposite magnetic poles repel each other.
items.zh: 相同的磁极相互吸引；相反的磁极相互排斥。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Electricity and magnetism are used in many useful devices.
items.zh: 电和磁被应用于许多有用的装置中。

items.subject: Science
items.en: All useful devices are developed through engineering design, a process which includes:
items.zh: 所有有用的装置都通过工程设计开发，这一过程包括：

items.subject: Science
items.en: Defining a problem
items.zh: 明确问题

items.subject: Science
items.en: Developing possible solutions
items.zh: 提出可能的解决方案

items.subject: Science
items.en: Refining (optimizing) the design solution
items.zh: 改进（优化）设计方案

items.subject: Science
items.en: Scientists and engineering designers often work together in teams to solve problems and design effective solutions.
items.zh: 科学家与工程设计师常常在团队中合作，解决问题并设计有效的方案。

items.subject: Science
items.topic: Safe Use of Electricity and Magnetism
items.en: Electricity is potentially dangerous. Collaborate with your fourth grade colleagues regarding future expectations and definitions of energy, transfer, and the transformation of energy (Grade 4, Energy Transfer and Transformation).
items.zh: 电有潜在危险。请与四年级同事协作，商定后续对能量、能量传递与能量转化的要求和定义（四年级“能量传递与转化”）。

items.subject: Science
items.topic: Safe Use of Electricity and Magnetism
items.en: Safety rules for electricity include:
items.zh: 用电安全规则包括：

items.subject: Science
items.topic: Safe Use of Electricity and Magnetism
items.en: never put your finger or anything metallic in an electrical outlet.
items.zh: 绝不要把手指或任何金属物插入电源插座。

items.subject: Science
items.topic: Safe Use of Electricity and Magnetism
items.en: never touch a switch or electrical appliance when your hand or body is wet.
items.zh: 手或身体潮湿时，绝不要触摸开关或电器。

items.subject: Science
items.topic: Safe Use of Electricity and Magnetism
items.en: never put your finger in a lamp socket.
items.zh: 绝不要把手指伸进灯座。

items.subject: Science
items.topic: The Human Body: Cells and Digestion
items.en: All living things are made up of cells too small to be seen without a microscope.
items.zh: 所有生物都由细胞构成，细胞小到必须借助显微镜才能看见。

items.subject: Science
items.topic: The Human Body: Cells and Digestion
items.en: The human body is made up of different types of cells including: stem, bone, blood, muscle, fat, skin, nerve.
items.zh: 人体由多种类型的细胞构成，包括：干细胞、骨细胞、血细胞、肌细胞、脂肪细胞、皮肤细胞、神经细胞。

items.subject: Science
items.topic: The Human Body: Cells and Digestion
items.en: Cells combine to form tissues.
items.zh: 细胞结合形成组织。

items.subject: Science
items.topic: The Human Body: Cells and Digestion
items.en: Tissues combine to form organs.
items.zh: 组织结合形成器官。

items.subject: Science
items.topic: The Human Body: Cells and Digestion
items.en: Organs combine to form organ systems.
items.zh: 器官结合形成器官系统。

items.subject: Science
items.topic: The Human Body: Cells and Digestion
items.en: The human body has complex systems, including the digestive and excretory systems.
items.zh: 人体有复杂的系统，包括消化系统和排泄系统。

items.subject: Science
items.topic: The Human Body: Cells and Digestion
items.en: The digestive system includes body parts that take in and process food (salivary glands, taste buds, teeth, esophagus, stomach, liver, small intestine, large intestine).
items.zh: 消化系统包括摄入和处理食物的身体部位（唾液腺、味蕾、牙齿、食道、胃、肝、小肠、大肠）。

items.subject: Science
items.topic: The Human Body: Cells and Digestion
items.en: The excretory system includes those body parts that eliminate some kinds of wastes (kidneys, bladder, urethra).
items.zh: 排泄系统包括排出某些废物的身体部位（肾、膀胱、尿道）。

items.subject: Science
items.en: A healthy lifestyle involves performing certain behaviors and avoiding other behaviors.
items.zh: 健康的生活方式包括采取某些行为并避免另一些行为。

items.subject: Science
items.en: The body needs specific foods, vitamins, and minerals in certain quantities to function properly.
items.zh: 身体需要特定数量的某些食物、维生素和矿物质才能正常运转。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Organizations make recommendations about what nutrients people need to stay healthy.
items.zh: 一些机构会就人们保持健康所需的营养素提出建议。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Vaccinations can help protect health.
items.zh: 接种疫苗有助于保护健康。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Through reading aloud and activities, explore with students the stories and accomplishments of these scientists and engineers. This list of science biographies is by no means exhaustive. Other individuals can be incorporated into learning during a corresponding topic of study for this grade level, and should include:
items.zh: 通过朗读和活动，与学生一起探究这些科学家和工程师的故事与成就。这份科学家传记清单并不详尽。在学习本年级相应主题时，还可以加入其他人物，应包括：

items.subject: Science
items.en: Dmitri Mendeleev—developed the periodic table
items.zh: 德米特里·门捷列夫——编制了元素周期表

items.subject: Science
items.en: John James Audubon—artist specializing in American birds
items.zh: 约翰·詹姆斯·奥杜邦——专画美洲鸟类的艺术家

items.subject: Science
items.en: Marie Tharp—pioneer in mapping the ocean floor
items.zh: 玛丽·萨普——绘制海底地图的先驱

items.subject: Science
items.en: Louis Pasteur—explored bacteria and the safety of foods Emphasis at this grade is to introduce the hierarchy of structures in the body. Review and extend learning from Kindergarten and Grade 1, Our Five Senses and Human Body Systems
items.zh: 路易斯·巴斯德——研究细菌与食品安全。本年级的重点是介绍身体的结构层次。复习并拓展幼儿园和一年级“我们的五种感官”与“人体系统”所学内容。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Maintain attention and actively participate in discussions about a variety of topics, ideas, and texts in a variety of settings including partners, small and large groups, and teacher-led groups.
items.zh: 在同伴、小组、大组和教师主导的多种情境中，都能保持专注并积极参与关于各种话题、想法和文本的讨论。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Prepare for discussions in advance, including reading about the topic and organizing information for the discussion. Draw on preparations during the discussion.
items.zh: 提前为讨论做准备，包括阅读相关话题材料并整理讨论所需信息；讨论时运用这些准备成果。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use agreed-upon rules for group discussions, e.g., look at and listen attentively to the speaker, raise hand to speak, take turns, keep discussions on-topic, and say “excuse me” or “please.”
items.zh: 遵守小组讨论的共同规则，例如：注视并认真倾听发言者、举手发言、轮流发言、紧扣讨论主题，并说“打扰一下”或“请”。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Ask relevant questions to clarify conversations and ideas and to build upon remarks made by others.
items.zh: 提出相关问题，以澄清谈话和想法，并在他人发言的基础上进一步展开。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Participate in a discussion by explaining their own ideas relevant to the topic or conversation.
items.zh: 通过解释自己与话题或谈话相关的想法来参与讨论。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Understand and use narrative language to describe main ideas and supporting details in a text read aloud, such as people, places, things, locations, events, and actions.
items.zh: 理解并运用叙述性语言，描述朗读文本中的主要观点和支撑细节，如人物、地点、事物、场所、事件和动作。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Understand and use narrative language to describe texts read aloud or presented in different formats, such as videos, recordings, pictures, graphs, and charts.
items.zh: 理解并运用叙述性语言，描述以不同形式呈现或朗读的文本，如视频、录音、图片、曲线图和图表。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Ask and answer questions about information presented orally, providing appropriate on-topic elaboration and detail.
items.zh: 就口头呈现的信息提问并回答，给出切题的适当阐述和细节。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Give a presentation about a topic or text, tell a story, or orally relate a personal experience including relevant details and facts.
items.zh: 就某个话题或文本做展示、讲故事，或口头讲述个人经历，并包含相关细节和事实。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Make audio recordings of poems and stories, reading fluently and at an understandable volume and pace.
items.zh: 录制诗歌和故事的音频，朗读流畅，音量和语速便于理解。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Add visual displays to enhance certain facts and details in oral readings or presentations.
items.zh: 添加视觉展示材料，以强化口头朗读或展示中的某些事实和细节。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Speak in complete sentences, providing appropriate details and clarification for multiple tasks and situations.
items.zh: 用完整句子说话，在多种任务和场合中提供适当的细节和说明。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Identify and understand the meaning of common prefixes and suffixes.
items.zh: 识别并理解常见前缀和后缀的含义。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Decode words with common Latin suffixes.
items.zh: 拼读带常见拉丁语后缀的单词。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Decode and read multisyllable words at grade level.
items.zh: 拼读并朗读符合年级水平的多音节词。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Read irregularly spelled words at grade level.
items.zh: 朗读符合年级水平的拼写不规则词。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Note: Students should read outside of school at least 20 minutes daily.
items.zh: 注：学生每天应在课外至少阅读20分钟。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Read grade-level text fluently and accurately to support comprehension.
items.zh: 流利、准确地朗读年级水平的文本，以帮助理解。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Understand the purpose for reading a particular text.
items.zh: 理解阅读某一特定文本的目的。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Orally read and reread grade-level poetry and prose to develop accuracy, appropriate pacing, and expression.
items.zh: 口头朗读并反复朗读年级水平的诗歌和散文，以培养准确性、恰当的节奏和表达力。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Self-correct and develop understanding by rereading as necessary.
items.zh: 必要时通过重读进行自我纠正并加深理解。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Independently read and comprehend longer works of fiction (chapter books, stories, plays, and poems) and nonfiction (science, history, and social studies) appropriately written for third grade or beyond.
items.zh: 独立阅读并理解适合三年级及以上水平的较长虚构作品（章节书、故事、戏剧和诗歌）和非虚构作品（科学、历史和社会研究）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Ask and pose plausible answers to how, why, and what-if questions in interpreting fiction and nonfiction texts read independently.
items.zh: 在解读独立阅读的虚构与非虚构文本时，就“如何”“为什么”“假如……会怎样”等问题提问并给出合理答案。
items.section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
items.section_zh: 把握具体细节与关键观点

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Orally summarize main points from fiction and nonfiction readings.
items.zh: 口头总结虚构和非虚构阅读材料的主要观点。
items.section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
items.section_zh: 把握具体细节与关键观点

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Make inferences, draw conclusions, and trace the development of themes.
items.zh: 进行推断、得出结论，并梳理主题的发展脉络。
items.section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
items.section_zh: 把握具体细节与关键观点

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Support inferences, conclusions, and themes with evidence from the text.
items.zh: 用文本中的证据支持推断、结论和主题。
items.section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
items.section_zh: 把握具体细节与关键观点

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Understand how ideas develop in a text and the interactions between ideas, people, places, and events, and why they are important.
items.zh: 理解文本中观点如何展开，以及观点、人物、地点和事件之间的相互作用及其重要性。
items.section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
items.section_zh: 把握具体细节与关键观点

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Point to specific words or passages that are causing difficulties in comprehension.
items.zh: 指出造成理解困难的具体词语或段落。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Determine the meaning of words and phrases from a text that has been read independently, including denotative, connotative, and figurative meanings.
items.zh: 确定独立阅读文本中词语和短语的含义，包括字面意义、内涵意义和比喻意义。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Identify and use text features to locate and understand information (e.g., table of contents, index, chapters, scenes, stanzas, sidebars, captions, and key words).
items.zh: 识别并利用文本特征来查找和理解信息（如目录、索引、章节、场景、诗节、边栏、图注和关键词）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Determine their own point of view about a text and understand how it differs from that of the author, narrator, or characters in a text.
items.zh: 确定自己对文本的观点，并理解它与作者、叙述者或书中人物的观点有何不同。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Prior to reading, identify what they know and have learned that may be related to the specific story or topic to be read.
items.zh: 阅读前，找出自己已知的、可能与所读故事或话题相关的知识和经验。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Make predictions prior to and while reading, based on the title, pictures, and/or text read thus far and then compare the actual outcomes to predictions.
items.zh: 根据标题、图片和/或已读到的文本，在阅读前和阅读中做出预测，然后把实际结果与预测进行比较。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use images accompanying the written text (e.g., illustrations, photographs, charts, and maps) to check and support understanding.
items.zh: 利用伴随文字的图片（如插图、照片、图表和地图）来检验和辅助理解。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Answer questions that require making interpretations, making judgments, or giving opinions about what is read independently.
items.zh: 回答需要对独立阅读内容进行解读、判断或发表看法的问题。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Interpret information that is read independently and then ask questions to clarify this information.
items.zh: 解读独立阅读的信息，然后提问以澄清这些信息。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Identify the important themes or key ideas in a text.
items.zh: 找出文本中的重要主题或关键观点。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Compare and contrast themes or key ideas across texts.
items.zh: 比较和对比不同文本中的主题或关键观点。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Retell a story, using narrative language to describe characters, setting(s), and the plot of the story in proper sequence.
items.zh: 复述故事，用叙述性语言按正确顺序描述人物、场景和故事情节。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Identify the moral or lesson of a fable, folktale, or myth and identify the components that build it, including details such as the title, setting, characters, and how the story plays out.
items.zh: 找出寓言、民间故事或神话的寓意或教训，并识别构成它的要素，包括标题、背景、人物以及故事如何展开等细节。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Describe characters in increasing depth by referring to dialogue and/or their actions in the story.
items.zh: 借助故事中的对话和/或人物行为，逐步深入地描述人物。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Explain how characters’ actions, words, and motivations affect the plot of a story.
items.zh: 解释人物的行为、言语和动机如何影响故事情节。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Demonstrate understanding of literary language (e.g., author, illustrator, characters, setting, plot, dialogue, personification, simile, and metaphor) and use some of these terms when discussing fiction, drama, or poetry.
items.zh: 展示对文学语言的理解（如作者、插画者、人物、背景、情节、对话、拟人、明喻和隐喻），并在讨论虚构作品、戏剧或诗歌时使用其中一些术语。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Distinguish between literal and figurative language and be able to explain the meaning of figurative language in a text.
items.zh: 区分字面语言和修辞性语言，并能解释文本中修辞性语言的含义。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Distinguish between poems, plays, and stories, including the components of each (e.g., stanzas, scenes and acts, and chapters) and how the components affect the whole.
items.zh: 区分诗歌、戏剧和故事，包括各自的组成部分（如诗节、场景与幕、章节），以及这些组成部分如何影响整体。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Identify the point(s) of view of the narrator(s) and characters in a text; distinguish their own opinion or point of view from that of the narrator or characters.
items.zh: 识别文本中叙述者和人物的视角；区分自己的观点与叙述者或人物的观点。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Understand and explain how illustrations impact stories by showing aspects of a character or setting and creating a specific mood.
items.zh: 理解并解释插图如何通过展示人物或场景的某些方面、营造特定氛围来影响故事。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Identify and describe the theme, setting, and plot of a story; compare the themes, settings, and plots of stories written by the same author (as in a series).
items.zh: 识别并描述故事的主题、背景和情节；比较同一作者所写故事（如系列作品）的主题、背景和情节。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Answer questions about the details of a nonfiction text, indicating which part of the text provides the information needed to answer specific questions.
items.zh: 回答关于非虚构文本细节的问题，并指出文本的哪一部分提供了回答特定问题所需的信息。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Locate the main ideas in a text and distinguish them from details. Explain how details support big ideas.
items.zh: 找出文本中的主要观点并将其与细节区分开；解释细节如何支撑重要观点。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Identify the structure of a text, section of text, paragraph, or sentence (e.g., comparison, cause/effect, problem/solution, compare/contrast, sequence, or main idea and details) and describe how it connects and communicates ideas in the text.
items.zh: 识别文本、文本部分、段落或句子的结构（如比较、因果、问题/解决、对比、顺序或主旨与细节），并描述它如何连接和传达文本中的观点。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Understand how historical events, scientific ideas, or steps in a procedure are related in a text and use language pertaining to sequence or cause/effect to explain how or why they happened.
items.zh: 理解历史事件、科学观点或操作步骤在文本中如何关联，并使用表示顺序或因果的语言解释它们如何或为何发生。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Identify and determine the meaning of Tier 2 academic vocabulary and Tier 3 domain specific vocabulary in informational text.
items.zh: 识别并确定信息类文本中“第二层”学术词汇和“第三层”学科专用词汇的含义。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Locate relevant information in a print or digital text using text features and search tools such as key words, sidebars, and hyperlinks.
items.zh: 利用文本特征和搜索工具（如关键词、边栏和超链接），在纸质或数字文本中定位相关信息。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Understand the author’s point of view or opinion about a nonfiction subject and distinguish it from their own.
items.zh: 理解作者对非虚构主题的观点或看法，并将其与自己的观点区分开。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use both words and images (e.g., photos, maps, and diagrams) in an informational text to answer where, when, why, and how questions relevant to the text.
items.zh: 利用信息类文本中的文字和图像（如照片、地图和示意图），回答与文本相关的“在哪里”“何时”“为什么”和“如何”的问题。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Compare and contrast the information in nonfiction texts on similar subjects.
items.zh: 比较和对比关于相似主题的非虚构文本中的信息。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
items.en: Write routinely, completing both short and long assignments focused on a range of different tasks, purposes, and audiences.
items.zh: 坚持经常写作，完成围绕各种任务、目的和读者的长短作业。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
items.en: Produce a variety of types of writing—such as stories, reports, poems, letters, descriptions, and arguments—and make reasonable judgments about what to include in their own written works based on the purpose and type of composition.
items.zh: 写出多种类型的作品——如故事、报告、诗歌、书信、描写和议论文——并根据写作目的和文体，合理判断自己的作品中应包含哪些内容。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
items.en: Know how to use established conventions when writing a friendly letter: heading, salutation (greeting), closing, and signature.
items.zh: 知道写友好书信时的既定格式：信头、称呼（问候语）、结尾敬语和署名。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
items.en: Organize material in paragraphs and understand
items.zh: 把材料组织成段落，并理解

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
items.en: how to use a topic sentence.
items.zh: 如何使用主题句。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
items.en: how to develop a paragraph with examples and details.
items.zh: 如何用实例和细节展开段落。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
items.en: that each new paragraph is indented.
items.zh: 每个新段落都要缩进。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
items.en: In some writings, proceed with guidance through a process of gathering information, organizing thoughts, composing a draft, revising to clarify and refine their meaning, and proofreading with attention to spelling, mechanics, and presentation of a final draft.
items.zh: 在某些写作中，在指导下完成如下过程：收集信息、整理思路、起草初稿、修改以澄清并完善意思，以及校订终稿并注意拼写、书写规范和呈现效果。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
items.en: Use keyboards, tablets, and other technologies to produce and publish writing as well as to collaborate and communicate with others.
items.zh: 使用键盘、平板电脑和其他技术来创作和发布作品，并与他人协作和交流。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Conduct short research projects to demonstrate knowledge gathered and learned about a topic.
items.zh: 开展小型研究项目，展示围绕某一主题收集和学到的知识。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Gather information from personal experiences as well as from print and digital sources (e.g., a children’s encyclopedia, approved online sources, videos, and recordings).
items.zh: 从个人经历以及纸质和数字资源（如儿童百科全书、经批准的在线资源、视频和录音）中收集信息。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Take notes from sources.
items.zh: 从资料来源中做笔记。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Organize information from research notes into categories provided by the teacher.
items.zh: 把研究笔记中的信息按老师提供的类别进行整理。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Produce narrative pieces that reflect real-life or imagined experiences
items.zh: 写出反映真实生活或想象经历的叙事作品

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Introduce a narrator and characters and develop them through dialogue and exposition, including actions, thoughts, feelings, and reactions to events in the plot.
items.zh: 引入叙述者和人物，并通过对话和说明展开刻画，包括动作、想法、感受以及对情节中事件的反应。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Organize a logical sequence of plot events, using time-order words to indicate event order.
items.zh: 按逻辑顺序组织情节事件，并用表示时间顺序的词标明事件先后。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Provide a beginning that introduces the story, a middle that develops story events, and an ending that gives a sense of closure.
items.zh: 写出引入故事的开头、展开故事事件的中段，以及带来完整收束感的结尾。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Write a short report that clearly presents ideas and information in their own words.
items.zh: 写一篇简短的报告，用自己的话清楚地呈现观点和资料。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Introduce a topic with information organized in related sections or paragraphs and developed with facts, definitions, and details.
items.zh: 引入一个主题，把信息组织在相关的部分或段落中，并用事实、定义和细节加以展开。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Include visual elements such as photos, drawings, or diagrams to help explain or present ideas or information when appropriate.
items.zh: 在适当处加入照片、绘图或图表等视觉元素，以帮助解释或呈现观点和信息。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use linking words to connect ideas (e.g., also, another, and, more, but, however, therefore, in addition).
items.zh: 使用连接词连接观点（如 also、another、and、more、but、however、therefore、in addition）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Write a conclusion that wraps up ideas in the text.
items.zh: 写出总结全文观点的结尾。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Introduce an opinion and support it with reasons or evidence.
items.zh: 提出一个观点，并用理由或证据加以支持。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use linking words to connect their opinion with reasons (e.g., another, more, but, also, however, therefore, in addition).
items.zh: 使用连接词把观点与理由连接起来（如 another、more、but、also、however、therefore、in addition）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Write a conclusion that wraps up the argument.
items.zh: 写出总结论证的结尾。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use knowledge of language conventions when reading, writing, speaking, and listening.
items.zh: 在阅读、写作、口语和倾听中运用语言规范知识。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Identify differences between written and spoken English.
items.zh: 识别书面英语与口语英语之间的差异。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Apply word choices to create meaning and effect.
items.zh: 运用选词来创造意义与效果。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Spell most words correctly or with a highly probable spelling.
items.zh: 大多数单词拼写正确，或拼出极有可能正确的形式。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Apply current code knowledge to spelling.
items.zh: 把当前学到的拼读规则知识运用于拼写。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Spell most grade-level high-frequency words correctly.
items.zh: 正确拼写大多数年级高频词。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Spell words correctly when adding plurals, suffixes, and other known endings.
items.zh: 在添加复数、后缀和其他已知词尾时正确拼写单词。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use knowledge of word patterns, word families, word parts, and ending rules to spell correctly.
items.zh: 利用词形模式、词族、词的组成部分和词尾规则来正确拼写。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use dictionaries or glossaries—print and digital—to check and correct spellings about which they are uncertain.
items.zh: 使用纸质或电子词典、词汇表，检查并改正不确定的拼写。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Understand what a complete sentence is, and
items.zh: 理解什么是完整句，并

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: identify subject and predicate in single-clause sentences.
items.zh: 在只含一个分句的句子中识别主语和谓语。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: distinguish complete sentences from fragments.
items.zh: 区分完整句与残句（片段）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Identify and use different sentence types:
items.zh: 识别并使用不同的句型：

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: simple (contains one subject and one predicate)
items.zh: 简单句（含一个主语和一个谓语）

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: compound (contains more than one subject or predicate)
items.zh: 并列句（含不止一个主语或谓语）

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: complex (contains a subordinate clause)
items.zh: 复杂句（含一个从句）

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Correctly use coordinating and subordinating conjunctions in sentences.
items.zh: 在句子中正确使用并列连词和从属连词。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Know the following parts of speech and how they are used:
items.zh: 了解以下词类及其用法：

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: nouns (concrete and abstract; regular and irregular plural)
items.zh: 名词（具体名词与抽象名词；规则复数与不规则复数）

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: pronouns (singular and plural)
items.zh: 代词（单数与复数）

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: verbs (action verbs and auxiliary or helping verbs; regular and irregular verbs; verb tenses)
items.zh: 动词（实义动词与助动词；规则动词与不规则动词；动词时态）

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: adjectives (including articles: a before a consonant, an before a vowel, and the)
items.zh: 形容词（包括冠词：辅音前用 a，元音前用 an，以及定冠词 the）

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: adverbs
items.zh: 副词

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Understand and use correct subject-verb agreement.
items.zh: 理解并正确使用主谓一致。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Understand and use correct pronoun-antecedent agreement.
items.zh: 理解并正确使用代词与其先行词的一致关系。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Correctly form and use comparative and superlative adjectives and adverbs.
items.zh: 正确构成并使用形容词和副词的比较级与最高级。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use capital letters correctly, including at the beginning of sentences, proper nouns, and words in titles.
items.zh: 正确使用大写字母，包括句首、专有名词以及标题中的主要单词。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Know how to use the following punctuation:
items.zh: 掌握以下标点符号的用法：

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: comma: between city and state in an address; in dialogue

items.en: Use context clues to figure out the meaning of words and phrases in a sentence.

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Know what prefixes and suffixes are and how the following affect word meaning:
items.zh: 了解前缀和后缀是什么，以及它们如何影响词义：

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Prefixes:
items.zh: 前缀：
details: re– meaning “again” (as in reuse, refill)
pre– meaning “before” (as in preview)
pro– meaning “for” or “forward” (as in propel)
mis– meaning “incorrectly” (as in misplaced)
un– meaning “not” (as in unfriendly)
dis–, non– meaning “not” (as in dishonest, nonsense)
un–, dis– meaning “opposite of” (as in untie, disappear)
anti– meaning “against” (as in antiviral)
uni– meaning “one” (as in universe)
bi– meaning “two” (as in bicycle)
tri– meaning “three” (as in triangle)
multi– meaning “many” (as in multiple)
mid– meaning “middle” (as in midsection)

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Suffixes:
items.zh: 后缀：
details: –er and –or meaning “someone who” (as in singer, actor)
–ful meaning “having” or “full of” (as in careful)
–less meaning “without” (as in careless)
–able, –ible meaning “able to” (as in breakable, visible)

–ly meaning “in the manner of” (as in quickly) Note: Review and reinforce from Grade 2: singular and plural nouns; making words plural with /s/ or /es/; irregular plurals; correct usage of irregular verbs (be, have, do, go, come, etc.); regular past tense with -ed and past tense of irregular verbs.

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Note: Review from Grade 2: capital letters for the first word of a sentence; proper nouns; the pronoun I; holidays and months and days of the week; names of countries, cities, states; main words in titles; initials.
items.zh: 注意：复习二年级内容：句子首字母大写；专有名词；代词 I；节假日、月份和星期几；国家、城市、州的名称；标题中的主要单词；姓名首字母缩写。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Note: Teach only words that can be clearly analyzed into prefix and base word; for example, do not teach “discover” or “display” as prefixed words.
items.zh: 注意：只教能够清楚拆分为前缀和词根的单词；例如，不要把 discover（发现）或 display（展示）当作带前缀的词来教。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Figure out the meaning of a new word based on the meaning of a known word with the same root (e.g., vision, visible, visualize).
items.zh: 根据词根相同的已知词的含义推断新词的意思（例如 vision 视力、visible 可见的、visualize 想象）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use a dictionary or glossary to answer questions regarding meaning and usage of unfamiliar words.
items.zh: 使用词典或词汇表来回答有关生词含义和用法的问题。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Differentiate between literal and figurative word choices, as in the phrase “hold your head up high.”
items.zh: 区分词语的字面含义与比喻含义，如短语 hold your head up high（昂首挺胸）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Make connections between words and real-world examples (e.g., describe something enjoyable; give an example of a disappointment).
items.zh: 在词语和真实世界的事例之间建立联系（例如描述令人愉快的事物；举出令人失望的例子）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Distinguish shades and degrees of meaning in related words (e.g. happy, pleased, overjoyed).
items.zh: 区分相关词语之间意义的细微差别和程度差异（如 happy 开心、pleased 满意、overjoyed 欣喜若狂）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Acquire grade-level academic words (e.g., compare, infer, describe).
items.zh: 掌握本年级的学术词汇（如 compare 比较、infer 推断、describe 描述）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Acquire grade-level words related to specific domains or subject areas (e.g., gravity, atmosphere, environment).
items.zh: 掌握与本年级特定领域或学科相关的词汇（如 gravity 重力、atmosphere 大气、environment 环境）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Understand and use words that signal time and spatial relationships (e.g., later, earlier that day, after breakfast yesterday.)
items.zh: 理解并使用表示时间和空间关系的词语（如 later 稍后、earlier that day 当天早些时候、after breakfast yesterday 昨天早饭后）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: The poems listed here constitute a selected core of poetry for this grade. You are encouraged to expose students to more poetry, old and new, and to have students write their own poems. To bring students into the spirit of poetry, read it aloud and encourage them to read it aloud so they can experience the music in the words. At this grade, poetry should be a source of delight; technical analysis should be delayed until later grades.
items.zh: 此处列出的诗歌构成本年级精选的核心诗篇。鼓励学生接触更多诗歌，无论古今，并让学生自己写诗。为带领学生进入诗歌的意境，请大声朗读，并鼓励学生也大声朗读，让他们体会文字中的韵律之美。在本年级，诗歌应当成为快乐的源泉；技巧性的分析应留到以后的年级再进行。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Every culture has phrases and proverbs that make no sense when carried over literally into another culture. For many students, this section may not be needed; they will have picked up these sayings by hearing them at home and among friends. But the sayings have been one of the categories most appreciated by teachers who work with students from home cultures that differ from the standard culture of literate American English. Actions speak louder than words. His bark is worse than his bite. Beat around the bush Beggars can’t be choosers. Clean bill of health Cold shoulder A feather in your cap Last straw Let bygones be bygones. One rotten apple spoils the whole barrel. On its last legs Rule the roost The show must go on. Touch and go When in Rome do as the Romans do. Rome wasn’t built in a day. See also World History Grade 3: Vikings.
items.zh: 每种文化都有一些短语和谚语，一旦逐字直译到另一种文化中就会失去意义。对许多学生来说，这一节可能并非必需；他们在家里和朋友之间听多了，自然就学会了这些说法。不过，对于那些面对的家庭文化与美国标准书面英语文化不同的学生的教师来说，这类谚语一直是最受好评的内容之一。Actions speak louder than words（行动胜于空谈）。His bark is worse than his bite（嘴硬心软）。Beat around the bush（拐弯抹角）。Beggars can't be choosers（乞讨者不能挑三拣四）。Clean bill of health（健康证明）。Cold shoulder（冷遇）。A feather in your cap（值得骄傲的成就）。Last straw（最后一根稻草）。Let bygones be bygones（既往不咎）。One rotten apple spoils the whole barrel（一颗老鼠屎坏了一锅粥）。On its last legs（行将就木）。Rule the roost（称王称霸）。The show must go on（演出必须继续）。Touch and go（一触即发）。When in Rome do as the Romans do（入乡随俗）。Rome wasn't built in a day（罗马不是一天建成的）。另见世界历史三年级：维京人。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Teachers: The study of geography embraces many topics throughout the Core Knowledge Sequence, including topics in history and science. Geographic knowledge includes a spatial sense of the world, an awareness of the physical processes that shape life, a sense of the interactions between humans and their environment, an understanding of the relations between place and culture, and an awareness of the characteristics of specific regions and cultures. It is important that students learn about the people who shaped our world, as well as those who continue to do so. Thus, it is recommended that students read biographies. Reading stories about the individuals listed in the Sequence, and others, allows students to draw from a broader perspective.
items.zh: 教师：地理学贯穿核心知识序列中的许多主题，包括历史和科学主题。地理知识包括对世界的空间感、对塑造生活的自然过程的认识、对人类与环境相互作用的理解、对地方与文化关系的理解，以及对特定地区和文化特征的认识。让学生了解塑造我们世界的人以及仍在塑造世界的人是很重要的。因此，建议让学生阅读传记。阅读关于序列中所列人物及其他人物的故事，能让学生从更广阔的视角出发。

items.en: Teachers: In Grade 3, students begin a more detailed and in-depth chronological investigation of topics, some of which have been introduced in grades K–2. Specific topics include: the early exploration of North America; ways of life of specific Native American peoples; life in colonial America before the Revolution. Use of timelines is encouraged. The following guidelines are meant to complement any locally required studies of the family, community, or region. Note that in fifth grade the American Geography requirements include “fifty states and capitals”; teachers in grades two through four may want to introduce these incrementally to prepare for the fifth grade requirement.
items.zh: 教师提示：三年级开始对一些主题进行更详细、更深入的按时间顺序的探究，其中部分主题在学前班至二年级已经介绍过。具体主题包括：北美的早期探索；某些美洲原住民族的生活方式；独立战争前北美殖民地的生活。鼓励使用时间线。以下指南旨在补充当地要求的关于家庭、社区或地区的学习。请注意，五年级的美国地理要求包括"五十个州及其首府"；二至四年级的教师可以逐步引入这些内容，为五年级的要求做准备。

items.en: In fifth grade, students will examine European exploration in a more global context. Third grade teachers should look ahead to the fifth grade World History guidelines (under “European Exploration, Trade, and the Clash of Cultures”) to see how the topics introduced here will be developed and extended later. It is recommended that third grade teachers keep their focus on the explorers and events specified here, and leave for fifth grade the figures and ideas specified for that grade.

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Ponce de Leon, legend of the Fountain of Youth Archaeological discoveries in North and South America, dating back 14,000 to 15,000 years, show that humans arrived on the continent 1,000 or even 2,000 years earlier than previously believed. According to a new theory, known as “Kelp Highway,” massive ice sheets covering western North America retreated allowing the first humans to arrive on the continent not only by foot but by boat. They traveled down the Pacific shore and subsisted on abundant coastal resources. See also Language Arts Grade 3: “The Hunting of the Great Bear” (an Iroquois legend).
items.zh: 庞塞·德莱昂（Ponce de Leon），不老泉传说。在南北美洲的考古发现可追溯到14,000至15,000年前，表明人类抵达该大陆的时间比此前认为的早1,000甚至2,000年。根据一项被称为"海藻高速公路"的新理论，覆盖北美西部的大片冰盖消退，使最早的人类不仅能步行、还能乘船抵达大陆。他们沿着太平洋海岸南下，依靠丰富的沿海资源为生。另见语言艺术三年级：《猎捕大熊》（易洛魁传说）。

items.en: Discuss with students the definition of “colony” and why countries establish colonies. Help students see that the thirteen English colonies were not alike. items.subject: Visual Arts
items.en: Teachers: In schools, lessons on the visual arts should illustrate important elements of making and appreciating art, and emphasize important artists, works of art, and artistic concepts. When appropriate, topics in the visual arts may be linked to topics in other disciplines. The following guidelines specify a variety of artwork in different media and from various cultures in order to expose students to a wide range of art and artists. While the list is robust, it may require teachers to narrow the selection in order to adequately address the works and related skills within an academic year.
items.zh: 教师：学校的视觉艺术课程应展示艺术创作与欣赏的重要元素，并重点介绍重要艺术家、艺术作品和艺术概念。在适当的时候，视觉艺术主题可以与其他学科主题相联系。以下指导方针列举了不同媒介和不同文化的多种艺术作品，以让学生接触广泛的艺术和艺术家。这份清单内容相当丰富，教师可能需要缩小选择范围，以便在一个学年内充分讲解这些作品及相关技能。

items.subject: Visual Arts
items.en: The generally recognized elements of art include line, shape, form, space, light, texture, and color. In third grade, build on what the students have learned in earlier grades as you introduce concepts of light, space, and design.
items.zh: 公认的艺术要素包括线条、形状、形体、空间、光、质感和色彩。三年级时，在学生以往所学的基础上，引入光、空间和设计的概念。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Teachers: In schools, lessons on music should feature activities and works that illustrate important musical concepts and terms, and should introduce important composers and works. When appropriate, topics in music may be linked to topics in other disciplines. The following guidelines focus on content, not performance skills, though many concepts are best learned through active practice (singing, clapping rhythms, playing instruments, etc.).
items.zh: 教师：学校的音乐课应包含能够体现重要音乐概念和术语的活动与作品，并应介绍重要作曲家和作品。在适当的时候，音乐主题可以与其他学科主题相联系。以下指导方针侧重内容而非表演技能，不过许多概念最好通过积极实践来学习（唱歌、拍节奏、演奏乐器等）。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Through participation, become familiar with basic elements of music (rhythm, melody, harmony, form, timbre, etc.).
items.zh: 通过参与，熟悉音乐的基本要素（节奏、旋律、和声、曲式、音色等）。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Recognize a steady beat, accents, and the downbeat; play a steady beat.
items.zh: 辨认稳定的节拍、重音和强拍；能打出稳定的节拍。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Move responsively to music.
items.zh: 随着音乐做出相应的动作。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Recognize short and long sounds.
items.zh: 分辨短音和长音。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Discriminate between fast and slow; gradually slowing down and getting faster.
items.zh: 区分快与慢；能逐渐减速和加速。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Discriminate between differences in pitch: high and low.
items.zh: 区分音高差异：高与低。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Discriminate between loud and soft; gradually increasing and decreasing volume.
items.zh: 区分响与轻；能逐渐增强和减弱音量。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Understand that melody can move up and down.
items.zh: 理解旋律可以上行和下行。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Hum the melody while listening to music.
items.zh: 听音乐时哼唱旋律。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Engage in improvisation activities (e.g., “The Rattlin’ Bog” \[Ireland\], “I Bought Me a Cat”)
items.zh: 参与即兴创作活动（例如《嘎吱作响的沼泽》[The Rattlin' Bog，爱尔兰]、《我买了一只猫》[I Bought Me a Cat]）

items.subject: Music
items.en: Participate in call and response activities (e.g., “Day-O”)
items.zh: 参与一领一和（call and response）的活动（例如《Day-O》）

items.subject: Music
items.en: Sing partner songs (e.g., “Jingle Bells”/“Winter Fantasy”)
items.zh: 演唱配对歌曲（partner songs，即可同时演唱的两首歌）（例如《铃儿响叮当》/《冬日幻想》）

items.subject: Music
items.en: Participate in play parties (e.g., “Old Brass Wagon,” “Draw Me a Bucket of Water,” “Heel and Toe Polka”)
items.zh: 参与游戏歌舞会（play parties）（例如《旧铜车》[Old Brass Wagon]、《给我打一桶水》[Draw Me a Bucket of Water]、《脚跟脚尖波尔卡》[Heel and Toe Polka]）

items.subject: Music
items.en: Echo short rhythms and melodic patterns.
items.zh: 模仿简短的节奏和旋律型。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Play simple rhythms and melodies.
items.zh: 演奏简单的节奏和旋律。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Sing unaccompanied, accompanied, and in unison.
items.zh: 能无伴奏演唱、有伴奏演唱，以及齐唱。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Recognize harmony; sing rounds
items.zh: 辨认和声；演唱轮唱曲（rounds）

items.subject: Music
items.en: Recognize verse and refrain.
items.zh: 辨认主歌与副歌（叠句）。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Continue work with timbre and phrasing.
items.zh: 继续学习音色与乐句处理。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Review names of musical notes;scale as a series of notes; singing the C major scale using “do re mi,” etc.
items.zh: 复习音符名称；音阶是一系列音符；用"do re mi"等唱名演唱C大调音阶。
