items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Teachers: Mathematics has its own vocabulary and patterns of thinking. It is a discipline with its own language and conventions. Thus, while some lessons may offer occasional opportunities for linking mathematics to other disciplines, it is critically important to attend to math as math. From the earliest years, mathematics requires incremental review and steady practice: not only the diligent effort required to master basic facts and operations, but also thoughtful and varied practice that approaches problems from a variety of angles, and gives students a variety of opportunities to apply the same concept or operation in different types of situations. While it is important to work toward the development of “higher-order problem-solving skills,” it is equally important—indeed, it is prerequisite to achieving “higher order” skills—to have a sound grasp of basic facts, and an automatic fluency with fundamental operations.
items.zh: 教师须知：数学有其自身的词汇和思维方式，是一门有自己语言和规范的学科。因此，虽然有些课程偶尔可以把数学与其他学科联系起来，但把数学当作数学来讲至关重要。从最初几年起，数学就需要循序渐进的复习和持续练习：既要努力掌握基本事实和运算，也要进行深思熟虑、形式多样的练习，从多种角度处理问题，让学生在不同类型的情境中多次运用同一概念或运算。虽然培养“高阶解题技能”很重要，但牢固掌握基本事实、对基本运算达到自动化熟练程度同样重要——事实上，这是达到“高阶”技能的前提。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Represent and solve problems involving multiplication and division.
items.zh: 表示并解决涉及乘法和除法的问题。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Interpret products of whole numbers as the number of objects in groups.
items.zh: 把整数的乘积理解为若干组中对象的总数。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Interpret whole-number quotients of whole numbers as the number of objects in each share or the number of shares when partitioned into equal shares.
items.zh: 把整数除以整数的商理解为：平均分成若干份时每份的物体个数，或平均分成的份数。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Use multiplication and division within 100 to solve word problems, with a symbol for the unknown number, in situations involving • equal groups • arrays • measurement quantities
items.zh: 运用100以内的乘法和除法解决应用题，用符号表示未知数，情境包括：等分组、阵列、度量数量。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Determine the unknown whole number, with a symbol for the unknown number, in a multiplication or division equation relating three whole numbers.
items.zh: 在涉及三个整数的乘法或除法算式中，用符号表示未知数，求出未知的整数。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Understand properties of multiplication and the relationship between multiplication and division.
items.zh: 理解乘法的运算性质以及乘法与除法之间的关系。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Apply properties of operations (commutative, associative, and distributive) as strategies to multiply and divide.
items.zh: 运用运算性质（交换律、结合律和分配律）作为乘法和除法的策略。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Understand division as an unknown-factor problem.
items.zh: 把除法理解为求未知因数的问题。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Multiply and divide within 100.
items.zh: 进行100以内的乘法和除法运算。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Fluently multiply and divide within 100.
items.zh: 熟练进行100以内的乘法和除法运算。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Use strategies such as the relationship between multiplication and division or properties of operations.
items.zh: 运用乘法与除法的关系或运算性质等策略。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Know all products of two one digit numbers.
items.zh: 记住所有两个一位数相乘的积。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Solve problems involving the four operations.
items.zh: 解决涉及四则运算的问题。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Solve two-step word problems using the four operations.
items.zh: 运用四则运算解决两步应用题。
details: Represent these problems using equations with a letter standing for the unknown quantity.
Assess the reasonableness of answers using mental computation and estimation strategies.

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Identify arithmetic patterns.
items.zh: 识别算术规律。
details: Describe using properties of operations.
Know that the product of an even number multiplied by any number is always even and why an even number multiplied by a number can be decomposed into equal addends.

items.subject: Mathematics
items.topic: Number and Operations in Base Ten
items.en: Use place value understanding and properties of operations to perform multi-digit arithmetic.
items.zh: 运用位值理解与运算性质进行多位数运算。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.topic: Number and Operations in Base Ten
items.en: Use place value understanding to round whole numbers to the nearest 10 or 100. By the end of Grade 3, know from memory all products of two one-digit numbers.
items.zh: 运用位值理解把整数四舍五入到最接近的10或100。到三年级结束时，能凭记忆说出所有两个一位数相乘的积。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.topic: Number and Operations in Base Ten
items.en: Fluently add and subtract within 1000, using strategies and algorithms based on
items.zh: 熟练进行1000以内的加减法，使用基于……的策略和算法。
details: place value
properties of operations
the relationship between addition and subtraction

items.subject: Mathematics
items.topic: Number and Operations in Base Ten
items.en: Multiply one-digit whole numbers by multiples of 10 in the range 10–90.
items.zh: 把一位数整数与10–90范围内10的倍数相乘。
details: Use strategies based on place value and properties of operations.

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Develop understanding of fractions as numbers.
items.zh: 建立对“分数也是数”的理解。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Understand a fraction 1 b as the quantity formed by 1 part when a whole is partitioned into b equal parts. • Understand a fraction a b as the quantity formed by a part of size 1 b.
items.zh: 把分数1/b理解为：把一个整体平均分成b份时其中1份的量；把分数a/b理解为a个大小为1/b的份所组成的量。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Understand a fraction as a number on the number line.
items.zh: 把分数理解为数轴上的一个数。
details: Represent fractions on a number line diagram.
Define the interval between zero and one as the whole and partition into b equal parts.
Define a b on a number line with segment lengths 1 b and an interval size a b.

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Explain equivalence of fractions in special cases.
items.zh: 在特定情况下解释分数的等价性。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Compare fractions by reasoning about their size.
items.zh: 通过推理分数的大小来比较分数。
details: Understand two fractions as equivalent (equal) if

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: they are the same size.
items.zh: 它们的大小相同。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: they are on the same point on a number line.
items.zh: 它们在数轴上位于同一点。
details: Recognize and generate simple equivalent fractions.
Explain why the fractions are equivalent.
Express whole numbers as fractions, and recognize fractions that are equivalent to whole numbers.
Compare two fractions with the same numerator or the same denominator by reasoning about their size.

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Recognize that comparisons are valid only when the two fractions refer to the same whole.
items.zh: 认识到只有当两个分数指的是同一个整体时，比较才有效。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Record the results of comparisons with the symbols >, =, or <, and justify the conclusions.
items.zh: 用符号 >、= 或 < 记录比较结果，并说明理由。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Solve problems involving measurement and estimation of intervals of time, liquid volumes, and masses of objects.
items.zh: 解决涉及时间长度、液体体积和物体质量的测量与估算的问题。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Tell and write time to the nearest minute.
items.zh: 读出并写出精确到分钟的时间。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Measure time intervals in minutes.
items.zh: 以分钟为单位测量时间间隔。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Solve word problems involving addition and subtraction of time intervals in minutes.
items.zh: 解决涉及以分钟为单位的时间间隔加减法的应用题。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Measure and estimate liquid volumes and masses of objects.
items.zh: 测量并估算液体的体积和物体的质量。
details: Use standard units of

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: grams (g)
items.zh: 克（g）

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: kilograms (kg)
items.zh: 千克（kg）

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: liters (l)
items.zh: 升（l）
details: Add, subtract, multiply, or divide to solve one-step word problems involving masses or volumes that are given in the same unit.

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Represent and interpret data
items.zh: 表示并解读数据

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Draw a scaled picture graph and a scaled bar graph to represent a data set with several categories. • Solve one- and two-step “how many more” and “how many less” problems using information presented in scaled bar graphs.
items.zh: 绘制带刻度的象形图和条形图来表示含若干类别的数据集；利用带刻度条形图中的信息解决一步和两步的“多多少”“少多少”问题。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Generate measurement data by measuring lengths using rulers marked with halves and fourths of an inch. • Show the data by making a line plot, where the horizontal scale is marked off in appropriate units— whole numbers, halves, or quarters.
items.zh: 用标有半英寸和四分之一英寸刻度的尺子测量长度，收集测量数据；用点图展示数据，横轴按适当的单位（整数、二分之一或四分之一）标注刻度。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Geometric measurement: understand concepts of area and relate area to multiplication and to addition.
items.zh: 几何测量：理解面积的概念，并把面积与乘法、加法联系起来。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Recognize area as an attribute of plane figures and understand concepts of area measurement. • A square with side length of 1 unit
items.zh: 把面积看作平面图形的一种属性，理解面积测量的概念；边长为1个单位的正方形……

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: is called “a unit square”
items.zh: 称为“单位正方形”

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: is said to have “one square unit” of area
items.zh: 被认为具有“1个平方单位”的面积

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: can be used to measure area
items.zh: 可用来测量面积
details: A plane figure which can be covered without gaps or overlaps by “n” unit squares is said to have an area of “n” square units.

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Measure areas by counting unit squares.
items.zh: 通过数单位正方形来测量面积。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Relate area to the operations of multiplication and addition.
items.zh: 把面积与乘法和加法运算联系起来。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Geometric measurement: recognize perimeter as an attribute of plane figures and distinguish between linear and area measures.
items.zh: 几何测量：把周长看作平面图形的一种属性，并区分长度测量与面积测量。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Solve real world and mathematical problems involving perimeters of polygons.
items.zh: 解决涉及多边形周长的实际问题和数学问题。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Recognize area by tiling.
items.zh: 通过铺满（密铺）来认识面积。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Find areas of rectangles by multiplying side lengths.
items.zh: 用边长相乘求长方形的面积。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Recognize area as additive.
items.zh: 认识到面积具有可加性。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Reason with shapes and their attributes.
items.zh: 根据形状及其属性进行推理。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Understand that shapes in different categories (e.g., rhombuses, rectangles, and others) may share attributes (e.g., having four sides).
items.zh: 理解不同类别的图形（如菱形、长方形等）可能具有共同属性（如有四条边）。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Understand that the shared attributes can define a larger category (e.g., quadrilaterals).
items.zh: 理解共同属性可以定义一个更大的类别（如四边形）。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Recognize rhombuses, rectangles, and squares as examples of quadrilaterals.
items.zh: 认识菱形、长方形和正方形都是四边形的例子。
details: Draw examples of quadrilaterals that do not belong to any of these subcategories.

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Partition shapes into parts with equal areas.
items.zh: 把图形分割成面积相等的部分。
details: Express the area of each part as a unit fraction of the whole. Square cm., square m., square in., square ft., and improvised units.

items.subject: Science
items.en: Teachers: Effective instruction in science requires hands-on experience and observation. In the words of the report from the National Academies of Science, A Framework for K-12 Science Education, “...children have surprisingly sophisticated ways of thinking about the world, based in part on their direct experiences with the physical environment, such as watching objects fall or collide and observing plants and animals. They also learn about the world through everyday activities, such as talking with their families, pursuing hobbies, watching television, and playing with friends. As children try to understand and influence the world around them, they develop ideas about their role in that world and how it works. In fact, the capacity of young children—from all backgrounds and socioeconomic levels—to reason in sophisticated ways is much greater than has long been assumed. Although they may lack deep knowledge and extensive experience, they often engage in a wide range of subtle and complex reasoning about the world. Thus, before they even enter school, children have developed their own ideas about the physical, biological, and social worlds and how they work. By listening to and taking these ideas seriously, educators can build on what children already know and can do.”
items.zh: 教师须知：有效的科学教学需要动手体验和观察。用美国国家科学院报告《K-12 科学教育框架》的话来说：“……孩子们以令人惊讶的复杂方式思考世界，这部分基于他们对物质环境的直接体验，比如观看物体下落或碰撞、观察动植物。他们也通过日常活动了解世界，比如与家人交谈、从事爱好、看电视、和朋友玩耍。当孩子们试图理解和影响周围的世界时，他们会形成关于自己在世界中的角色以及世界如何运作的想法。事实上，幼儿——无论来自何种背景、何种社会经济水平——进行复杂推理的能力远超长期以来的设想。尽管他们可能缺乏深入知识和丰富经验，但他们常常对世界进行广泛而细致的复杂推理。因此，甚至在入学之前，孩子们就已经对物理、生物和社会世界及其运作方式形成了自己的想法。通过倾听并认真对待这些想法，教育者可以在儿童已有知识和能力的基础上进行教学。”

items.subject: Science
items.en: Through reading aloud, observation, and activities such as planning and conducting investigations of colliding objects, explore the following with students:
items.zh: 通过朗读、观察，以及设计并实施对碰撞物体的探究等活动，带领学生探索以下内容：

items.subject: Science
items.en: A force is a push or a pull.
items.zh: 力是推或拉。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Forces can cause changes in an object’s motion.
items.zh: 力能使物体的运动状态发生改变。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Forces can change an object’s direction and speed, sometimes starting or stopping the object’s motion.
items.zh: 力能改变物体的方向和速度，有时还能使物体开始或停止运动。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Gravity is a force that pulls objects toward each other.
items.zh: 重力是把物体相互吸引的力。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Forces on an object may be balanced or unbalanced.
items.zh: 作用在物体上的力可能是平衡的，也可能是不平衡的。

items.subject: Science
items.en: If an object is at rest the forces acting on it are balanced.
items.zh: 如果物体处于静止状态，作用在其上的力是平衡的。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Friction is a force that occurs when objects are in contact with one another.
items.zh: 摩擦力是物体相互接触时产生的一种力。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Friction opposes motion.
items.zh: 摩擦力阻碍运动。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Friction can create heat (for example, rubbing hands together).
items.zh: 摩擦能产生热（例如双手互相摩擦）。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Friction can be helpful (bicycle brakes) or harmful (in automobile engines).
items.zh: 摩擦力可能有益（自行车刹车），也可能有害（汽车发动机中）。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Lubricants reduce friction.
items.zh: 润滑剂能减少摩擦。

items.subject: Science
items.en: If an object moves in regular patterns, we can predict the object’s future motion.
items.zh: 如果物体按规律的模式运动，我们就能预测它未来的运动。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Magnetism is a force that can push or pull.
items.zh: 磁力是一种能推或拉的力。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Only certain metals can be or become magnetic or be affected by magnetism (for example, iron).
items.zh: 只有某些金属能带有磁性、被磁化或受磁力影响（例如铁）。

items.subject: Science
items.en: The strength of a magnetic force depends on the distance between the magnet and the object.
items.zh: 磁力的大小取决于磁铁与物体之间的距离。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Unlike poles (north and south) attract, like poles repel.
items.zh: 异极（南极和北极）相吸，同极相斥。

items.subject: Science
items.en: People use magnets to solve problems (refrigerator magnets, cabinet locks, maglev trains). Review and extend learning from Kindergarten, Pushes and Pulls.
items.zh: 人们利用磁铁解决问题（冰箱贴、柜门锁、磁悬浮列车）。复习并拓展幼儿园“推与拉”的学习内容。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Life cycles are the patterns of changes that organisms go through during their lives.
items.zh: 生命周期是生物在一生中所经历的变化模式。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Different organisms have different life cycles, but all life cycles share common stages: birth, growth, reproduction, death.
items.zh: 不同生物有不同的生命周期，但所有生命周期都有共同的阶段：出生、生长、繁殖、死亡。

items.subject: Science
items.en: The life cycle of a typical flowering plant:
items.zh: 典型开花植物的生命周期：

items.subject: Science
items.en: birth (germination of seeds) > growth > reproduction (flowering) > death
items.zh: 出生（种子萌发）> 生长 > 繁殖（开花）> 死亡

items.subject: Science
items.en: Metamorphosis is the process some animals go through involving a great change in form in becoming an adult, such as:
items.zh: 变态发育是某些动物在长大为成体的过程中形态发生巨大变化的过程，例如：

items.subject: Science
items.en: butterfly (egg, larva, pupa, adult)
items.zh: 蝴蝶（卵、幼虫、蛹、成虫）

items.subject: Science
items.en: frog (egg, tadpole, adult)
items.zh: 青蛙（卵、蝌蚪、成体）

items.subject: Science
items.en: An organism is any individual life form.
items.zh: 生物体是任何单个的生命形式。

items.subject: Science
items.en: A community of organisms of the same species within an ecosystem is a population.
items.zh: 生态系统中同一物种的生物群体称为种群。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Traits can vary to help certain individuals survive and reproduce.
items.zh: 性状会发生变化，以帮助某些个体生存和繁殖。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Organisms are divided into species, which share specific traits.
items.zh: 生物被划分为不同的物种，同一物种具有特定的共同性状。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Traits are the characteristics of living things, including structures, functions, and behaviors; traits we can observe are called physical traits.
items.zh: 性状是生物的特征，包括结构、功能和行为；能观察到的性状称为外在（形态）性状。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Offspring and siblings generally look like, but are not identical to, their parents or one another.
items.zh: 子代和兄弟姐妹通常长得像父母或彼此，但并不完全相同。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Inheritance is the traits that are passed from parents to offspring.
items.zh: 遗传是从父母传递给子代的性状。

items.subject: Science
items.en: A population is a group of organisms of the same species that live in the same area.
items.zh: 种群是生活在同一地区的同一物种生物群体。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Variations are the differences among specific traits in a population.
items.zh: 变异是种群中特定性状之间的差异。

items.subject: Science
items.en: The environment can influence an organism’s traits.
items.zh: 环境会影响生物的性状。

items.subject: Science
items.en: The environment can affect all stages of an organism’s life cycle.
items.zh: 环境会影响生物生命周期的所有阶段。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Cause and effect relationships exist between populations and their ecosystems.
items.zh: 种群与其生态系统之间存在因果关系。

items.subject: Science
items.en: In a changing environment, some traits help some living things (advantageous) while other traits do not help (disadvantageous).
items.zh: 在变化的环境中，某些性状对某些生物有利（有利性状），而另一些性状则无益（不利性状）。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Some individuals in a population may reproduce more successfully than others if their traits help them thrive in their specific environment.
items.zh: 如果某些个体的性状有助于它们在特定环境中繁盛，它们就可能比其他个体繁殖得更成功。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Through reading aloud, observation, and activities such as developing models of the shapes and kinds of land and water in an area, help students to explore the following:
items.zh: 通过朗读、观察，以及制作某地区陆地和水域的形状与种类模型等活动，帮助学生探索以下内容：

items.subject: Science
items.en: Living things are adapted to the environment in which they live.
items.zh: 生物适应其生存的环境。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Adaptations promote survival.
items.zh: 适应性有助于生存。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Organisms have traits that indicate they are adapted to live in their environment, and able to survive.
items.zh: 生物具有一些性状，表明它们已适应所处环境并能够生存。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Organisms have adaptations to specific habitats (tundra, seashore, desert and underground).
items.zh: 生物具有适应特定栖息地（苔原、海岸、沙漠和地下）的特征。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Some animals form groups to help them survive in their habitats. Review and extend learning from Grade 2, Organisms and Their Habitats. B. Ecosystems and Environmental Change
items.zh: 有些动物组成群体，以帮助自己在栖息地中生存。复习并拓展二年级“生物及其栖息地”的学习内容。

items.subject: Science
items.en: An ecosystem is all the biotic and abiotic factors in a specific environment.
items.zh: 生态系统是特定环境中的全部生物因素和非生物因素。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Ecosystems undergo natural and human-induced changes over time.
items.zh: 生态系统会随时间经历自然变化和人为引起的变化。

items.subject: Science
items.en: When an ecosystem changes, some organisms survive while others may not.
items.zh: 当生态系统发生变化时，有些生物能存活，另一些则可能无法存活。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Describe specific evidence that shows what a habitat and a specific organism in that habitat were like before and after a significant environmental change.
items.zh: 描述具体证据，说明在重大环境变化前后，某栖息地及其中某种生物的状态。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Humans can cause threats to the environment (air pollution: emissions, smog; water pollution: industrial waste, run-off from farming).
items.zh: 人类可能对环境造成威胁（空气污染：排放物、烟雾；水污染：工业废料、农业径流）。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Debate the merits of solutions for reconstructing an ecosystem after a significant environmental change.
items.zh: 就重大环境变化后重建生态系统的各种方案的优劣展开辩论。

items.subject: Science
items.topic: Evidence of How Organisms and Environments Have Changed Over Time
items.en: Fossils: Scientists analyze and interpret fossils (bones, amber, traces, impressions) for evidence of how organisms and environments have changed over time.
items.zh: 化石：科学家分析和解读化石（骨骼、琥珀、痕迹、印痕），以寻找生物和环境随时间变化的证据。

items.subject: Science
items.topic: Evidence of How Organisms and Environments Have Changed Over Time
items.en: As a past environment changed, so did the organisms that continue to live there (coral reefs, grasslands).
items.zh: 随着过去环境的改变，继续生活在那里的生物也发生了改变（如珊瑚礁、草原）。

items.subject: Science
items.topic: Evidence of How Organisms and Environments Have Changed Over Time
items.en: Many organisms that once existed are now extinct.
items.zh: 许多曾经存在的生物如今已经灭绝。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Air is a mixture of gases.
items.zh: 空气是多种气体的混合物。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Air is matter and takes up space.
items.zh: 空气是物质，会占据空间。

items.subject: Science
items.en: The most common gases in the atmosphere are nitrogen and oxygen.
items.zh: 大气中最常见的气体是氮气和氧气。

items.subject: Science
items.en: The atmosphere grows thinner as you move upward from Earth’s surface.
items.zh: 从地球表面向上，大气变得越来越稀薄。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Air pressure is the weight of air in the atmosphere.
items.zh: 气压是大气中空气的重量。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Humidity is the amount of water vapor in the air.
items.zh: 湿度是空气中水蒸气的含量。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Evaporation is the sun’s energy changing liquid water to gas.
items.zh: 蒸发是太阳的能量把液态水变成气态。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Condensation of water vapor in the atmosphere forms clouds and fog.
items.zh: 大气中的水蒸气凝结形成云和雾。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Precipitation is water that falls from clouds, such as rain, snow, sleet, or hail.
items.zh: 降水是从云中落下的水，如雨、雪、雨夹雪或冰雹。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Energy from the sun warms Earth unevenly, which creates areas of warm air (lower air pressure) and areas of cool air (higher air pressure).
items.zh: 太阳的能量使地球受热不均，形成暖空气区域（气压较低）和冷空气区域（气压较高）。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Winds are the result of air moving from areas of high air pressure to areas of low air pressure.
items.zh: 风是空气从高气压区域向低气压区域移动的结果。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Prevailing winds are regular patterns of wind flow across Earth’s surface.
items.zh: 盛行风是地球表面上规则的风流模式。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Weather is the conditions in the lowest layer of the atmosphere at a specific time and place.
items.zh: 天气是特定时间和地点大气最低层的状况。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Weather conditions vary from place to place and over time.
items.zh: 天气状况因地点和时间而异。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Meteorologists are scientists who study weather and climate.
items.zh: 气象学家是研究天气和气候的科学家。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Climate is the pattern of weather conditions in a large area over a long time.
items.zh: 气候是大范围内长时间内的天气状况模式。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Climate varies from place to place.
items.zh: 气候因地点而异。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Climate in one location varies over a year’s time.
items.zh: 同一地点的气候在一年中也会变化。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Climatologists are scientists who study long-term weather data.
items.zh: 气候学家是研究长期天气数据的科学家。

items.subject: Science
items.topic: Reducing the Impact of Hazardous Weather
items.en: Storms: high winds, heavy rains, lightning, thunder
items.zh: 暴风雨：强风、暴雨、闪电、雷声

items.subject: Science
items.topic: Reducing the Impact of Hazardous Weather
items.en: Extreme weather events: tornadoes, hurricanes, blizzards, drought Collaborate with your fifth grade colleagues regarding future expectations within, Energy and Matter in Ecosystems and Protecting Earth's Resources. Fossils are explored in more depth in Grade 4, Processes That Shape Earth. Review and extend learning from Kindergarten, Weather Patterns.
items.zh: 极端天气事件：龙卷风、飓风、暴风雪、干旱。与五年级同事协作，了解“生态系统中的能量与物质”和“保护地球资源”方面的后续要求。化石将在四年级“塑造地球的过程”中更深入地探讨。复习并拓展幼儿园“天气模式”的学习内容。

items.subject: Science
items.topic: Reducing the Impact of Hazardous Weather
items.en: Flooding can occur during and after storms.
items.zh: 洪水可能在暴风雨期间和之后发生。

items.subject: Science
items.topic: Reducing the Impact of Hazardous Weather
items.en: Extreme weather conditions can endanger people and cause destruction.
items.zh: 极端天气会危及人类并造成破坏。

items.subject: Science
items.topic: Reducing the Impact of Hazardous Weather
items.en: People can plan and take steps to reduce damage and avoid danger from weather hazards (levies, warning systems, lightning rods, special buildings).
items.zh: 人们可以制定计划并采取措施，减少天气灾害造成的损失、避免危险（堤坝、预警系统、避雷针、特殊建筑）。

items.subject: Science
items.topic: The Human Body: Human Senses and Movement
items.en: Muscles
items.zh: 肌肉

items.subject: Science
items.topic: The Human Body: Human Senses and Movement
items.en: Involuntary and voluntary muscles
items.zh: 不随意肌和随意肌

items.subject: Science
items.topic: The Human Body: Human Senses and Movement
items.en: Skeleton, bones, marrow
items.zh: 骨骼、骨头、骨髓

items.subject: Science
items.topic: The Human Body: Human Senses and Movement
items.en: Skull, cranium, spinal column, vertebrae
items.zh: 头骨、颅骨、脊柱、椎骨

items.subject: Science
items.topic: The Human Body: Human Senses and Movement
items.en: Joints
items.zh: 关节

items.subject: Science
items.topic: The Human Body: Human Senses and Movement
items.en: Ribs, rib cage, sternum
items.zh: 肋骨、胸廓、胸骨

items.subject: Science
items.topic: The Human Body: Human Senses and Movement
items.en: Scapula (shoulder blades), pelvis, tibia, fibula
items.zh: 肩胛骨（肩胛）、骨盆、胫骨、腓骨

items.subject: Science
items.topic: The Human Body: Human Senses and Movement
items.en: Broken bones, x-rays
items.zh: 骨折、X光

items.subject: Science
items.topic: The Human Body: Human Senses and Movement
items.en: Musculo-skeletal connections
items.zh: 肌肉与骨骼的连接

items.subject: Science
items.topic: The Human Body: Human Senses and Movement
items.en: Ligaments
items.zh: 韧带

items.subject: Science
items.topic: The Human Body: Human Senses and Movement
items.en: Tendons, Achilles tendon
items.zh: 肌腱、跟腱

items.subject: Science
items.topic: The Human Body: Human Senses and Movement
items.en: Cartilage
items.zh: 软骨

items.subject: Science
items.en: Brain: medulla, cerebellum, cerebrum, cerebral cortex
items.zh: 脑：延髓、小脑、大脑、大脑皮层

items.subject: Science
items.en: Spinal cord
items.zh: 脊髓

items.subject: Science
items.en: Nerves
items.zh: 神经

items.subject: Science
items.en: Reflexes
items.zh: 反射

items.subject: Science
items.en: Parts of the eye: cornea, iris and pupil, lens, retina
items.zh: 眼睛的构造：角膜、虹膜和瞳孔、晶状体、视网膜

items.subject: Science
items.en: Optic nerve
items.zh: 视神经

items.subject: Science
items.en: Farsighted and nearsighted vision
items.zh: 远视和近视

items.subject: Science
items.en: Ways to help those with impaired vision, including corrective lens, assistive animals, and braille
items.zh: 帮助视力障碍者的方式，包括矫正镜片、导盲犬和盲文

items.subject: Science
items.en: Sound as vibration
items.zh: 声音是振动

items.subject: Science
items.en: Outer ear, ear canal
items.zh: 外耳、耳道

items.subject: Science
items.en: Eardrum
items.zh: 鼓膜

items.subject: Science
items.en: Three tiny bones (hammer, anvil, and stirrup) pass vibrations to the cochlea
items.zh: 三块小骨（锤骨、砧骨和镫骨）将振动传递到耳蜗

items.subject: Science
items.en: Auditory nerve
items.zh: 听觉神经

items.subject: Science
items.en: Ways to help those with impaired hearing, including sign language, cochlear implants, and other hearing aids.
items.zh: 帮助听力障碍者的方式，包括手语、人工耳蜗和其他助听器。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Through reading aloud and activities, explore with students the stories and accomplishments of these scientists and engineers. This list of science biographies is by no means exhaustive. Other individuals can be incorporated into learning during a corresponding topic of study for this grade level, and should include: Emphasis at this grade is to build on prior knowledge and to explore how our body systems and senses work together.
items.zh: 通过朗读和相关活动，与学生一起了解这些科学家和工程师的故事与成就。这份科学家传记清单并不详尽；在学习本年级相应主题时，还可以加入其他人物。本年级的重点是在已有知识的基础上，探索我们的身体系统和各种感官是如何协同工作的。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Petrus Peregrinus de Maricourt—French scholar who worked on compasses
items.zh: 佩特鲁斯·佩雷格里努斯·德·马里库尔——研究指南针的法国学者

items.subject: Science
items.en: Elijah McCoy—American inventor, invented lubrication devices to improve the efficiency of train travel.
items.zh: 伊莱贾·麦科伊——美国发明家，发明了润滑装置以提高火车运行效率。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Gregor Mendel—Austrian monk who studied pea plants, and developed models of simple inheritance.
items.zh: 格雷戈尔·孟德尔——奥地利修道士，研究豌豆植物，提出了简单遗传的模型。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Rachel Carson—warned of the environmental impacts of pesticides in her book Silent Spring.
items.zh: 蕾切尔·卡逊——在《寂静的春天》一书中警示了农药对环境的影响。

items.subject: Science
items.en: John Muir—studied wilderness areas and worked to convince people to protect them.
items.zh: 约翰·缪尔——研究荒野地区，并努力说服人们加以保护。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Edward D. Cope and Othniel C. Marsh—paleontologists and competitors whose competition started “the Bone Wars,” also known as the Great Dinosaur Rush of the late 19th century.
items.zh: 爱德华·D·科普与奥塞内尔·C·马什——古生物学家，也是竞争对手；他们的竞争引发了“骨头战争”，即19世纪末的“恐龙淘金热”。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Evangelista Torricelli—invented the barometer and studied air pressure.
items.zh: 埃万杰利斯塔·托里拆利——发明了气压计，并研究气压。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Benjamin Franklin—invented a lightning rod to protect people, buildings, and other structures.
items.zh: 本杰明·富兰克林——发明了避雷针，以保护人、建筑物和其他结构。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Tetsuya Fujita and Alan Pearson—researched storms and rated the severity of tornadoes.
items.zh: 藤田哲也和艾伦·皮尔逊——研究风暴，并对龙卷风的强度进行评级。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Maintain attention and actively participate in discussions about a variety of topics, ideas, and texts in a variety of settings, including partners, small and large groups, and teacher-led groups.
items.zh: 在两人、小组、大组以及教师带领的多种场合中，就各种话题、观点和文本保持专注并积极参与讨论。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Prepare for discussions in advance, including reading about the topic and organizing information for the discussion. Draw on preparations during the discussion.
items.zh: 提前为讨论做准备，包括阅读相关话题材料并整理讨论所需信息；讨论时运用这些准备成果。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use agreed-upon rules for group discussions, keep discussions on topic, and carry out specific roles appropriate to a discussion, such as an interviewer or historical figure.
items.zh: 遵守商定的小组讨论规则，使讨论紧扣主题，并承担适合讨论的特定角色，如采访者或历史人物。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Ask relevant questions to clarify conversations and ideas, and to build upon remarks made by others.
items.zh: 提出相关问题，以澄清谈话和观点，并在他人发言的基础上进一步展开。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Understand and restate the key ideas in a discussion and distinguish them from their own ideas.
items.zh: 理解并复述讨论中的关键观点，并将其与自己的想法区分开来。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Restate or paraphrase information read aloud or delivered visually, quantitatively, or in other formats, such as videos, recordings, etc.
items.zh: 重述或转述朗读的信息，或以图像、数据及其他形式（如视频、录音等）呈现的信息。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Determine the evidence and reasons a speaker uses to support their main points.
items.zh: 判断说话者用哪些证据和理由来支持其主要观点。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Give a presentation about a topic or text, tell a story, or orally relate a personal experience in a logical and organized manner, including relevant details and facts that support main ideas or themes.
items.zh: 有条理、逻辑清晰地就某个话题或文本做展示、讲故事或口头讲述个人经历，并包含支持主旨或主题的相关细节和事实。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Speak clearly at an understandable volume and pace.
items.zh: 以清晰易懂的音量、语速说话。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Develop main ideas and themes by adding displays, images, videos, and recordings to enhance presentations.
items.zh: 通过添加展品、图片、视频和录音来增强展示效果，从而展开主旨和主题。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Switch between formal and informal English as appropriate to the situation or task—for example, presentations (formal) and group discussions (informal).
items.zh: 根据情境或任务在正式英语与非正式英语之间切换，例如展示（正式）与小组讨论（非正式）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use grade-level phonics and word analysis skills to decode words.
items.zh: 运用年级对应的自然拼读和词汇分析技能来解码单词。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use combined knowledge of letter-sound correspondences, syllabication patterns, and morphology (e.g., roots, prefixes, and suffixes) to read unfamiliar multisyllabic words in context and out of context.
items.zh: 综合运用字母与读音对应关系、音节划分模式和词法知识（如词根、前缀和后缀），在上下文和脱离上下文的情况下读出陌生的多音节词。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Read grade-level text fluently and accurately to support comprehension.
items.zh: 流利、准确地朗读年级水平的文本，以帮助理解。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Read text with purpose.
items.zh: 带着目的阅读文本。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Self-correct and develop understanding by using context and rereading as necessary.
items.zh: 必要时利用上下文和重读来自我纠正并加深理解。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Read grade-level prose and poetry orally with accuracy, appropriate rate, and expression.
items.zh: 准确、语速适当、带感情地朗读年级对应的散文和诗歌。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Independently read and comprehend longer works of fiction (chapter books, stories, plays, and poems) and nonfiction (science, history, social studies, and technical subjects) appropriately written for fourth grade or beyond.
items.zh: 独立阅读并理解适合四年级及以上水平的较长虚构作品（章节书、故事、戏剧和诗歌）和非虚构作品（科学、历史、社会研究和科技类文本）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use details and examples when explaining literal elements in a text or making inferences.
items.zh: 在解释文本的字面内容或进行推断时，运用细节和例子。
items.section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
items.section_zh: 把握具体细节与关键观点

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use details to summarize texts.
items.zh: 用细节概括文本。
items.section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
items.section_zh: 把握具体细节与关键观点

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Identify the topic or theme of a text.
items.zh: 确定文本的主题或主旨。
items.section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
items.section_zh: 把握具体细节与关键观点

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Determine the meaning of words and phrases from a text by using context clues, asking questions, or consulting a reference source such as a dictionary or glossary.
items.zh: 通过上下文线索、提问或查阅词典、词汇表等参考工具，确定文本中单词和短语的含义。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Understand how text elements (such as chapters and headings) and visual elements (such as photos and illustrations) contribute to the organization and understanding of a text.
items.zh: 理解文本要素（如章节和标题）与视觉要素（如照片和插图）如何帮助文本的组织和理解。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Explain how visual elements contribute to the understanding of a text.
items.zh: 说明视觉要素如何帮助理解文本。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Compare a written text to an oral or visual version.
items.zh: 将书面文本与口头或影像版本进行比较。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Compare and contrast different texts with the same topic or genre.
items.zh: 比较和对比主题或体裁相同的不同文本。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use details to trace the themes in literary works, such as poems, plays, and fiction.
items.zh: 用细节梳理文学作品（如诗歌、戏剧和小说）中的主题。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use details to describe and build an in-depth understanding of the elements of fiction or plays, such as setting, dialogue, plot, and character motivations.
items.zh: 用细节描述并深入理解小说或戏剧的要素，如背景、对话、情节和人物动机。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Know the basic structural differences when writing or speaking about different kinds of literary works, such as plays, poems, and novels.
items.zh: 了解在写作或谈论不同类型文学作品（如戏剧、诗歌和小说）时的基本结构差异。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Know the basic elements of poems, such as verse, rhythm, rhyme, and meter.
items.zh: 了解诗歌的基本要素，如诗节、节奏、韵脚和格律。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Know the basic elements of plays, such as stage directions, cast lists, and dialogue.
items.zh: 了解戏剧的基本要素，如舞台说明、演员表和对话。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Recognize allusions to Greek and Roman mythology and use this understanding to determine the meaning of words (e.g., chronology, echo, Herculean).
items.zh: 识别对希腊和罗马神话的典故，并借此判断词义（如 chronology、echo、Herculean）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Examine different types of stories to compare the points of view of various narrators, including different narrators telling the same story.
items.zh: 考察不同类型的故事，比较不同叙述者的视角，包括不同叙述者讲述同一个故事的情况。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Identify whether a story is told in the first or third person.
items.zh: 判断故事是第一人称还是第三人称叙述。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Relate the written versions of stories and plays to oral or visual presentations, including locating specifically in the text any corresponding elements, such as scene descriptions, stage directions, or dialogue.
items.zh: 将故事和戏剧的书面版本与口头或影像呈现联系起来，包括在文本中准确找出对应的要素，如场景描写、舞台说明或对话。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Answer questions about the details of a nonfiction text, indicating which part of the text provides the information needed to answer specific questions.
items.zh: 回答关于非虚构文本细节的问题，并指出文本的哪一部分提供了回答特定问题所需的信息。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Locate the main ideas in a text and identify key details that support them.
items.zh: 找出文本中的主旨，并确定支持主旨的关键细节。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Effectively summarize all types of informational texts.
items.zh: 有效地概括各类信息类文本。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Identify and determine the meaning of Tier 2 and Tier 3 vocabulary words in informational text.
items.zh: 识别并确定信息类文本中二级（Tier 2）和三级（Tier 3）词汇的含义。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Identify the structure of a text, section of text, paragraph, or sentence (e.g., comparison, cause/effect, problem/solution, compare/contrast, sequence, and main idea and details) and describe how it connects and communicates ideas in the text.
items.zh: 识别文本、章节、段落或句子的结构（如比较、因果、问题解决、对比、顺序以及主旨与细节），并说明它如何连接和传达文本中的观点。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Understand how historical events, scientific ideas, concepts, or steps in a procedure are related in a text and use language pertaining to sequence or cause/effect to explain how or why they happened.
items.zh: 理解文本中历史事件、科学观点、概念或操作步骤之间的关系，并使用表示顺序或因果的语言解释其发生的过程或原因。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Examine firsthand and secondhand sources for the same topic and explain the differences in perspective, facts, and details between them.
items.zh: 考察关于同一话题的第一手和第二手资料，并说明它们在视角、事实和细节上的差异。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Understand the characteristics of charts, timelines, bar graphs, animations, and other text features and use them to gather information.
items.zh: 了解图表、时间线、条形图、动画及其他文本特征的特点，并利用它们收集信息。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Explain how charts, time lines, bar graphs, animations, and other visual and quantitative text features enhance a text and/or provide additional information, including on websites.
items.zh: 说明图表、时间线、条形图、动画及其他视觉和数据类文本特征如何增强文本或提供额外信息，包括网站上的情况。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Explain how an author supports their claims in a text by giving reasons (opinions) and evidence, such as facts, examples, and expert opinions from reliable sources.
items.zh: 说明作者如何通过给出理由（观点）和证据（如事实、例子以及可靠来源的专家意见）来支持文本中的主张。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Synthesize information from two or more sources on the same topic, then speak or write about the topic with mastery of the subject matter.
items.zh: 综合同一主题的两个或多个来源的信息，然后对该主题进行口头或书面表达，体现出对内容的掌握。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
items.en: Write routinely, clearly, and coherently, completing both short and long assignments focused on a range of different tasks, purposes, and audiences.
items.zh: 定期、清晰、连贯地写作，完成针对各种任务、目的和读者的长短篇作业。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
items.en: Incorporate planning, research, editing, and revision into writing practice.
items.zh: 把计划、研究、编辑和修改纳入写作练习。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
items.en: Use keyboards, tablets, the Internet, and other technologies to produce and publish writing and collaborate and communicate with others.
items.zh: 使用键盘、平板电脑、互联网及其他技术来创作和发布作品，并与他人协作和交流。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
items.en: Type a minimum of one page in a single attempt.
items.zh: 一次至少打出一页内容。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
items.en: Analyze literature in writing:
items.zh: 通过写作分析文学作品：

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
items.en: Trace a theme.
items.zh: 梳理一个主题。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
items.en: Show in-depth understanding of characters, setting, and plot events.
items.zh: 展现对人物、背景和情节事件的深入理解。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
items.en: Describe how different literary elements interact within the text.
items.zh: 描述不同文学要素在文本中如何相互作用。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
items.en: Analyze informational texts in writing by describing how authors make and support their points with reasons and factual evidence.
items.zh: 通过描述作者如何提出观点并用理由和事实证据加以支持，以写作方式分析信息类文本。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
items.en: Draw upon appropriate literary elements, details, or facts as evidence for writing analysis.
items.zh: 选取恰当的文学要素、细节或事实作为写作分析的证据。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Conduct short research projects to demonstrate knowledge gathered and learned about a topic.
items.zh: 开展小型研究项目，展示围绕某一主题收集和学到的知识。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Gather information from personal experiences as well as from print and digital sources (such as an encyclopedias, magazines, approved online sources, videos, interviews, and recordings).
items.zh: 从个人经历以及纸质和数字资源（如百科全书、杂志、获批的在线资源、视频、访谈和录音）中收集信息。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Take notes from sources.
items.zh: 从资料来源中做笔记。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Provide a rudimentary bibliography.
items.zh: 提供一份简单的参考文献目录。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Produce narrative text based on real-life or imagined experiences.
items.zh: 基于真实或想象的经历写出叙述性文本。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Introduce a narrator, a situation, and characters, and develop them through dialogue and exposition, including actions, thoughts, feelings, and reactions to events in the plot.
items.zh: 介绍叙述者、情境和人物，并通过对话和叙述加以展开，包括动作、思想、情感以及对情节中事件的反应。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Organize a logical or natural sequence of plot events following from the situation, using time-order words to indicate event order.
items.zh: 按照情境安排合乎逻辑或自然的情节事件顺序，并用表示时间顺序的词标明事件先后。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Include sensory details to make writing vivid and precise; convey a sense of experiences and/or the sensations that accompany experiences.
items.zh: 加入感官细节，使写作生动准确；传达体验本身及伴随体验的感受。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Provide a sense of closure that follows logically or artfully from the situation, character responses, and sequence of events.
items.zh: 给出合乎逻辑或巧妙的结尾，与情境、人物反应和事件顺序相呼应。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Write reports and other types of informational texts that clearly present ideas and information in their own words.
items.zh: 写报告及其他类型的信息类文本，用自己的话清晰地呈现观点和资料。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Introduce a topic with information organized in related sections or paragraphs and developed with facts, definitions, quotations, and details.
items.zh: 引入一个主题，把信息组织在相关的部分或段落中，并用事实、定义、引文和细节加以展开。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Include visual elements such as photos, drawings, or diagrams to help explain or present ideas or information when appropriate.
items.zh: 在适当的时候加入照片、图画或图表等视觉要素，以帮助解释或呈现观点和信息。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use linking words to connect ideas (e.g., also, another, and, more, but, however, therefore, in addition).
items.zh: 使用连接词连接观点（如 also、another、and、more、but、however、therefore、in addition）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use Tier 2 and/or Tier 3 vocabulary to explain or elaborate topics.
items.zh: 使用二级（Tier 2）和/或三级（Tier 3）词汇来解释或展开主题。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Write a conclusion that wraps up ideas in the text.
items.zh: 写出总结全文观点的结论。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Introduce a topic and opinion and support a point of view with reasons, details, and evidence.
items.zh: 引入主题和观点，并用理由、细节和证据支持某一立场。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Follow through with an organizational structure that supports the purpose of the text, grouping ideas in a logical way.
items.zh: 采用有助于实现文本目的的组织结构，按逻辑对观点进行分组。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use linking words to connect the opinion with reasons and evidence (e.g., another, furthermore, but, also, however, therefore, in addition, for example).
items.zh: 使用连接词把观点与理由和证据连接起来（如 another、furthermore、but、also、however、therefore、in addition、for example）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Write a conclusion that wraps up the argument.
items.zh: 写出总结论证的结论。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use knowledge of language conventions when reading, writing, speaking, and listening.
items.zh: 在阅读、写作、口语和倾听中运用语言规范知识。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Apply word choices and punctuation to create meaning and effect.
items.zh: 运用选词和标点来创造意义与效果。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Identify differences between written and spoken English.
items.zh: 识别书面英语与口语英语之间的差异。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Switch between formal and informal English as appropriate to the situation or task—for example, presentations (formal) and group discussions (informal).
items.zh: 根据情境或任务在正式英语与非正式英语之间切换，例如展示（正式）与小组讨论（非正式）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Spell most words correctly or with a highly probable spelling.
items.zh: 大多数单词拼写正确，或拼出极有可能正确的形式。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Apply current code knowledge to spelling.
items.zh: 把当前学到的拼读规则知识运用于拼写。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Spell most grade-level high-frequency words correctly.
items.zh: 正确拼写大多数年级高频词。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use dictionaries or glossaries—print and digital—to check and correct spellings about which they are uncertain.
items.zh: 使用纸质或电子词典、词汇表，检查并改正不确定的拼写。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Understand the basic rules of English grammar and conventions when writing or speaking.
items.zh: 在写作或口语中理解英语语法和语言规范的基本规则。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Know the following parts of speech and how they are used: nouns, pronouns, verbs (action verbs and auxiliary or helping verbs: can, could, may, must, ought, shall, should), adjectives (including articles), adverbs, conjunctions (and, but, or), interjections.
items.zh: 掌握下列词性及其用法：名词、代词、动词（实义动词和助动词/情态动词：can、could、may、must、ought、shall、should）、形容词（包括冠词）、副词、连词（and、but、or）、感叹词。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use relative pronouns (who, whose, whom, which, that) and relative adverbs (where, when, why).
items.zh: 使用关系代词（who、whose、whom、which、that）和关系副词（where、when、why）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Form and use the progressive (e.g., I was running; I am running; I will be running) verb tenses.
items.zh: 构成并使用进行时动词时态（如 I was running；I am running；I will be running）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Form and use prepositional phrases.
items.zh: 构成并使用介词短语。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Understand what a complete sentence is and
items.zh: 理解什么是完整的句子，并

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: identify subject and predicate in single-clause sentences.
items.zh: 在单句（单分句）中识别主语和谓语。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: distinguish complete sentences from fragments.
items.zh: 区分完整句子与残缺句（片段）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: identify and correct run-on sentences.
items.zh: 识别并改正连写句（一逗到底的句子）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Produce complete sentences.
items.zh: 写出完整的句子。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Identify subject and verb in a sentence and understand that they must agree.
items.zh: 识别句子中的主语和动词，并理解二者必须保持一致。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Correctly use frequently confused words (e.g., to, too, two; there, their, they’re).
items.zh: 正确使用容易混淆的词（如 to、too、two；there、their、they're）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Understand and apply the basic rules of capitalization and punctuation when writing or speaking.
items.zh: 在写作或口语中理解并运用大小写和标点的基本规则。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use capital letters correctly, including at the beginning of sentences, when using proper nouns, and for words in titles.
items.zh: 正确使用大写字母，包括句首、专有名词和标题中的单词。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Correctly use commas and quotation marks when writing dialogue.
items.zh: 写对话时正确使用逗号和引号。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Correctly use quotation marks when quoting from a source.
items.zh: 引用资料时正确使用引号。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use a comma before a coordinating conjunction (and, but, for, nor, or, so, yet) in a compound sentence.
items.zh: 在并列句中，并列连词（and、but、for、nor、or、so、yet）前使用逗号。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Effectively use synonyms and antonyms.
items.zh: 有效地使用同义词和反义词。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use context clues to figure out the meaning of words and phrases in a sentence.
items.zh: 利用上下文线索推断句中单词和短语的含义。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Know how to look for synonyms and antonyms in nearby words to use as context clues.
items.zh: 知道如何在附近的词中寻找同义词和反义词作为上下文线索。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Know how to look for examples and definitions in nearby words to use as context clues.
items.zh: 知道如何在附近的词中寻找例子和定义作为上下文线索。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Understand words by thinking of them in terms of other words that mean the same (synonyms) or opposite (antonyms); understand degrees of difference, degrees of similarity, and degrees of contrast in word choices.
items.zh: 通过意思相同（同义词）或相反（反义词）的其他词来理解单词；理解选词中差异、相似和对比的程度。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use knowledge of Greek and Latin roots and affixes to figure out the meaning of a new word (e.g., autograph, photograph).
items.zh: 利用希腊语和拉丁语词根及词缀知识推断新词的含义（如 autograph、photograph）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use a dictionary or glossary, print or digital, to answer questions about the meanings and usage of unfamiliar words.
items.zh: 使用纸质或电子词典、词汇表，回答有关陌生词含义和用法的问题。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Know how to use a dictionary, print or digital, to pronounce words correctly.
items.zh: 知道如何使用纸质或电子词典来正确发音。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use a dictionary to find the precise meaning of words and phrases.
items.zh: 使用词典查找单词和短语的确切含义。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Differentiate between literal and figurative word choices, including basic similes and metaphors, as in the phrases “brave as a lion” and “raining cats and dogs.”
items.zh: 区分字面用法和比喻性用词，包括基本的明喻和暗喻，如“brave as a lion”（勇猛如狮）和“raining cats and dogs”（倾盆大雨）。

items.subject: English Language Arts

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: The poems listed here constitute a selected core of poetry for this grade. You are encouraged to expose students to more poetry, old and new, and to have students write their own poems. To bring students into the spirit of poetry, read it aloud and encourage them to read it aloud so they can experience the music in the words. At this grade, poetry should be a source of delight; technical analysis should be delayed until later grades.
items.zh: 此处列出的诗歌构成本年级精选的核心诗篇。鼓励学生接触更多诗歌，无论古今，并让学生自己写诗。为带领学生进入诗歌的意境，请大声朗读，并鼓励学生也大声朗读，让他们体会文字中的韵律之美。在本年级，诗歌应当成为快乐的源泉；技巧性的分析应留到以后的年级再进行。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: In fourth grade, students should be fluent, competent readers of appropriate materials. Decoding skills should be automatic, allowing the students to focus on meaning. Regular practice in reading aloud and independent silent reading should continue. Students should read outside of school at least 20 minutes daily.

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Every culture has phrases and proverbs that make no sense when carried over literally into another culture. For many students, this section may not be needed; they will have picked up these sayings by hearing them at home and among friends. But the sayings have been one of the categories most appreciated by teachers who work with students from home cultures that differ from the standard culture of literate American English. An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure. As the crow flies Beauty is only skin deep. The bigger they are, the harder they fall. Birds of a feather flock together. Blow hot and cold Break the ice Bull in a china shop Bury the hatchet Can’t hold a candle to Don’t count your chickens before they hatch. Don’t put all your eggs in one basket. Etc. Go to pot Half a loaf is better than none. Haste makes waste. Laugh and the world laughs with you. Lightning never strikes twice in the same place. Live and let live. Make ends meet. Make hay while the sun shines. Money burning a hole in your pocket Once in a blue moon One picture is worth a thousand words. On the warpath RSVP Run-of-the-mill Seeing is believing. Shipshape Through thick and thin Timbuktu Two wrongs don’t make a right. When it rains, it pours. You can lead a horse to water, but you can’t make it drink.
items.zh: 每种文化都有一些短语和谚语，直译到另一种文化中就会失去意义。对许多学生而言，这部分可能并非必需；他们在家里和朋友交往中早已听过这些说法。但对于那些面对家庭文化与标准美式书面英语文化不同的学生的老师来说，这类俗语一直是最受好评的内容之一。An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure.（一分预防胜于十分治疗。）As the crow flies（直线距离）Beauty is only skin deep.（美貌只是肤浅的外表。）The bigger they are, the harder they fall.（爬得越高，摔得越重。）Birds of a feather flock together.（物以类聚。）Blow hot and cold（反复无常）Break the ice（打破僵局）Bull in a china shop（莽撞闯祸的人）Bury the hatchet（言归于好）Can't hold a candle to（远远比不上）Don't count your chickens before they hatch.（别高兴得太早。）Don't put all your eggs in one basket.（不要孤注一掷。）Etc.（等等）Go to pot（走下坡路）Half a loaf is better than none.（聊胜于无。）Haste makes waste.（欲速则不达。）Laugh and the world laughs with you.（笑口常开，好运自来。）Lightning never strikes twice in the same place.（同一地点不会两次遭雷劈。）Live and let live.（己所不欲，勿施于人。）Make ends meet.（量入为出。）Make hay while the sun shines.（趁热打铁。）Money burning a hole in your pocket（有钱就忍不住花）Once in a blue moon（千载难逢）One picture is worth a thousand words.（一图胜千言。）On the warpath（气势汹汹）RSVP（请回复）Run-of-the-mill（平平无奇）Seeing is believing.（眼见为实。）Shipshape（井井有条）Through thick and thin（同甘共苦）Timbuktu（遥远的地方）Two wrongs don't make a right.（以错纠错还是错。）When it rains, it pours.（祸不单行。）You can lead a horse to water, but you can't make it drink.（牵马到水边易，逼马喝水难。）

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Teachers: The study of geography embraces many topics throughout the Core Knowledge Sequence, including topics in history and science. Geographic knowledge includes a spatial sense of the world, an awareness of the physical processes that shape life, a sense of the interactions between humans and their environment, an understanding of the relations between place and culture, and an awareness of the characteristics of specific regions and cultures. Many geographic topics are listed below in connection with historical topics.
items.zh: 教师：地理学贯穿核心知识序列中的许多主题，包括历史和科学主题。地理知识包括对世界的空间感、对塑造生活的自然过程的认识、对人类与环境相互作用的理解、对地方与文化关系的理解，以及对特定地区和文化特征的认识。下面列出许多与历史主题相关的地理主题。

items.en: Examine some of the basic values and principles of American democracy, in both theory and practice, as defined in the Declaration of Independence and the U. S. Constitution, both in historical context and in terms of present-day practice. In examining the significance of the U. S. Constitution, introduce students to the unique nature of the American experiment, the difficult task of establishing a democratic government, the compromises the framers of the Constitution were willing to make, and the persistent threats to success. In order to appreciate the boldness and fragility of the American attempt to establish a republican government based on a constitution, students should know that republican governments were rare at this time. Discuss with students basic questions and issues about government, such as: Why do societies need government? Why does a society need laws? Who makes the laws in the United States? What might happen in the absence of government and laws?
items.zh: 考察《独立宣言》和美国宪法所界定的美国民主的基本价值观和原则，既要从理论和实践两方面，也要结合历史背景和当今实践。在考察美国宪法的意义时，向学生介绍美国这一独特实验的性质、建立民主政府的艰难任务、宪法制定者愿意做出的妥协，以及持续存在的成功威胁。为了让学生体会美国试图建立以宪法为基础的共和政体的大胆与脆弱，学生应了解当时共和政体十分罕见。与学生讨论有关政府的基本问题和议题，例如：社会为什么需要政府？社会为什么需要法律？美国由谁制定法律？如果没有政府和法律，可能会发生什么？

items.subject: Visual Arts
items.en: Teachers: In schools, lessons on the visual arts should illustrate important elements of making and appreciating art, and emphasize important artists, works of art, and artistic concepts. When appropriate, topics in the visual arts may be linked to topics in other disciplines. The following guidelines specify a variety of artwork in different media and from various cultures in order to expose students to a wide range of art and artists. While the list is robust, it may require teachers to narrow the selection in order to adequately address the works and related skills within an academic year. In studying the works of art specified below, and in creating their own art, students should review, develop, and apply concepts introduced in previous grades, such as line, shape, form, space, texture, color, light, design, and symmetry
items.zh: 教师提示：在学校的视觉艺术课程中，应阐明创作与鉴赏艺术的重要元素，并强调重要的艺术家、艺术作品和艺术概念。在适当的时候，视觉艺术主题可与其他学科的主题相联系。以下指导原则列出了不同媒介、不同文化的多种艺术作品，以让学生接触广泛的艺术和艺术家。这份清单虽然丰富，但教师可能需要缩小选择范围，以便在一个学年内充分讲清这些作品及相关技能。在学习下列艺术作品和创作自己的作品时，学生应复习、发展并运用前几个年级引入的概念，如线条、形状、形体、空间、肌理、色彩、光线、设计和对称。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Teachers: In schools, lessons on music should feature activities and works that illustrate important musical concepts and terms, and should introduce important composers and works. When appropriate, topics in music may be linked to topics in other disciplines. The following guidelines focus on content, not performance skills, though many concepts are best learned through active practice (singing, clapping rhythms, playing instruments, etc.).
items.zh: 教师：学校的音乐课应包含能够体现重要音乐概念和术语的活动与作品，并应介绍重要作曲家和作品。在适当的时候，音乐主题可以与其他学科主题相联系。以下指导方针侧重内容而非表演技能，不过许多概念最好通过积极实践来学习（唱歌、拍节奏、演奏乐器等）。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Through participation, become familiar with basic elements of music (rhythm, melody, harmony, form, timbre, etc.).
items.zh: 通过参与，熟悉音乐的基本要素（节奏、旋律、和声、曲式、音色等）。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Recognize a steady beat, accents, and the downbeat; play a steady beat and a simple rhythm pattern.
items.zh: 识别稳定的拍子、重音和强拍；能打出稳定的拍子和简单的节奏型。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Discriminate between fast and slow; gradually slowing down and getting faster.

items.subject: Music
items.en: Discriminate between differences in pitch: high and low.

items.subject: Music
items.en: Discriminate between loud and soft; gradually increasing and decreasing volume.
items.zh: 区分响与轻；能逐渐增强和减弱音量。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Understand legato (smoothly flowing progression of notes) and staccato (crisp distinct notes).
items.zh: 理解连奏（音符平滑流畅地衔接）和断奏（清晰分离的音符）。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Sing unaccompanied, accompanied, and in unison.
items.zh: 能无伴奏演唱、有伴奏演唱，以及齐唱。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Recognize harmony; sing simple rounds (e.g., I Love the Mountains, Ah, Poor Bird) and canons.
items.zh: 识别和声；演唱简单的轮唱曲（如《我爱群山》《啊，可怜的鸟》）和卡农。

items.subject: Music
items.en: Recognize verse and refrain; also, introduction and coda.

items.subject: Music

items.subject: Music
items.en: Recognize theme and variations, and listen to Mozart, Variations on “Ah! vous dirai-je Maman” (familiarly known as “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star”).

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Teachers: Mathematics has its own vocabulary and patterns of thinking. It is a discipline with its own language and conventions. Thus, while some lessons may offer occasional opportunities for linking mathematics to other disciplines, it is critically important to attend to math as math. From the earliest years, mathematics requires incremental review and steady practice: not only the diligent effort required to master basic facts and operations, but also thoughtful and varied practice that approaches problems from a variety of angles, and gives students a variety of opportunities to apply the same concept or operation in different types of situations. While it is important to work toward the development of “higher-order problem-solving skills,” it is equally important—indeed, it is prerequisite to achieving “higher order” skills—to have a sound grasp of basic facts, and an automatic fluency with fundamental operations.
items.zh: 教师须知：数学有其自身的词汇和思维方式，是一门有自己语言和规范的学科。因此，虽然有些课程偶尔可以把数学与其他学科联系起来，但把数学当作数学来讲至关重要。从最初几年起，数学就需要循序渐进的复习和持续练习：既要努力掌握基本事实和运算，也要进行深思熟虑、形式多样的练习，从多种角度处理问题，让学生在不同类型的情境中多次运用同一概念或运算。虽然培养“高阶解题技能”很重要，但牢固掌握基本事实、对基本运算达到自动化熟练程度同样重要——事实上，这是达到“高阶”技能的前提。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Teachers: Effective instruction in science requires hands-on experience and observation. In the words of the report from the National Academies of Science, A Framework for K-12 Science Education, “...children have surprisingly sophisticated ways of thinking about the world, based in part on their direct experiences with the physical environment, such as watching objects fall or collide and observing plants and animals. They also learn about the world through everyday activities, such as talking with their families, pursuing hobbies, watching television, and playing with friends. As children try to understand and influence the world around them, they develop ideas about their role in that world and how it works. In fact, the capacity of young children—from all backgrounds and socioeconomic levels—to reason in sophisticated ways is much greater than has long been assumed. Although they may lack deep knowledge and extensive experience, they often engage in a wide range of subtle and complex reasoning about the world. Thus, before they even enter school, children have developed their own ideas about the physical, biological, and social worlds and how they work. By listening to and taking these ideas seriously, educators can build on what children already know and can do.”
items.zh: 教师须知：有效的科学教学需要动手体验和观察。用美国国家科学院报告《K-12 科学教育框架》的话来说：“……孩子们以令人惊讶的复杂方式思考世界，这部分基于他们对物质环境的直接体验，比如观看物体下落或碰撞、观察动植物。他们也通过日常活动了解世界，比如与家人交谈、从事爱好、看电视、和朋友玩耍。当孩子们试图理解和影响周围的世界时，他们会形成关于自己在世界中的角色以及世界如何运作的想法。事实上，幼儿——无论来自何种背景、何种社会经济水平——进行复杂推理的能力远超长期以来的设想。尽管他们可能缺乏深入知识和丰富经验，但他们常常对世界进行广泛而细致的复杂推理。因此，甚至在入学之前，孩子们就已经对物理、生物和社会世界及其运作方式形成了自己的想法。通过倾听并认真对待这些想法，教育者可以在儿童已有知识和能力的基础上进行教学。”

items.subject: Science
items.en: The emphasis in Grade 4 should be on observation, description, and explanation of real world applications of energy; technical explanations of energy transfer and transformation should be taken up in later grades; see Grades 5, 6, and 8 for an increasingly detailed study of energy:
