items.en: Understand solving an equation or inequality as a process of answering a question: which values from a specified set, if any, make the equation or inequality true?
items.zh: 把解方程或不等式理解为回答一个问题的过程：在指定的集合中，哪些值（如果有）能使方程或不等式成立？

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Use substitution to determine whether a given number in a specified set makes an equation or inequality true.
items.zh: 用代入法判断指定集合中的某个数是否能使方程或不等式成立。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Use variables to represent numbers and write expressions when solving a real-world or mathematical problem.
items.zh: 在解决实际或数学问题时，用变量表示数并写出表达式。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Understand that a variable can represent an unknown number, or, depending on the purpose at hand, any number in a specified set.
items.zh: 理解变量可以代表一个未知数，或者根据当前目的，代表指定集合中的任意一个数。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Solve real-world and mathematical problems by writing and solving equations of them form x + p = q and px = q for cases in which p, q and x are all nonnegative rational numbers. Equivalent expressions = when the two expressions name the same number regardless of which value is substituted into them.
items.zh: 通过写出并求解 x + p = q 和 px = q 形式的方程来解决实际与数学问题（其中 p、q、x 均为非负有理数）。等价表达式＝无论代入什么值，两个表达式表示的都是同一个数。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Write an inequality of the form x > c or x < c to represent a constraint or condition in a real-world or mathematical problem.
items.zh: 写出 x > c 或 x < c 形式的不等式，表示实际或数学问题中的约束或条件。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Recognize that inequalities of the form x > c or x < c have infinitely many solutions; represent solutions of such inequalities on number line diagrams.
items.zh: 认识到 x > c 或 x < c 形式的不等式有无穷多个解；在数轴图上表示这类不等式的解。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Represent and analyze quantitative relationships between dependent and independent variables.
items.zh: 表示并分析因变量与自变量之间的数量关系。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Use variables to represent two quantities in a real-world problem that change in relationship to one another write an equation to express one quantity.
items.zh: 用变量表示实际问题中相互关联的两个量，写出一个表达式表示其中一个量。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Thought of as the dependent variable, in terms of the other quantity, thought of as the independent variable.
items.zh: 把它看作因变量，用另一个量（看作自变量）来表示。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Analyze the relationship between the dependent and independent variables using graphs and tables, and relate these to the equation.
items.zh: 用图表和表格分析因变量与自变量之间的关系，并把它们与方程联系起来。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Solve real-world and mathematical problems involving area, surface area, and volume.
items.zh: 解决涉及面积、表面积和体积的实际问题与数学问题。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Find the area of right triangles, other triangles, special quadrilaterals, and polygons by decomposing into triangles or other shapes.
items.zh: 通过把直角三角形、其他三角形、特殊四边形和多边形分割成三角形或其他图形，求它们的面积。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Find the volume of a right rectangular prism with fractional edge lengths.
items.zh: 求棱长为分数的直长方体的体积。
details: Show that the volume is the same as would be found by multiplying the edge lengths of the prism.
Apply the formulas Volume = length x width x height (V=l x w x h) and Volume = base x height (V=b x h) to find volumes of right rectangular prisms with fractional edge lengths.

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Draw polygons in the coordinate plane given coordinates for the vertices.
items.zh: 已知顶点坐标，在坐标平面上画出多边形。
details: Use coordinates to find the length of a side joining points with the same first coordinate or the same second coordinate.

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Represent three-dimensional figures using nets made up of rectangles and triangles, and use the nets to find the surface area of these figures.
items.zh: 用由长方形和三角形组成的展开图表示三维图形，并利用展开图求这些图形的表面积。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Develop understanding of statistical variability.
items.zh: 发展对统计变异性的理解。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Recognize a statistical question as one that anticipates variability in the data related to the question and accounts for it in the answers.
items.zh: 认识到统计问题是指能预判与该问题相关的数据存在变异性，并在答案中体现这种变异性的问题。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Understand that a set of data collected to answer a statistical question has a distribution which can be described by its center, spread, and overall shape.
items.zh: 理解为回答统计问题而收集的一组数据具有一个分布，可以用其中心、离散程度和整体形状来描述。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Recognize that a measure of center for a numerical data set summarizes all of its values with a single number, while a measure of variation describes how its values vary with a single number.
items.zh: 认识到数值数据集的集中趋势度量用一个数概括其所有取值，而变异程度度量用一个数描述其取值的差异情况。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Summarize and describe distributions.
items.zh: 概括并描述分布。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Display numerical data in plots on a number line, including dot plots, histograms, and box plots.
items.zh: 把数值数据用数轴上的图表示，包括点图、直方图和箱线图。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Summarize numerical data sets in relation to their context, such as by:
items.zh: 结合背景概括数值数据集，例如：
details: Reporting the number of observations.
Describing the nature of the attribute under investigation, including how it was measured and its units of measurement.

Giving quantitative measures of center (median and/or mean) and variability (interquartile range and/or mean absolute deviation), as well as describing any overall pattern and any striking deviations from the overall pattern with reference to the context in which the data were gathered.

Relating the choice of measures of center and variability to the shape of the data distribution and the context in which the data were gathered. Apply these techniques in the context of solving real-world and mathematical problems.

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Pack the right rectangular prism with unit cubes of the appropriate unit fraction edge lengths.
items.zh: 用棱长为适当单位分数的小立方体填充直长方体。
details: Reporting the number of observations.
Describing the nature of the attribute under investigation, including how it was measured and its units of measurement.

Giving quantitative measures of center (median and/or mean) and variability (interquartile range and/or mean absolute deviation), as well as describing any overall pattern and any striking deviations from the overall pattern with reference to the context in which the data were gathered.

Relating the choice of measures of center and variability to the shape of the data distribution and the context in which the data were gathered. Apply these techniques in the context of solving real-world and mathematical problems.

items.subject: Science
items.en: Teachers: Effective instruction in science requires not only hands-on experience and observation but also book learning, which helps bring coherence and order to a student’s scientific knowledge. only when topics are presented systematically and clearly can students make steady and secure progress in their scientific learning. The Science sequence for the middle school grades aims for more intensive and selective study of topics, a number of which were introduced in earlier grades. It also continues the practice of studying topics from each of the major realms of science (physical, life, and earth science). Students are expected to do experiments and write reports on their findings.
items.zh: 教师提示：有效的科学教学不仅需要有动手体验和观察，还需要书本学习，后者有助于使学生的科学知识连贯有序。只有系统而清晰地呈现主题，学生才能在科学学习上稳步而扎实地进步。中学各年级的科学序列旨在对若干主题进行更深入、更有选择性的学习，其中一些主题在更早的年级已经引入。它还延续了从科学的各大领域（物理科学、生命科学和地球科学）分别学习主题的做法。学生应做实验并撰写实验报告，汇报发现。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Light can be reflected, absorbed, refracted, or transmitted.
items.zh: 光可以被反射、吸收、折射或透射。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Refraction:
items.zh: 折射：
details: Slowing down of light as it passes through matter
Refraction from the glass in lenses is useful in devices for television, photography, and astronomy.

items.subject: Science
items.en: Reflection:
items.zh: 反射：
details: Light from a flashlight reflects off a mirror at the exact angle the light hits the mirror.
Lenses can be concave or convex, changing the angle of reflection, used in many practical devices.
Sometimes we can see both through a window and see a reflection at the same time.

items.subject: Science
items.en: Any movement of an electrically charged particle produces an electromagnetic wave.
items.zh: 带电粒子的任何运动都会产生电磁波。

items.subject: Science
items.en: This wave alternates between the establishment of an electrical field and a magnetic field.
items.zh: 这种波在电场与磁场的建立之间交替变化。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Some waves, such as sound and water, transfer energy through matter, but electromagnetic radiation travels through empty space as well as through some kinds of matter.
items.zh: 有些波，如声波和水波，通过物质传递能量，而电磁辐射既能在真空中传播，也能在某些物质中传播。

items.subject: Science
items.en: All electromagnetic waves have the same speed in a vacuum, about 300,000 kilometers per second or 186,000 miles per second; labeled c.
items.zh: 所有电磁波在真空中的速度相同，约为每秒300,000公里或每秒186,000英里；记作 c。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Electromagnetic waves carry energy through space and are used to transmit information, e.g., through devices such as radio, television, cellular phones, and Bluetooth technology.
items.zh: 电磁波携带能量穿过太空，用于传递信息，例如通过收音机、电视、手机和蓝牙技术等设备。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Electromagnetic waves vary in their frequency, resulting in a continuous spectrum of waves, called the electromagnetic spectrum.
items.zh: 电磁波的频率各不相同，形成连续的波谱，称为电磁波谱。

items.subject: Science
items.en: The longest wavelengths on the spectrum: radio waves
items.zh: 波谱中波长最长的波：无线电波

items.subject: Science
items.en: Shorter wavelengths: microwaves, infrared waves, visible light, ultraviolet light, X rays, and gamma rays
items.zh: 较短的波长：微波、红外线、可见光、紫外线、X射线和伽马射线

items.subject: Science
items.en: Visible light is the small portion of the electromagnetic spectrum that we see.
items.zh: 可见光是电磁波谱中我们能看见的一小部分。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Visible light ranges along the spectrum: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, to violet.
items.zh: 可见光在波谱中的范围：红、橙、黄、绿、蓝，直到紫。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Definition of energy
items.zh: 能量的定义

items.subject: Science
items.en: Forms of energy
items.zh: 能量的形式

items.subject: Science
items.en: Kinetic and potential energy
items.zh: 动能与势能

items.subject: Science
items.en: Forms of energy can be transformed into one another:
items.zh: 各种形式的能量可以相互转化：

items.subject: Science
items.en: The energy of sound waves → mechanical energy of breaking glass
items.zh: 声波的能量 → 击碎玻璃的机械能

items.subject: Science
items.en: The energy of light waves hitting a solar panel → into electrical energy
items.zh: 照射到太阳能板上的光波能量 → 转化为电能

items.subject: Science
items.en: The chemical energy → into fireworks
items.zh: 化学能 → 转化为烟花的能量

items.subject: Science
items.en: Joules: metric unit measure
items.zh: 焦耳：公制计量单位

items.subject: Science
items.en: Thermal energy
items.zh: 热能

items.subject: Science
items.en: Understanding how heat passes through, or is kept from passing though, the walls of a container can give us evidence of the movement of thermal energy.
items.zh: 了解热量如何穿过容器壁或被容器壁阻隔，能为我们提供热能运动的证据。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Scientific meaning of heat is the movement of thermal energy from one place to another.
items.zh: 热在科学上的含义是热能从一地转移到另一地。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Temperature: related to how rapidly particles are moving
items.zh: 温度：与粒子运动的快慢有关

items.subject: Science
items.en: Conduction, convection, and radiation: ways thermal energy is transferred
items.zh: 传导、对流和辐射：热能传递的方式

items.subject: Science
items.en: The passive direction of heat transfer is hotter to colder.
items.zh: 热量传递的自发方向是从热到冷。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Role of heating of the earth in establishing air and ocean currents
items.zh: 地球受热在形成气流和洋流中的作用

items.subject: Science
items.en: How ocean currents such as the Gulf Stream and Kuroshio are kept in motion
items.zh: 像墨西哥湾流和黑潮这样的洋流是如何保持运动的

items.subject: Science
items.en: Variations of ocean temperatures and salinity help drive ocean currents.
items.zh: 海洋温度和盐度的变化有助于驱动洋流。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Definition and causes of weather
items.zh: 天气的定义及成因

items.subject: Science
items.en: Definition and cause of air masses
items.zh: 气团的定义及成因

items.subject: Science
items.en: Role of air masses in changing weather conditions
items.zh: 气团在天气变化中的作用

items.subject: Science
items.en: Colliding air masses can cause sudden changes in the weather.
items.zh: 气团相撞会导致天气突变。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Weather conditions: air temperature, air pressure, humidity, precipitation, warm and cold weather fronts, wind speed and direction
items.zh: 天气状况：气温、气压、湿度、降水、暖锋与冷锋、风速与风向

items.subject: Science
items.en: Weather data can be obtained by visual observation, instruments on the earth, radar, weather balloons, and satellites.
items.zh: 天气数据可通过目测观察、地面仪器、雷达、气象气球和卫星获得。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Examination of weather patterns can lead to weather prediction.
items.zh: 对天气模式的研究可以带来天气预报。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Definition of climate
items.zh: 气候的定义

items.subject: Science
items.en: Climate conditions—how long they last and how they change over time
items.zh: 气候状况——它们持续多久以及如何随时间变化

items.subject: Science
items.en: The Koppen system
items.zh: 柯本气候分类法

items.subject: Science
items.en: Familiar climates: tundra, rainforest, temperate, desert, and humid continental
items.zh: 熟悉的气候类型：苔原、雨林、温带、沙漠和湿润大陆性气候

items.subject: Science
items.en: Climate from millions of years ago can be determined by various scientific methods.
items.zh: 数百万年前的气候可以通过多种科学方法确定。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Definition and causes of the water (hydrologic) cycle
items.zh: 水（水文）循环的定义及成因

items.subject: Science
items.en: Diagram all parts of the water cycle
items.zh: 画出水循环所有组成部分的示意图

items.subject: Science
items.en: Relationship to weather
items.zh: 与天气的关系

items.subject: Science
items.en: Formation of the sun, Earth, and other planets
items.zh: 太阳、地球及其他行星的形成

items.subject: Science
items.en: Makeup and thickness of Earth’s crust and mantle
items.zh: 地壳与地幔的组成及厚度

items.subject: Science
items.en: Earth’s outer and inner cores
items.zh: 地球的外核与内核

items.subject: Science
items.en: The cycling of Earth’s materials as exemplified by the rock cycle
items.zh: 以岩石循环为例说明地球物质的循环

items.subject: Science
items.en: Mountains rise and fall.
items.zh: 山脉有升有降。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Volcanoes
items.zh: 火山

items.subject: Science
items.en: Earthquakes
items.zh: 地震

items.subject: Science
items.en: Large areas of Earth move over time.
items.zh: 地球的广大区域随时间推移而移动。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Effect of plate tectonics on the surface of Earth
items.zh: 板块构造对地球表面的影响

items.subject: Science
items.en: Causes and speed of the movement of the plates
items.zh: 板块运动的原因和速度

items.subject: Science
items.en: Evidence for long-term movement of plates: fit of continents and matches of rock types, fossils, ocean floor age, topography, ancient climate zones, locations of earthquakes, volcanoes, mountain ranges, and magnetic directions in ancient rocks
items.zh: 板块长期运动的证据：大陆的吻合、岩性的匹配、化石、海底年龄、地形、古气候带、地震、火山、山脉的位置，以及古代岩石中的磁极方向

items.subject: Science
items.en: The continents were once joined into a continent called Pangaea.
items.zh: 各大洲曾经连在一起，形成一个名为盘古大陆（Pangaea）的大陆。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Tsunamis are caused most often by earthquakes.
items.zh: 海啸最常由地震引发。

items.subject: Science
items.en: People can predict the movement of tsunamis and thereby prepare for their arrivals and reduce damage to people and property.
items.zh: 人们可以预测海啸的移动，从而为其到来做好准备，减少人员和财产损失。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Landslides often happen quickly and can be massive movements of soil and rocks that can inflict major damage to roads and homes.
items.zh: 山体滑坡往往发生迅速，可能是土壤和岩石的大规模运动，会对道路和房屋造成重大破坏。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Floods, including flash floods, are a major hazard in many parts of the world.
items.zh: 洪水，包括山洪暴发，是世界上许多地区的主要灾害。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Definition of fronts, and their role in creation of hazardous weather
items.zh: 锋面的定义及其在危险天气形成中的作用

items.subject: Science
items.en: Atmospheric conditions that lead to hurricanes (cyclones)
items.zh: 导致飓风（气旋）的大气条件

items.subject: Science
items.en: Importance of accurate weather predictions in planning for severe weather conditions
items.zh: 准确天气预报在应对恶劣天气的规划中的重要性

items.subject: Science
items.en: Earthquakes caused by stress of plate boundaries moving against each other.
items.zh: 板块边界相互挤压产生的应力引发地震。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Earthquake vibrations cause waves.
items.zh: 地震的振动产生波。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Focus: the point below the surface where the quake begins
items.zh: 震源：地表以下地震开始的位置

items.subject: Science
items.en: Epicenter: the point on the surface above the focus
items.zh: 震中：地表上位于震源正上方的点

items.subject: Science
items.en: Richter scale
items.zh: 里氏震级

items.subject: Science
items.en: Most volcanoes are caused by plate boundaries pulling apart or coming together.
items.zh: 大多数火山是由板块边界张裂或碰撞造成的。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Some caused by plates moving over hot spots (e.g., the Hawaiian Islands)
items.zh: 有些是由板块在热点上方移动形成（如夏威夷群岛）

items.subject: Science
items.en: Cells are the basis of all living things.
items.zh: 细胞是一切生物的基础。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Differences between unicellular and multicellular organisms
items.zh: 单细胞生物与多细胞生物的区别

items.subject: Science
items.en: Types and function of cellular membranes
items.zh: 细胞膜的类型与功能

items.subject: Science
items.en: Membranes, cytoplasm, and organelle are cell components.
items.zh: 膜、细胞质和细胞器都是细胞的组成部分。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Cell organelles include the nucleus, mitochondria, and chloroplasts.
items.zh: 细胞器包括细胞核、线粒体和叶绿体。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Chromosomes and their role in cell function and reproduction
items.zh: 染色体及其在细胞功能与繁殖中的作用

items.subject: Science
items.en: DNA,
items.zh: DNA（脱氧核糖核酸）

items.subject: Science
items.en: Mutations
items.zh: 突变

items.subject: Science
items.en: Role of cell division in growth and reproduction
items.zh: 细胞分裂在生长与繁殖中的作用

items.subject: Science
items.en: Types of cell division
items.zh: 细胞分裂的类型

items.subject: Science
items.en: Mitosis
items.zh: 有丝分裂

items.subject: Science
items.en: Meiosis and its association with sexual reproduction.
items.zh: 减数分裂及其与有性繁殖的关联。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Sexual reproduction involves meiosis and the fusion of gametes (egg and sperm).
items.zh: 有性繁殖涉及减数分裂和配子（卵子与精子）的融合。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Sexual reproduction allows for variation between parent and offspring due to crossing over, mutations, and other factors.
items.zh: 由于染色体交叉互换、突变及其他因素，有性繁殖使亲代与子代之间产生差异。

items.subject: Science
items.en: A group of similar cells usually performing one function is called a tissue.
items.zh: 一群相似、通常执行某一功能的细胞称为组织。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Tissues work together to form organs in both plants and animals.
items.zh: 在植物和动物体内，组织共同协作形成器官。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Organs work together to form organ systems, such as the muscular and skeletal system of humans.
items.zh: 器官共同协作形成器官系统，如人类的肌肉系统和骨骼系统。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Marie Curie — discoveries in radioactivity, and the elements polonium and radium
items.zh: 玛丽·居里——放射性方面的发现，以及钋和镭元素

items.subject: Science
items.en: Lewis Howard Latimer — aided in inventions of telephone and light bulb
items.zh: 刘易斯·霍华德·拉蒂默——协助发明了电话和白炽灯

items.subject: Science
items.en: Isaac Newton — nature of motion and laws of gravity
items.zh: 艾萨克·牛顿——运动的本质与万有引力定律

items.subject: Science
items.en: Alfred Wegener — Pangaea and the science of continental drift
items.zh: 阿尔弗雷德·魏格纳——泛大陆与大陆漂移学说

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Actively participate in discussions about a variety of Grade 7 topics, ideas, and texts in a variety of settings, including partners, small and large groups, and teacher-led groups.
items.zh: 在多种场合（包括两人结对、小组、大组和教师主导的小组）积极参与关于七年级各种主题、观点和文本的讨论。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Prepare for discussions in advance, including researching the topic and organizing information for the discussion. Draw on preparations during the discussion to analyze ideas and explore the topic further.
items.zh: 提前为讨论做准备，包括研究主题和整理讨论所需信息；在讨论中运用这些准备来分析观点并进一步探讨主题。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Manage goals and deadlines, and define specific roles appropriate to a discussion; follow rules for productive social engagement among peers.
items.zh: 管理目标和时限，明确适合讨论的具体角色；遵守同伴之间富有成效的互动规则。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Ask relevant questions to clarify conversations and ideas and to build upon remarks made by others.
items.zh: 提出相关问题，以澄清谈话和想法，并在他人发言的基础上进一步展开。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use details to elaborate and comment on a topic, text, or issue being discussed; add insight to discussions or move discussions forward.
items.zh: 运用细节对所讨论的主题、文本或问题进行阐述和评论；为讨论增添见解或推动讨论深入。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Demonstrate a willingness to change one’s own point of view when presented with new information during a discussion.
items.zh: 在讨论中接触到新信息时，表现出愿意改变自己观点的态度。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Interpret information from an array of media formats, such as visual (paintings, pictures, and animations), quantitative (graphs, charts, and diagrams), videos, and recordings.
items.zh: 解读多种媒体形式呈现的信息，如视觉类（绘画、图片和动画）、数据类（曲线图、图表和示意图）、视频以及录音。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Explain how information from media formats reflects, enhances, or is otherwise suitable to the discussion, issue, or topic at hand.
items.zh: 说明媒体形式的信息如何反映、增强或以其他方式契合当前的讨论、问题或主题。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Find and analyze the main ideas and details in information from multimedia formats.
items.zh: 找出并分析多媒体信息中的主旨和细节。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Explain a speaker’s argument, distinguishing the claims, evidence, and reasons speakers give and whether the claims are adequately supported.
items.zh: 解释说话者的论点，区分其提出的主张、证据和理由，并判断这些主张是否得到充分支持。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Evaluate the overall quality of the reasoning used in an argument and the relevancy of the evidence provided.
items.zh: 评估论证中推理的整体质量以及所提供证据的相关性。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Give a presentation about a topic or text, tell a story, or orally relate a personal experience in a logical and organized manner, including relevant descriptions, details, and facts that support main ideas or themes.
items.zh: 以条理清晰、逻辑严密的方式就某一主题或文本作报告、讲故事或口头讲述个人经历，包括支持主要观点或主题的相关描述、细节和事实。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Orally present a claim-based argument that is supported by research and demonstrates a focused emphasis on the essential points.
items.zh: 口头陈述以主张为核心、有研究支撑的论证，并突出强调要点。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Speak clearly at an understandable volume and pace; maintain eye contact.
items.zh: 以清晰、易于理解的音量和语速讲话；保持眼神交流。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Enhance presentations by adding relevant multimedia such as displays, images, videos, graphics, music, and recordings.
items.zh: 通过添加相关的多媒体（如演示文稿、图片、视频、图形、音乐和录音）来增强展示效果。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Switch between formal and informal English as appropriate to the situation or task; adapt speech to a variety of contexts.
items.zh: 根据情境或任务在正式与非正式英语之间恰当切换；使言语适应各种语境。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Show proficiency when using formal English, such as standard pronunciation when giving speeches or speaking to large groups and in formal circumstances, such as a job interview.
items.zh: 在使用正式英语时表现出熟练能力，例如在演讲、面对大群人讲话或在求职面试等正式场合使用标准发音。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Independently and proficiently read and comprehend longer works of fiction (stories, plays, and poems) and literary nonfiction written at the high end of grades 6 through 8.
items.zh: 独立且熟练地阅读并理解难度达到6至8年级上限的较长虚构作品（故事、戏剧和诗歌）以及文学性非虚构作品。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Draw multiple pieces of evidence from texts when explaining them or making inferences.
items.zh: 在解释文本或进行推断时，从文本中找出多条证据。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Quote or cite accurately from texts when explaining them or making inferences.
items.zh: 在解释文本或进行推断时，准确引用或标注文本出处。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Identify the central ideas or themes in a text and explain how they develop.
items.zh: 识别文本的中心思想或主题，并解释其如何展开。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Summarize texts objectively.
items.zh: 客观地概括文本。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Determine the meaning of words and phrases in a literary or nonfiction text, including Tier 2 academic vocabulary and Tier 3 subject-area vocabulary.
items.zh: 确定文学或非虚构文本中词语和短语的含义，包括二级学术词汇和三级学科词汇。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Consider the impact of word choices on meaning and tone.
items.zh: 考虑用词选择对意义和语气的影响。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Analyze the structure of a text and how the larger sections relate to the whole.
items.zh: 分析文本结构以及较大章节与整体的关系。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Analyze how a text’s structure helps build on themes and big ideas.
items.zh: 分析文本结构如何帮助深化主题和重要观点。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Compare and contrast a text to several audio, video, or multimedia versions of it, focusing on how the medium affects its impact.
items.zh: 将文本与其音频、视频或多媒体版本进行比较和对比，重点关注媒介如何影响其效果。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Trace arguments and claims and determine whether the reasoning, evidence, and logic are adequate.
items.zh: 梳理论证和主张，判断推理、证据和逻辑是否充分。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Analyze what different authors emphasize about the same topic/s and how they present information to create emphasis.
items.zh: 分析不同作者在同一主题上强调的内容，以及他们如何呈现信息以突出重点。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Analyze how literary elements in stories and dramas interact (e.g., how setting affects the characters and plot).
items.zh: 分析故事和戏剧中文学要素如何相互作用（例如背景如何影响人物和情节）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Analyze the impact of sound devices, such as alliteration, assonance, repetition, rhyme, and rhythm in poems, stories, and plays in specific stanzas, sections, and scenes.
items.zh: 分析诗歌、故事和戏剧中特定诗节、段落和场景里语音手法（如头韵、元音谐音、重复、押韵和节奏）所产生的效果。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Analyze figurative language, such as metaphors and similes, to determine meaning.
items.zh: 分析暗喻和明喻等修辞性语言以确定其含义。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Determine connotative meanings of words in literary text.
items.zh: 确定文学文本中词语的引申义（内涵义）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Examine how the structures of plays and poems develop deeper meaning and themes.
items.zh: 考察戏剧和诗歌的结构如何深化含义和主题。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Explain how authors develop the points of view of narrators, speakers, and characters.
items.zh: 解释作者如何刻画叙述者、说话者和人物的观点。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Examine how authors contrast the points of view of narrators, speakers, and characters.
items.zh: 考察作者如何对比叙述者、说话者和人物的观点。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Compare a written text to an oral, visual, audio, or multimedia version, focusing on the techniques used, such as lighting, sound, camera angles, and use of color.
items.zh: 将书面文本与口头、视觉、音频或多媒体版本进行比较，重点关注所用技巧，如灯光、声音、镜头角度和色彩运用。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Examine historical and fictional accounts of the same events, people, places, periods, and ideas to develop a deep understanding of how authors utilize history in their works and shape history by dramatizing it.
items.zh: 考察对同一事件、人物、地点、时期和思想的历史记载与虚构叙述，深入理解作者如何在作品中运用历史，并通过戏剧化加工塑造历史。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Reading Comprehension—Nonficton and Informationa Text l
items.en: Effectively summarize all types of informational texts.
items.zh: 有效地概括各种类型的说明性文本。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Reading Comprehension—Nonficton and Informationa Text l
items.en: Understand and explain the relationships and interactions between two or more individuals, events, or ideas in a text and how they influence each other.
items.zh: 理解并解释文本中两个或更多人物、事件或思想之间的关系与互动，以及它们如何相互影响。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Reading Comprehension—Nonficton and Informationa Text l
items.en: Identify the structure of a text and how it helps develop big ideas.
items.zh: 识别文本结构及其如何帮助展开重要思想。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Reading Comprehension—Nonficton and Informationa Text l
items.en: Identify an author’s point of view and purpose in a text.
items.zh: 识别作者在文本中的观点和写作目的。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Reading Comprehension—Nonficton and Informationa Text l
items.en: Explain how an author distinguishes their own point of view from that of others in a text.
items.zh: 解释作者如何在文本中将自己的观点与他人的观点区分开来。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Reading Comprehension—Nonficton and Informationa Text l
items.en: Analyze a medium’s impact on words by comparing and contrasting an informational text (e.g., a speech) to audio, visual, or multimedia portrayals of the same text (e.g., how the delivery of an address brings the words to life/adds emphasis).
items.zh: 通过比较信息类文本（如演讲）与同一文本的音频、视觉或多媒体呈现（如演讲的演绎方式如何让文字生动起来或增加强调），分析媒介对文字的影响。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Reading Comprehension—Nonficton and Informationa Text l
items.en: Explain how an author supports arguments in a text by giving reasons (opinions) and evidence, such as facts, examples, and expert opinions from reliable sources.
items.zh: 解释作者如何通过给出理由（观点）和证据（如事实、实例以及可靠来源的专家意见）来支持文本中的论证。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Reading Comprehension—Nonficton and Informationa Text l
items.en: Distinguish between claims that are supported and those that are not.
items.zh: 区分有证据支持的主张和没有证据支持的主张。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Reading Comprehension—Nonficton and Informationa Text l
items.en: Examine the overall soundness of the reasoning in an argument and the quality of the evidence supporting it.
items.zh: 考察论证中推理的总体合理性以及支持论证的证据质量。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Reading Comprehension—Nonficton and Informationa Text l
items.en: Compare and contrast different authors’ approaches to the same subject matter, such as
items.zh: 比较和对比不同作者对同一主题的处理方式，例如

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Reading Comprehension—Nonficton and Informationa Text l
items.en: their different interpretations
items.zh: 他们不同的解读

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Reading Comprehension—Nonficton and Informationa Text l
items.en: the different techniques they use to create emphasis
items.zh: 他们用来突出重点的不同技巧

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Reading Comprehension—Nonficton and Informationa Text l
items.en: what evidence they include
items.zh: 他们纳入了哪些证据

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.topic: Reading Comprehension—Nonficton and Informationa Text l
items.en: how they present evidence to reach their conclusions
items.zh: 他们如何呈现证据以得出结论

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Students should be given opportunities to compose narratives, persuasive essays, and expository writing. Students should examine their work with attention to unity, coherence, and emphasis. Narratives should present a logical sequence of events, and include concrete details. Persuasive pieces should incorporate credible sources and consider counter arguments. Expository essays should have a main point and stick to it, and have a coherent structure, typically following the pattern of introduction, body, and conclusion. Paragraphs should have a unified focus, be developed with evidence and examples, and have transitions between them. Essays should have appropriate tone and diction, as well as correct spelling and grammar in their final form. Standards for writing apply across the disciplines.
items.zh: 应让学生有机会撰写记叙文、说服性文章和说明文。学生应关注作品的统一性、连贯性和重点来审视自己的作品。记叙文应按逻辑顺序呈现事件，并包含具体细节。说服性文章应纳入可信来源并考虑反面论点。说明文应有一个中心观点并紧扣该观点，结构连贯，通常遵循引言、正文和结论的模式。段落应有统一的焦点，用证据和实例展开，段落之间应有过渡。文章应有恰当的语气和措辞，最终稿还应拼写和语法正确。写作标准适用于所有学科。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
items.en: Write routinely, clearly, and coherently, completing both short-term and long-term assignments focused on a range of different tasks, purposes, and audiences.
items.zh: 定期、清晰且连贯地写作，完成短期和长期作业，这些作业围绕各种不同的任务、目的和读者对象展开。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
items.en: Strengthen existing writing skills (sentences, paragraphs, transitions, introductions, and conclusions) by applying them to longer and genre-specific writing assignments.
items.zh: 通过将这些技能应用于更长、更具体裁特点的写作任务，巩固已有的写作技能（句子、段落、过渡、开头和结尾）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
items.en: Use the steps of the writing process to develop and strengthen writing: plan, draft, share, evaluate, revise, edit, and publish.
items.zh: 运用写作过程的各个步骤来发展和强化写作能力：计划、起草、分享、评价、修订、编辑和发表。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
items.en: Use conventional language standards when editing.
items.zh: 编辑时遵循规范的语言标准。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
items.en: Maintain a consistent style and tone appropriate to the genre of writing and audience.
items.zh: 保持与写作体裁和读者对象相适应的统一风格和语气。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
items.en: Use keyboards, tablets, the Internet, and other technologies to produce and publish writing and collaborate and communicate with others.
items.zh: 使用键盘、平板电脑、互联网及其他技术来创作和发布作品，并与他人协作和交流。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
items.en: Use the Internet to research and cite sources.
items.zh: 利用互联网进行研究并引用来源。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
items.en: Analyze literature in writing: compare and contrast real events, people, places, ideas, and periods from history with historical fiction and plays.
items.zh: 以书面形式分析文学作品：将历史上的真实事件、人物、地点、思想和时期与历史小说及戏剧进行比较和对比。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
items.en: Discuss and analyze, in writing, how authors utilize history in their works and shape history by dramatizing it.
items.zh: 以书面形式讨论并分析作者如何在作品中运用历史，并通过戏剧化加工塑造历史。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
items.en: Use literary elements as evidence for analyzing literature to strengthen reflection and analysis skills.
items.zh: 运用文学要素作为分析文学作品的证据，以增强思考和分析能力。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
items.en: Analyze informational texts in writing:
items.zh: 在写作中分析说明性文本：

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
items.en: Explain how authors make and support their points or claims with reasons and factual evidence.
items.zh: 解释作者如何提出观点或主张，并用理由和事实证据加以支持。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
items.en: Explain how specific pieces of evidence support specific claims.
items.zh: 解释具体的证据如何支持具体的主张。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
items.en: Discuss, in writing, whether the reasoning and evidence in an argument are valid and adequate.
items.zh: 以书面形式讨论论证中的推理和证据是否有效且充分。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
items.en: Use details and facts as evidence for analyzing informational texts to strengthen research and analysis skills.
items.zh: 将细节和事实作为分析信息类文本的证据，以增强研究和分析能力。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Conduct short research projects focused on answering a specific research question.
items.zh: 开展小型研究项目，专注于回答某个具体的研究问题。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Gather relevant information from several different print and digital sources and use it to support research.
items.zh: 从多种不同的纸质和数字来源收集相关信息，并用于支持研究。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Adjust the research question as appropriate throughout the information-gathering process.
items.zh: 在信息收集过程中酌情调整研究问题。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use the information-gathering process to pose related questions and explore additional topics requiring further research.
items.zh: 利用信息收集过程提出相关问题，并探索需要进一步研究的其他主题。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Determine the credibility of information gathered from print and digital sources.
items.zh: 判断从纸质和数字来源收集的信息的可信度。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Accurately quote or paraphrase from sources without plagiarizing.
items.zh: 准确地引用或转述来源内容，避免抄袭。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Practice honing keywords and key phrases to produce more effective online searches.
items.zh: 练习打磨关键词和关键短语，以进行更有效的在线搜索。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Cite sources and provide a basic bibliography.
items.zh: 标注引用来源，并提供基本的参考文献书目。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Produce narrative pieces that reflect real-life or imagined experiences.
items.zh: 写出反映真实生活或想象经历的记叙文。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Introduce a narrator, a situation, and characters, and develop them through dialogue, pacing, and exposition, including actions, thoughts, feelings, and reactions to events in the plot.
items.zh: 介绍叙述者、情境和人物，并通过对话、节奏和说明加以展开，包括动作、思想、情感以及对情节中事件的反应。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Organize a well-structured logical or natural sequence of plot events following from the situation, using time-order and transitional words, phrases, and clauses to indicate and manage the event order.
items.zh: 围绕情境组织结构良好、符合逻辑或自然的情节事件顺序，使用时间顺序词以及过渡词、短语和从句来标示和掌控事件顺序。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Incorporate shifts in time and multiple settings.
items.zh: 融入时间转换和多个场景。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Include concrete and sensory details to make writing vivid and precise; convey a sense of experiences and/or the sensations that accompany experiences.
items.zh: 加入具体和感官细节，使写作生动准确；传达体验感及伴随体验的感受。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Provide a sense of closure that follows logically or artfully from the situation, character responses, and sequence of events.
items.zh: 给出合乎逻辑或巧妙的结尾，与情境、人物反应和事件顺序相呼应。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Write reports and other types of informational texts that clearly focus ideas and information.
items.zh: 撰写报告和其他类型的信息类文本，清晰地聚焦观点和信息。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Introduce a topic with information organized in related sections or paragraphs and developed with facts, definitions, quotations, examples, and details.
items.zh: 引入一个主题，信息按相关部分或段落组织，并用事实、定义、引文、实例和细节加以展开。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Organize ideas, concepts, and information using text structures such as definition, classification, comparison/contrast, and cause/effect.
items.zh: 使用定义、分类、比较/对比和因果等文本结构来组织观点、概念和信息。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Group related information logically and incorporate formatting features, such as headings, graphics, charts, and other multimedia.
items.zh: 按逻辑将相关信息分组，并加入标题、图形、图表等格式元素。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Include visual elements such as photos, drawings, or diagrams to help explain or present ideas or information when appropriate.
items.zh: 在适当的时候加入照片、图画或图表等视觉要素，以帮助解释或呈现观点和信息。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use transitions to connect ideas and concepts from distinct categories and to clarify relationships; use transitions to create an overall sense of cohesion.
items.zh: 使用过渡手段连接不同类别的观点和概念并阐明关系；使用过渡手段营造整体的连贯感。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Establish and maintain a formal style.
items.zh: 建立并保持正式的文体风格。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use Tier 2 and/or Tier 3 domain-specific vocabulary to explain or elaborate topics.
items.zh: 使用二级和/或三级学科词汇来解释或详述主题。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Write a conclusion that wraps up ideas in the text.
items.zh: 写出总结全文观点的结论。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Write persuasive essays with well-defined theses and arguments that use clear reasons, examples, and relevant evidence to support claims.
items.zh: 撰写论点明确的说服性文章，用清晰的理由、实例和相关证据支持主张。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Follow through with an organizational structure that supports the purpose of the text, grouping ideas, reasons, and evidence in a logical way.
items.zh: 采用有助于实现文本目的的组织结构，按逻辑将观点、理由和证据分组。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Distinguish evidence from opinion.
items.zh: 区分证据与观点。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Demonstrate a clear understanding of the topic and argument.
items.zh: 表现出对主题和论证的清晰理解。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use linking words, phrases, and clauses to connect opinions with reasons and evidence and create an overall sense of cohesion.
items.zh: 使用连接词、短语和从句将观点与理由和证据联系起来，营造整体的连贯感。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Demonstrate the use of logical reasoning to support claims throughout the essay.
items.zh: 在整篇文章中运用逻辑推理来支持主张。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Establish and maintain a formal style and reasonable tone.
items.zh: 建立并保持正式的文体和合理的语气。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Anticipate and answer counterarguments.
items.zh: 预判并回应反面论点。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Identify and use accurate, credible sources.
items.zh: 识别并使用准确、可信的来源。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Write a conclusion that effectively and logically wraps up the argument. IV. Language Conventions
items.zh: 写出有效且合乎逻辑地总结论证的结论。四、语言规范

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use knowledge of language conventions when reading, writing, speaking, and listening.
items.zh: 在阅读、写作、口语和听力中运用语言规范知识。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Rework sentences by shortening and combining them to
items.zh: 通过缩短和合并句子来改写，以

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: express ideas with precision.
items.zh: 精确地表达思想。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: identify wordiness and correct it.
items.zh: 找出冗赘之处并加以改正。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: avoid or correct redundancies in word choices and ideas.
items.zh: 避免或纠正用词和观点上的重复累赘。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Apply known spelling strategies when writing.
items.zh: 写作时运用已知的拼写策略。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Apply known morphology skills (roots, prefixes, suffixes, and spelling changes) to correctly spell words.
items.zh: 运用已知的构词法知识（词根、前缀、后缀和拼写变化）正确拼写单词。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Continue work with spelling, with special attention to commonly misspelled words.
items.zh: 继续练习拼写，特别注意常见拼写错误的单词。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Students should have a working understanding of the following terms and be able to use them to discuss and analyze writing.
items.zh: 学生应基本理解下列术语，并能用它们来讨论和分析写作。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Understand the basic rules of English grammar and conventions when writing or speaking.
items.zh: 在写作或口语中理解英语语法和语言规范的基本规则。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Know types of phrases and clauses and
items.zh: 了解短语和从句的类型，并

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: explain their function in general.
items.zh: 大体解释它们的功能。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: explain their function in specific sentences.
items.zh: 解释它们在具体句子中的功能。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Identify sentence types:
items.zh: 识别句子类型：

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: simple
items.zh: 简单句

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: compound
items.zh: 并列句

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: complex
items.zh: 复合句

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: compound-complex
items.zh: 并列复合句

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Effectively use a variety of different sentence types to communicate relationships between ideas.
items.zh: 有效使用多种不同句型来表达思想之间的关系。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Know how to use different types of clauses effectively within a sentence.
items.zh: 知道如何在一个句子中有效使用不同类型的从句。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Identify and correct dangling/misplaced modifiers.
items.zh: 识别并纠正悬垂修饰语和错位修饰语。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Understand the basic rules of capitalization and punctuation when writing or speaking.
items.zh: 在写作或口语中理解大小写和标点符号的基本规则。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Correctly use commas when using coordinate adjectives (e.g., The dry, stale bread was difficult to chew but not The crumbling cellar door from the original house had to be replaced).
items.zh: 正确使用并列形容词之间的逗号（例如：The dry, stale bread was difficult to chew，但 The crumbling cellar door from the original house had to be replaced 中不用）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Apply a variety of strategies, such as the following, to figure out the meaning of Grade 7 words and phrases:
items.zh: 运用以下等多种策略来推断七年级词语和短语的含义：

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: context clues
items.zh: 上下文线索

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: examples
items.zh: 例子

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: definitions
items.zh: 定义

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: cause-and-effect relationships
items.zh: 因果关系

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: comparisons
items.zh: 比较

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use the overall meaning of a sentence as a clue to the meaning of words within a sentence.
items.zh: 利用句子的整体意思作为理解句中单词含义的线索。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Figure out the meaning of words based on the word’s position and function within a sentence, such as part of speech, subject, predicate, object, etc.
items.zh: 根据单词在句子中的位置和作用来判断其含义，如词性、主语、谓语、宾语等。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use a dictionary, thesaurus, or glossary—print or digital—to answer questions about the meanings and usage of unfamiliar words.
items.zh: 使用词典、同义词词典或词汇表（纸质或数字版）来回答有关生词含义和用法的问题。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Know how to use a dictionary—print or digital—to pronounce words correctly and determine a word’s part of speech.
items.zh: 知道如何使用词典（纸质或数字版）正确发音并确定单词的词性。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use a dictionary to find the precise meaning of words and phrases.
items.zh: 使用词典查找单词和短语的确切含义。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Infer the meaning of words by using context, and then confirm the meaning in a dictionary.
items.zh: 利用上下文推断词义，然后在词典中确认。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Make accurate interpretations of similes and metaphors and other types of figurative language, such as personification, based on context.
items.zh: 根据上下文准确理解明喻、暗喻以及其他修辞手法（如拟人）的含义。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Interpret figures of speech based on context, especially literary, mythological, and biblical allusions.
items.zh: 根据上下文理解修辞格，尤其是文学、神话和《圣经》典故。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Discern nuances in word meanings.
items.zh: 辨别词义的细微差别。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Recognize and use word relationships (synonym/antonym, analogies) to better understand words.
items.zh: 识别并运用词语关系（同义/反义、类比）来更好地理解词语。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Distinguish connotations, or shades of meaning, among words with similar denotations (e.g., picky, fickle, discerning, sophisticated, fastidious, persnickety).
items.zh: 区分外延意义相近词语之间的内涵或语义细微差别（例如 picky、fickle、discerning、sophisticated、fastidious、persnickety）。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Acquire grade-level Tier 2 general academic and Tier 3 domain-specific words and phrases and use them with accuracy.
items.zh: 掌握符合年级水平的第二层通用学术词汇和第三层学科专业词汇及短语，并准确使用。

items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: Use knowledge of Greek and Latin roots and affixes to figure out the meaning of a new word, such as Latin/Greek Word Meaning Examples ab \[L\] away from abnormal, absent ad \[L\] to, forward advocate, advance amo \[L\] love amiable, amorous audio \[L\] hear audience, inaudible auto \[G\] self automobile, autocrat bene \[L\] good/well beneficial, benefit circum \[L\] around circulate, circumference celer \[L\] swift accelerate chronos \[G\] time chronological cresco \[L\] grow increase, decrease cum \[L\] with compose, accommodate curro \[L\] run current, cursive, course demos \[G\] people democracy, epidemic erro \[L\] wander, stray error, erratic ex \[L\] from, out of exclaim, exhaust extra \[L\] outside extravagant, extraordinary facio \[L\] make effect, affect fero \[L\] bring, bear confer, defer fragilis \[L\] breakable fragile, fragment finis \[L\] end confine, finality homos \[G\] same homogenous hyper \[G\] over, beyond hypertension, hyperactive hypo \[G\] under, beneath hypodermic, hypothesis jacio \[L\] throw eject, interject judex \[L\] a judge judge, prejudice juro \[L\] swear jury, perjury makros \[G\] long macrocosm malus \[L\] bad malady, malice manus \[L\] hand manufacture, manuscript morphe \[G\] form metamorphosis, amorphous Note: More Latin and Greek words and roots are listed in Grades 6 and 8. items.subject: English Language Arts
items.en: The poems listed here constitute a selected core of poetry for this grade. You are encouraged to expose students to more poetry, old and new, and to have students write their own poems. Students should examine some poems in detail, discussing what the poems mean as well as asking questions about the poet’s use of language.
items.zh: 此处列出的诗歌构成本年级精选的核心诗歌。建议让学生接触更多新旧诗歌，并尝试自己写诗。学生应细读部分诗歌，讨论其含义，并对诗人的语言运用提出问题。

items.subject: Visual Arts
items.en: Teachers: In schools, lessons on the visual arts should illustrate important elements of making and appreciating art, and emphasize important artists, works of art, and artistic concepts. When appropriate, topics in the visual arts may be linked to topics in other disciplines. The following guidelines specify a variety of artwork in different media and from various cultures in order to expose students to a wide range of art and artists. While the list is robust, it may require teachers to narrow the selection in order to adequately address the works and related skills within an academic year. In studying the works of art specified below, and in creating their own art, students should review, develop, and apply concepts introduced in previous grades, such as line, shape, form, space, texture, color, light, design, and symmetry
items.zh: 教师提示：在学校的视觉艺术课程中，应阐明创作与鉴赏艺术的重要元素，并强调重要的艺术家、艺术作品和艺术概念。在适当的时候，视觉艺术主题可与其他学科的主题相联系。以下指导原则列出了不同媒介、不同文化的多种艺术作品，以让学生接触广泛的艺术和艺术家。这份清单虽然丰富，但教师可能需要缩小选择范围，以便在一个学年内充分讲清这些作品及相关技能。在学习下列艺术作品和创作自己的作品时，学生应复习、发展并运用前几个年级引入的概念，如线条、形状、形体、空间、肌理、色彩、光线、设计和对称。

items.subject: Visual Arts
items.en: The guidelines here continue the organizational scheme established in sixth grade, which combined art history with analysis of specific illustrative works. Timelines may help students situate the artists, periods, and schools. Note that the periods and characteristics are not absolute distinctions but generally helpful categories (to which there are always exceptions) often used in discussions of art.
items.zh: 这里的指南延续了六年级确立的组织框架，即将艺术史与对具体示范作品的分析相结合。时间线可以帮助学生定位艺术家、时期和流派。请注意，这些时期和特征并非绝对界限，而是通常有用的分类（总有例外），常用于艺术讨论之中。

Ask students to think about how Frank Lloyd Wright broke out of the box and opened up the walls of rooms to create space; and, in doing this, he was inspired by Japanese architecture, such as the Katsura Palace (see Grade 2).

items.subject: Music
items.en: The music guidelines for Grades 6-8 share a basic vocabulary of the elements of music that can inform the discussion, appreciation, and study of selected musical works. following these guidelines are recommendations in each grade for a core of musical content, broadly organized as a history of music from early to modern times, with attention to specific periods, composers, and genres. While these guidelines focus on musical vocabulary, appreciation, and history, musical performance should be encouraged and emphasized as local resources allow.
items.zh: 六至八年级的音乐指南共享一套音乐要素的基本词汇，可用于对所选音乐作品的讨论、欣赏和学习。在这些指南之后，是各年级对核心音乐内容的建议，大致按从早期到现代的音乐史组织，并关注具体时期、作曲家和体裁。虽然这些指南侧重于音乐词汇、欣赏和历史，但在当地条件允许的情况下，应鼓励并重视音乐表演。

items.en: forte 𝆑 (loud), mezzo-forte 𝆐𝆑 (moderately loud), fortissimo 𝆑𝆑 (very loud) II. Classical Music: Romantic and Patriotic Teachers: While these guidelines focus on musical vocabulary, appreciation, and history, musical performance should be encouraged and emphasized as resources allow. The focus here combines music history with appreciation of illustrative works, and continues from Grade 6 the idea of classifying Western music by periods, with examples of specific composers and works, as well as some associated musical terms. Timelines may help students situate the periods. The periods and their characteristics are not absolute distinctions but generally helpful categories often used in discussions of music. In sixth grade students studied music and composers from the Baroque to the romantic.
items.zh: forte 𝆑（强），mezzo-forte 𝆐𝆑（中强），fortissimo 𝆑𝆑（很强）II. 古典音乐：浪漫主义与爱国音乐 教师须知：虽然这些指南侧重于音乐词汇、欣赏和历史，但在资源允许的情况下应鼓励并重视音乐表演。这里的重点是将音乐史与对示范作品的欣赏相结合，并延续六年级按时期划分西方音乐的做法，列举具体作曲家和作品的例子以及一些相关音乐术语。时间线可以帮助学生定位各个时期。时期及其特征并非绝对界限，而是音乐讨论中常用的、大体有用的分类。六年级时学生学习了从巴洛克到浪漫主义时期的音乐和作曲家。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Teachers: In learning the new concepts and procedures, students should use previously acquired mathematics to ensure that the procedures become automatic and habitual. Students should continue to master the use of measuring and drawing instruments, develop their mental arithmetic and their approximating abilities, become more familiar with deductive reasoning, and use calculators and computers in a thoughtful way. While teaching methods may vary, it is worth keeping in mind the psychological principle that the most effective method for learning mathematics emphasizes frequent, varied practice, and encourages multiple approaches to solving varied types of problems.
items.zh: 教师须知：在学习新概念和运算方法时，学生应运用已掌握的数学知识，确保这些方法变得自动化并成为习惯。学生应继续熟练掌握测量和绘图工具的使用，发展心算和估算能力，更加熟悉演绎推理，并审慎地使用计算器和计算机。虽然教学方法可以多样，但值得记住的心理原则是：学习数学最有效的方法强调经常的、多样化的练习，并鼓励采用多种方法解决不同类型的问题。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Analyze proportional relationships and use them to solve real-world and mathematical problems.
items.zh: 分析比例关系，并用其解决现实世界和数学问题。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Compute unit rates associated with ratios of fractions, including ratios of lengths, areas and other quantities measured in like or different units.
items.zh: 计算与分数之比相关的单位率，包括以相同或不同单位测量的长度、面积及其他量的比。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Recognize and represent proportional relationships between quantities.
items.zh: 识别并表示数量之间的比例关系。
details: Decide whether two quantities are in a proportional relationship.
Identify the constant of proportionality (unit rate) in tables, graphs, equations, diagrams, and verbal descriptions of proportional relationships.
Represent proportional relationships by equations.
Explain what a point (x, y) on the graph of a proportional relationship means in terms of the situation, with special attention to the points (0, 0) and (1, r) where r is the unit rate.

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Use proportional relationships to solve multistep ratio and percent problems.
items.zh: 运用比例关系解决多步骤的比和百分数问题。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Apply and extend previous understandings of operations with fractions to add, subtract, multiply, and divide rational numbers.
items.zh: 运用并拓展之前对分数运算的理解，进行有理数的加、减、乘、除。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Apply and extend previous understandings of addition and subtraction to add and subtract rational numbers.
items.zh: 运用并拓展之前对加法和减法的理解，进行有理数的加减。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Represent addition and subtraction on a horizontal or vertical number line diagram.
items.zh: 在水平或垂直的数轴图上表示加法和减法。
details: Describe situations in which opposite quantities combine to make 0.
Understand p + q as the number located a distance |q| from p.

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Show that a number and its opposite have a sum of 0 (are additive inverses).
items.zh: 说明一个数与其相反数的和为 0（二者互为加法逆元）。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Interpret sums of rational numbers.
items.zh: 解释有理数之和的意义。
details: Understand subtraction of rational numbers as adding the additive inverse, p – q = p + (–q).

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Show that the distance between two rational numbers on the number line is the absolute value of their difference. • Apply properties of operations as strategies to add and subtract rational numbers.
items.zh: 说明数轴上两个有理数之间的距离等于它们差的绝对值。运用运算性质作为策略进行有理数的加减。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Apply and extend previous understandings of multiplication and division and of fractions to multiply and divide rational numbers. • Understand that multiplication is extended from fractions to rational numbers by requiring that operations continue to satisfy the properties of operations.
items.zh: 运用并拓展之前对乘法、除法及分数的理解，进行有理数的乘除。理解乘法从分数扩展到有理数时，要求运算继续满足运算性质。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Interpret products of rational numbers.
items.zh: 解释有理数之积的意义。
details: Understand that integers can be divided, provided that the divisor is not zero, and every quotient of integers (with non-zero divisor) is a rational number.

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Interpret quotients of rational numbers. Apply and describe in real-world contexts. In the positive or negative direction depending on whether q is positive or negative. Particularly the distributive property, leading to products such as (–1)(–1) =1 and the rules for multiplying signed numbers. If p and q are integers, then – p q = –p q = p –q . • Apply properties of operations as strategies to multiply and divide rational numbers. • Convert a rational number to a decimal using long division.
items.zh: 解释有理数之商的意义；在现实情境中应用并描述。根据 q 为正或为负，确定为正向或负向。特别是分配律，从而得到 (–1)(–1) = 1 以及带符号数相乘的法则。若 p 和 q 为整数，则 −p/q = −(p/q) = p/(−q)。运用运算性质作为策略进行有理数的乘除。用长除法将有理数化为小数。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Solve real-world and mathematical problems involving the four operations with rational numbers.
items.zh: 解决涉及有理数四则运算的现实世界和数学问题。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Use properties of operations to generate equivalent expressions.
items.zh: 运用运算性质生成等价的表达式。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Apply properties of operations as strategies to add, subtract, factor, and expand linear expressions with rational coefficients.
items.zh: 运用运算性质作为策略，对系数为有理数的一次表达式进行加减、因式分解和展开。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Understand that rewriting an expression in different forms in a problem context can shed light on the problem and how the quantities in it are related.
items.zh: 理解在问题情境中把表达式改写成不同形式，有助于厘清问题以及其中各数量之间的关系。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Solve real-life and mathematical problems using numerical and algebraic expressions and equations.
items.zh: 运用数值表达式、代数表达式和方程解决现实生活与数学问题。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Solve multi-step, real-life and mathematical problems posed with positive and negative rational numbers in any form (whole numbers, fractions, and decimals). • Use tools strategically. • Apply properties of operations to calculate with numbers in any form. • Convert between forms as appropriate. • Assess the reasonableness of answers using mental computation and estimation strategies.
items.zh: 解决以任意形式（整数、分数和小数）的正负有理数提出的多步骤现实生活和数学问题。策略性地使用工具；运用运算性质对任意形式的数进行计算；在适当的时候进行形式转换；用心算和估算策略判断答案是否合理。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Use variables to represent quantities in a real-world or mathematical problem, and construct simple equations and inequalities to solve problems by reasoning about the quantities. • Solve word problems leading to equations of the form px + q = r and p(x + q) = r.
items.zh: 用变量表示现实世界或数学问题中的数量，并构造简单的方程和不等式，通过对数量的推理来解决问题。解可化为 px + q = r 和 p(x + q) = r 形式的应用题。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Solve equations of these forms fluently.
items.zh: 熟练求解这些形式的方程。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Compare an algebraic solution to an arithmetic solution, identifying the sequence of the operations used in each approach. • Solve word problems leading to inequalities of the form px + q > r or px + q < r.
items.zh: 比较代数解法与算术解法，指出每种方法中所用运算的顺序。解可化为 px + q > r 或 px + q < r 形式的不等式应用题。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Graph the solution set of the inequality and interpret it in the context of the problem.
items.zh: 画出不等式的解集，并结合问题情境解释其含义。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Draw, construct and describe geometrical figures and describe the relationships between them.
items.zh: 绘制、制作并描述几何图形，以及描述它们之间的关系。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Solve problems involving scale drawings of geometric figures.
items.zh: 解决涉及几何图形按比例绘图的问题。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Draw geometric shapes with given conditions.
items.zh: 按给定条件绘制几何图形。

items.subject: Mathematics
