items.subject: History and Geography
items.topic: Latin America in the Second Half of the Twentieth Century
items.en: Caribbean B. Background In the second half of the twentieth century, many Latin American nations began to transition from military dictatorships to democracies. Populist leaders tapped into the energy of the working classes and took control in many places. The United States continued its involvement in Latin America as the Cold War accelerated. In the 1970s, military dictatorships took control of many Latin American countries, but democracy eventually returned in most places. The United States inserted itself into Central American and Caribbean commerce and governance in the early twentieth century. It intervened more than thirty times before Timeline 1933, at which point President Franklin Roosevelt adopted the Good Neighbor Policy, which called for an end to armed U.S. intervention in Latin America.
items.zh: 加勒比地区 B. 背景 20世纪下半叶，许多拉丁美洲国家开始从军事独裁过渡到民主。民粹主义领导人利用工人阶级的力量，在许多地方掌权。随着冷战加剧，美国继续介入拉丁美洲。20世纪70年代，军事独裁政权控制了拉美许多国家，但最终大多数地方都恢复了民主。20世纪初，美国介入中美洲和加勒比的商业与治理，在1933年之前干预了三十多次。1933年，富兰克林·罗斯福总统采取了“睦邻政策”，呼吁结束美国对拉丁美洲的武装干预。时间线

items.subject: History and Geography
items.topic: Latin America in the Second Half of the Twentieth Century
items.en: Mexican Revolution veteran Venustiano Carranza (1859–1920) became the first president of the new Mexican republic in 1917; oversaw rewriting of Mexican constitution
items.zh: 墨西哥革命老兵贝努斯蒂亚诺·卡兰萨（1859–1920）于1917年成为新墨西哥共和国的首任总统；主持重写墨西哥宪法。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.topic: Latin America in the Second Half of the Twentieth Century
items.en: Carranza eventually succeeded by Lázaro Cárdenas (1895–1970) in 1934; Cárdenas was first Mexican president to truly implement the economic and social reforms outlined in the 1917 constitution
items.zh: 1934年卡兰萨最终由拉萨罗·卡德纳斯（1895–1970）继任；卡德纳斯是第一位真正落实1917年宪法所概述的经济和社会改革的墨西哥总统。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.topic: Latin America in the Second Half of the Twentieth Century
items.en: Institutional Revolutionary Party (PRI) took over as the nation’s dominant political force after Cárdenas’s presidency ended in 1940.
items.zh: 1940年卡德纳斯总统任期结束后，革命制度党（PRI）成为该国的主导政治力量。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.topic: Latin America in the Second Half of the Twentieth Century
items.en: PRI eventually taken down by charges of corruption; devastating 1985 earthquake in Mexico City revealed political leaders’ corruption
items.zh: 革命制度党（PRI）最终因腐败指控而下台；1985年墨西哥城毁灭性地震揭露了政治领导人的腐败。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.topic: Latin America in the Second Half of the Twentieth Century
items.en: In 2000, Vicente Fox, businessman and right-wing populist, won the presidency as a member of the National Action Party (PAN)
items.zh: 2000年，商人、右翼民粹主义者维森特·福克斯作为国家行动党（PAN）成员赢得总统选举。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.topic: Latin America in the Second Half of the Twentieth Century
items.en: Today, Mexico is an important economic and political player in Latin America; booming industry and service sectors; mineral resources
items.zh: 如今，墨西哥是拉丁美洲重要的经济和政治角色；工业和服务业蓬勃发展；矿产资源丰富。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: First peaceful transition of power in Guatemala in 1950; Jacobo Arbenz replaced Juan José Arévalo as president; embraced idea of agrarian reform; in 1952, passed reform to redistribute uncultivated land from wealthy estates to rural workers
items.zh: 1950年危地马拉首次和平权力交接；哈科沃·阿本斯接替胡安·何塞·阿雷瓦洛担任总统；接受土地改革理念；1952年通过改革，将富裕庄园的未耕地重新分配给农村劳动者。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Concept of land reform alarmed U.S. government; believed communists would use the policy to organize the population; instructed CIA to undermine and destabilize the Guatemalan government; authorized the U.S. Air Force to provide arms to Guatemalan military officer Colonel Carlos Castillo Armas (1914–57)
items.zh: 土地改革的概念惊动了美国政府；美国认为共产党会利用这一政策来组织民众；指示中央情报局（CIA）削弱并颠覆危地马拉政府；授权美国空军向危地马拉军官卡洛斯·卡斯蒂略·阿马斯上校（1914–57）提供武器。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Castillo Armas staged military coup against the democratically elected Arbenz in 1954; claimed the presidency; returned all confiscated land to the United Fruit Company; thwarted farmworkers’ attempts to unionize; assassinated in 1957
items.zh: 1954年，卡斯蒂略·阿马斯对民选的阿本斯发动军事政变；自立为总统；将所有被没收的土地归还联合果品公司；挫败农场工人组织工会的企图；1957年遇刺身亡。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Military governments ruled Guatemala for several decades; 1996 peace agreement restored the nation’s representative government
items.zh: 军政府统治危地马拉数十年；1996年和平协议恢复了国家的代议制政府。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Ernesto “Che” Guevara (1928–67), Argentine physician working in Guatemala, took up arms against the U.S.-backed Guatemalan military to fight for Arbenz; as well as Raúl Castro (b. 1931) and Fidel Castro (1926–2016); Guevara one of the leaders of the 1959 Cuban Revolution
items.zh: 埃内斯托·“切”·格瓦拉（1928–67）是在危地马拉工作的阿根廷医生，他拿起武器反对美国支持的危地马拉军队，为阿本斯而战；劳尔·卡斯特罗（生于1931年）和菲德尔·卡斯特罗（1926–2016）也是如此；格瓦拉是1959年古巴革命的领导人之一。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Recognized as independent nation by the United States in 1903 after it allowed joint control of the Canal Zone
items.zh: 1903年在允许共同控制运河区后，被美国承认为独立国家。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: In 1977, U.S. president Jimmy Carter signed a treaty that promised to return the Canal Zone to Panama on December 31, 1999.
items.zh: 1977年，美国总统吉米·卡特签署条约，承诺于1999年12月31日将运河区归还巴拿马。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: In 1989, during the presidency of George H. W. Bush, the United States helped overthrow Panamanian military dictator Manuel Noriega.
items.zh: 1989年，在乔治·H·W·布什总统任内，美国帮助推翻了巴拿马军事独裁者曼努埃尔·诺列加。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Nicaragua subject to United States intervention many times during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries
items.zh: 尼加拉瓜在十九和二十世纪多次遭受美国干预。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Between 1934 and 1979, Somoza dynasty ruled Nicaragua; known for violence against enemies and for corruption
items.zh: 1934年至1979年间，索摩查王朝统治尼加拉瓜；以对敌人的暴力和腐败而闻名。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: In 1979, rebel group called the Sandinistas carried out a successful socialist revolution against the Somoza regime
items.zh: 1979年，名为桑地诺民族解放阵线（桑解阵）的叛乱组织成功发动了反对索摩查政权的社会主义革命。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Sandinistas confiscated and redistributed land owned by the Somoza family.
items.zh: 桑解阵没收并重新分配了索摩查家族拥有的土地。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: President Ronald Reagan and his administration helped fund and train a counterrevolutionary military force called the Contras to defeat the Sandinistas.
items.zh: 罗纳德·里根总统及其政府帮助资助和训练了一支名为反政府武装（Contras）的反革命军事力量，以击败桑解阵。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: In the Nicaraguan presidential election of 1984, Sandinista leader Daniel Ortega (b. 1945) won 67 percent of vote; following year, the United States imposed a five-year trade embargo
items.zh: 在1984年尼加拉瓜总统选举中，桑解阵领导人丹尼尔·奥尔特加（生于1945年）赢得67%的选票；次年，美国实施了为期五年的贸易禁运。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: U.S. Congress passed bills that called for an end to Contra funding; Reagan administration continued to secretly support the counterrevolutionaries.
items.zh: 美国国会通过了要求停止资助反政府武装的法案；里根政府继续秘密支持这些反革命力量。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: In 1986, revealed that the U.S. National Security Council had illegally sold weapons to Iran at inflated prices; used profits to fund the Contras; the Iran-Contra Affair
items.zh: 1986年，曝光美国国家安全委员会以高价非法向伊朗出售武器；用所得利润资助反政府武装；即“伊朗门事件”（Iran-Contra Affair）。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: In 1990, Nicaraguans elected Violeta Barrios de Chamorro (b. 1929).
items.zh: 1990年，尼加拉瓜人选举比奥莱塔·巴里奥斯·德·查莫罗（生于1929年）为总统。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Daniel Ortega re-elected in 2006; implementation of conservative laws, support for extreme right-wing ideology, and suppression of the press
items.zh: 丹尼尔·奥尔特加于2006年再次当选；实施保守法律、支持极右翼意识形态并压制新闻自由。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: El Salvador’s economy largely agricultural in the early twentieth century; rural workers exploited by influential landowners; Salvadorian students protested; Catholic priests worked to improve lives of rural population
items.zh: 20世纪初萨尔瓦多的经济以农业为主；农村劳动者受到有势力地主的剥削；萨尔瓦多学生提出抗议；天主教神父致力于改善农村人口的生活。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Catholic Church viewed as enemy of the ruling elite, the armed forces, and the landowning oligarchy
items.zh: 天主教会被视为统治精英、武装部队和地主寡头的敌人。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: In 1960s, guerrilla and anti-government forces in El Salvador drew support from the rural population; success of Sandinistas inspired Salvadorans to rise against oppressive government; between 1979 and 1985, rebel group called Farabundo Martí National Liberation Front (FMLN) almost overthrew Nicaragua’s ruling elite
items.zh: 20世纪60年代，萨尔瓦多的游击队和反政府力量获得了农村人口的支持；桑解阵的成功鼓舞了萨尔瓦多人奋起反抗压迫性政府；1979年至1985年间，名为法拉本多·马蒂民族解放阵线（FMLN）的叛乱组织几乎推翻了尼加拉瓜的统治精英。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Reagan administration supported the Salvadoran military in its fight against the FMLN guerrillas; between 1980 and 1992, the United States sent El Salvador’s government more than $4 billion in economic and military aid
items.zh: 里根政府支持萨尔瓦多军队对抗 FMLN 游击队；1980年至1992年间，美国向萨尔瓦多政府提供了超过40亿美元的经济和军事援助。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Assassination of Archbishop Óscar Romero in 1980 and murder of eight people, including six Catholic priests, in 1989, prompted international pressure
items.zh: 1980年大主教奥斯卡·罗梅罗遇刺以及1989年包括六名天主教神父在内的八人遇害，促使国际社会施加压力。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: United Nations brokered a peace agreement between the Salvadoran government and the FMLN in 1992
items.zh: 1992年，联合国斡旋达成萨尔瓦多政府与 FMLN 之间的和平协议。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Brazilian economy impacted by the global depression of 1930s
items.zh: 巴西经济受到20世纪30年代全球经济大萧条的影响。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Getúlio Vargas (1882–1954), Brazilian politician, represented the reform party in the 1930 presidential election; he lost; led armed revolution that overthrew Brazil’s oligarchic government
items.zh: 热图利奥·瓦加斯（1882–1954）是巴西政治家，在1930年总统选举中代表改革党参选；他落败了；随后领导武装革命推翻了巴西的寡头政府。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Vargas centralized power; replaced corrupt coffee barons who ruled southern part of the nation
items.zh: 瓦加斯将权力集中；取代了统治该国南部的腐败咖啡巨头。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: In 1937, with help of the Brazilian military, he assumed dictatorial powers; rewrote the country’s constitution; period known as the New State
items.zh: 1937年，在巴西军方的帮助下，他攫取了独裁权力；重写了国家宪法；这一时期被称为“新国家”（Estado Novo）。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Inspired by Mussolini’s rule in Italy, Vargas imposed an authoritarian regime; prohibited political parties that opposed his government; made improvements to educational system; enacted social security laws; established a minimum wage; gave women the right to vote
items.zh: 受墨索里尼在意大利统治的启发，瓦加斯建立了威权政权；禁止反对他政府的政党；改进教育体系；颁布社会保障法；设立最低工资；给予妇女选举权。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Vargas overthrown in 1945 military coup; still maintained widespread public support; was elected president of Brazil in 1951; until his death in 1954, led in a more democratic manner; this approach followed by subsequent presidents; in 1964, military took control of the country
items.zh: 瓦加斯在1945年军事政变中被推翻；但仍拥有广泛的公众支持；1951年当选巴西总统；直到1954年去世前，他以较为民主的方式领导国家；后续总统沿袭了这一做法；1964年，军方控制了国家。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Populist Juan Domingo Perón (1895–1974), Argentine military officer, rose to power during 1943 government coup; recognized workers as important political force; seen as a threat, Domingo Perón arrested and jailed; supporters protested; Perón freed on October 17, 1945; known in Argentina as Loyalty Day; elected president in 1946
items.zh: 民粹主义者胡安·多明戈·庇隆（1895–1974）是阿根廷军官，在1943年政府政变中掌权；他承认工人是重要的政治力量；被视为威胁后，多明戈·庇隆被捕入狱；支持者抗议；庇隆于1945年10月17日获释；这一天在阿根廷被称为“忠诚日”；1946年他当选总统。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Perón rewrote Argentina’s constitution in 1949; bill of rights; free speech restricted; authoritarian regime; prohibited opposing parties
items.zh: 庇隆于1949年重写阿根廷宪法；包含权利法案；限制言论自由；实行威权政权；禁止反对党。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Eva “Evita” Duarte de Perón (1919–52), wife of Juan Perón, powerful female leader in Latin America; helped establish national vote for women in 1947
items.zh: 埃娃·“艾维塔”·杜阿尔特·德·庇隆（1919–52）是胡安·庇隆的妻子，是拉丁美洲有影响力的女性领袖；帮助在1947年确立了妇女的全国选举权。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Military overthrew Peron in 1955; attempted to “de-Perónize” society; prohibited any politician belonging to the Peronist party from holding office; Perón exiled to Spain
items.zh: 军方于1955年推翻庇隆；试图对社会进行“去庇隆化”；禁止任何庇隆主义党派的政治家担任公职；庇隆被流放到西班牙。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Political tensions of Cold War, and economic turmoil of 1970s fragmented Argentine society; Peron returned to Argentina; reelected president in 1973; died in office
items.zh: 冷战的政治紧张局势和20世纪70年代的经济动荡使阿根廷社会分裂；庇隆返回阿根廷；1973年再次当选总统；在任内去世。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Colombia experienced waves of violence after assassination of popular leftist politician and presidential hopeful Jorge Eliécer Gaitán in 1948; period known as La Violencia, or the Era of Violence
items.zh: 1948年受欢迎的左翼政治家和总统候选人豪尔赫·埃利塞尔·盖坦遇刺后，哥伦比亚经历了多轮暴力浪潮；这一时期被称为“La Violencia”，即“暴力时代”。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Laureano Gómez (1889–1965), conservative politician, accused of being involved in Gaitán’s assassination, elected president of Colombia in 1950; censored the press, restricted courts, persecuted Protestants; Gómez overthrown by Colombian military in 1953
items.zh: 劳雷亚诺·戈麦斯（1889–1965）是保守派政治家，被指控参与盖坦遇刺，1950年当选哥伦比亚总统；他审查新闻、限制法院、迫害新教徒；1953年戈麦斯被哥伦比亚军方推翻。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Gómez replaced by General Gustavo Rojas Pinilla (1900–75); corrupt authoritarian; his presidency even more restrictive than Gómez’s
items.zh: 古斯塔沃·罗哈斯·皮尼利亚将军（1900–75）取代了戈麦斯；他是腐败的独裁者；其总统任期比戈麦斯时期更加严苛。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Guerrilla insurgent groups faded away in most of Latin America after the Cold War; not in Columbia; Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC) and other groups waged war in countryside
items.zh: 冷战结束后，游击叛乱组织在拉丁美洲大部分地区逐渐消失；但在哥伦比亚并非如此；哥伦比亚革命武装力量（FARC）等组织在乡村地区继续作战。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Álvaro Uribe (b. 1952) elected president of Colombia in 2002; waged war against rebel groups; more than two hundred thousand Colombians died; millions displaced; Uribe reelected and served until 2010
items.zh: 阿尔瓦罗·乌里韦（生于1952年）于2002年当选哥伦比亚总统；对叛乱组织发动战争；超过二十万哥伦比亚人死亡；数百万人流离失所；乌里韦连任并执政至2010年。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Democratic governments of several South American countries ruthlessly overthrown in the 1960s and 1970s; often political parties banned, legislatures shut down, and press censored; lawmaking by decree
items.zh: 20世纪60年代和70年代，几个南美洲国家的民主政府被无情推翻；政党经常被取缔，立法机构被关闭，新闻受到审查；通过法令进行立法。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Dictators reversed populist policies that benefited workers; banned unions, strikes, and other public demonstrations; anti-communist
items.zh: 独裁者废除了惠及工人的民粹主义政策；禁止工会、罢工和其他公开示威；持反共产主义立场。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Regimes set up special security forces to kidnap and kill anyone suspected of leftist or anti-government activities
items.zh: 这些政权建立了特别安全部队，绑架并杀害任何被怀疑从事左翼或反政府活动的人。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: In Argentina, historians estimate up to thirty thousand people were “disappeared,” or kidnapped.
items.zh: 在阿根廷，历史学家估计有多达三万人“失踪”，即被绑架。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: United States worked to prevent spread of communist ideology across Latin America; between 1955 and 1976, Argentina received almost $400 million in military support from the United States; in Chile, the U.S. Navy and CIA provided military support for September 11, 1973, coup that replaced socialist president Salvador Allende (1908–73) with dictator Augusto Pinochet (1915–2006)
items.zh: 美国努力阻止共产主义意识形态在拉丁美洲蔓延；1955年至1976年间，阿根廷从美国获得了近4亿美元的军事援助；在智利，美国海军和中情局为1973年9月11日的政变提供了军事支持，该政变用独裁者奥古斯托·皮诺切特（1915–2006）取代了社会主义总统萨尔瓦多·阿连德（1908–73）。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Pinochet embraced capitalism; rewrote the nation’s constitution; universities put under control of military men, who controlled course curricula and hiring and firing of faculty; by 1980, Chile the most privatized and unregulated economy in the world
items.zh: 皮诺切特拥抱资本主义；重写了国家宪法；大学被置于军方人员控制之下，他们控制课程设置以及教师的聘用和解聘；到1980年，智利成为世界上私有化程度最高、监管最少经济体。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Pinochet lost the election in 1988; maintained role as head of the armed forces until 1998
items.zh: 皮诺切特在1988年选举中落败；但一直保留武装部队总司令的职位直到1998年。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Falkland Islands, also called Malvinas Islands; conflict in 1982 between Argentina and Britain
items.zh: 福克兰群岛，也称马尔维纳斯群岛；1982年阿根廷与英国之间爆发冲突。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Raúl Alfonsín (1927–2009) democratically elected president of Argentina in 1983; created the National Commission on the Disappeared; Mothers of the Plaza de Mayo
items.zh: 劳尔·阿方辛（1927–2009）于1983年通过民主选举当选阿根廷总统；设立了失踪人员全国委员会；五月广场母亲组织（Mothers of the Plaza de Mayo）。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: In Brazil, military regime began slow transition to democracy in the 1970s during period known as the abertura, or opening
items.zh: 在巴西，军政府在20世纪70年代开始缓慢向民主过渡，这一时期被称为“开放”（abertura）。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Across Latin America, Catholic Church turned against the military due to many human rights abuses
items.zh: 在整个拉丁美洲，天主教会因军队诸多侵犯人权行为而转而反对军政府。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Aftermath of dictatorships resulted in many challenges for South American countries
items.zh: 独裁统治的后果给南美洲国家带来了许多挑战。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Cuban Revolution in 1959 highlighted Cold War tensions
items.zh: 1959年古巴革命凸显了冷战紧张局势。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Cuban alliance with the Soviet Union during the Cold War; Cuba experienced four hundred years of Spanish colonialism, followed by U.S. involvement in its affairs
items.zh: 冷战期间古巴与苏联结盟；古巴经历了四百年的西班牙殖民统治，随后美国介入其事务。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: In 1903, the United States passed the Platt Amendment; stated that the U.S. government had political authority over Cuba; authority lasted until 1934; ended by the Good Neighbor Policy; next quarter century, Cuba led by rulers friendly to American interests
items.zh: 1903年，美国通过《普拉特修正案》；宣称美国政府对古巴拥有政治权力；这一权力持续到1934年；随“睦邻政策”而终止；此后四分之一世纪，古巴由亲美利益的统治者领导。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: In 1933, Fulgencio Batista (1901–73) led coup that overthrew the government; maintained influence over next presidents for a period
items.zh: 1933年，富尔亨西奥·巴蒂斯塔（1901–73）领导政变推翻政府；在一段时间内对后续总统保持影响力。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: In 1940, Batista elected president; increasingly bound to the United States; after serving full term, moved to the United States; Batista returned to Cuba in 1952; staged successful coup with the support of Cuban military; worked with leaders of organized crime in the United States to promote tourism
items.zh: 1940年，巴蒂斯塔当选总统；与美国的关系日益紧密；任期届满后移居美国；1952年巴蒂斯塔返回古巴；在古巴军方支持下成功发动政变；与美国有组织犯罪头目合作发展旅游业。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Middle-class law student, Fidel Castro, leading opponent of Batista; on July 26, 1953, Castro led failed insurrection in eastern Cuba; many Cubans killed; Fidel and his brother Raúl arrested; upon their release, in 1955, go into exile in Mexico; meet Ernesto “Che” Guevara; organize revolutionary group, the 26th of July Movement
items.zh: 中产阶级法律系学生菲德尔·卡斯特罗是巴蒂斯塔的主要反对者；1953年7月26日，卡斯特罗在古巴东部领导了一次失败的起义；许多古巴人被杀；菲德尔和他的弟弟劳尔被捕；1955年获释后流亡墨西哥；结识埃内斯托·“切”·格瓦拉；组织革命团体“七二六运动”（26th of July Movement）。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Castros, Guevara, and seventy-nine other revolutionaries sailed to Cuba from Mexico in 1956; many killed; three leaders and some revolutionaries survive; lived in the Sierra Maestra mountains and attracted more members; waged a guerilla battle against Batista’s forces; on January 1, 1959, the rebels entered Cuban capital, Havana
items.zh: 1956年，卡斯特罗兄弟、格瓦拉和其他七十九名革命者从墨西哥乘船返回古巴；许多人被杀；三位领导人和部分革命者幸存；他们在马埃斯特腊山区生活并吸引了更多成员；对巴蒂斯塔军队开展游击战；1959年1月1日，起义者进入古巴首都哈瓦那。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Fidel Castro pushed back against U.S. economic dominance; in 1960, Castro made deal to sell Cuban sugar to Soviet Union; U.S. president Dwight D. Eisenhower’s administration retaliated; ended diplomatic relations with Castro; U.S. organize Cuban dissidents to return to Cuba; attempt to overthrow Castro—Bay of Pigs, April 17, 1961; attempt fails; U.S. operation Mongoose also fails
items.zh: 菲德尔·卡斯特罗抵制美国的经济支配；1960年，卡斯特罗达成协议向苏联出售古巴糖；美国总统德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔政府予以报复；与卡斯特罗断绝外交关系；美国组织古巴异见人士返回古巴；试图推翻卡斯特罗——1961年4月17日的猪湾事件；行动失败；美国的“猫鼬行动”（Operation Mongoose）也告失败。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Castro declares revolution socialist
items.zh: 卡斯特罗宣布革命为社会主义革命。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: In October 1962, U.S. spy planes take satellite photos of installation of Soviet nuclear warheads in Cuba
items.zh: 1962年10月，美国间谍飞机的卫星照片显示苏联在古巴部署核弹头。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Soviet leader Nikita Khrushchev (1894–1971) had installed weapons in Cuba in response to U.S. weapons placed in Turkey
items.zh: 苏联领导人尼基塔·赫鲁晓夫（1894–1971）在古巴部署武器，以回应美国在土耳其部署武器。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: President Kennedy demands withdrawal of Soviet nuclear warheads; Cuban missile crisis; Soviet Union withdraws missiles in exchange for U.S. assurance not to invade Cuba; thousands of Cubans migrate to the United States; Mariel boatlift, 1980
items.zh: 肯尼迪总统要求撤走苏联核弹头；古巴导弹危机；苏联撤走导弹，以换取美国不入侵古巴的保证；成千上万的古巴人移民美国；1980年马里埃尔船运事件（Mariel boatlift）。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Cuba entered period of economic hardship in 1990s; U.S. maintains economic embargo against Cuba
items.zh: 古巴在20世纪90年代进入经济困难时期；美国继续对古巴实施经济禁运。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Fidel Castro died in 2016; Raúl Castro becomes president
items.zh: 菲德尔·卡斯特罗于2016年去世；劳尔·卡斯特罗出任总统。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: United States Marines stationed in Haiti from 1915 until 1934
items.zh: 美国海军陆战队从1915年到1934年驻扎在海地。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: In 1957, United States supported François “Papa Doc” Duvalier (1907–71) as Haiti’s president; supportive of U.S.; corruption; exploitation of Haitian resources; after his death, his son, Jean-Claude “Baby Doc” Duvalier (1951–2014) installed in office; ousted in 1986
items.zh: 1957年，美国支持弗朗索瓦·“老杜瓦利埃”（Papa Doc）·杜瓦利埃（1907–71）出任海地总统；他亲美；腐败；剥削海地资源；他死后，其子让-克洛德·“小杜瓦利埃”（Baby Doc）·杜瓦利埃（1951–2014）被安插上台；1986年被推翻。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: In 1965, the United States sent troops to the Dominican Republic to end a civil war and install an authoritarian government friendly to its interests.
items.zh: 1965年，美国向多米尼加共和国派兵，以结束内战并扶植一个符合其利益的威权政府。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.topic: Modern World Events, Challenges, and Successes
items.en: Map of the World B. Globalization
items.zh: 世界地图B. 全球化

items.subject: History and Geography
items.topic: Modern World Events, Challenges, and Successes
items.en: Modern globalized economy is result of end of the Cold War
items.zh: 现代全球化经济是冷战结束的结果。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.topic: Modern World Events, Challenges, and Successes
items.en: Networks of production, distribution, trade; fast communications technology; capacity for goods to crisscross the planet; just-in-time supply chain; opportunity for ideas and culture to spread around the world; global influence of American popular culture
items.zh: 生产、分销和贸易网络；快速的通信技术；商品能够纵横全球的能力；即时供应链（just-in-time）；思想和文化传播到世界各地的机会；美国流行文化的全球影响力。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.topic: Modern World Events, Challenges, and Successes
items.en: World Trade Organization (WTO) formed in 1995 to set standards for global trade and exchange
items.zh: 世界贸易组织（WTO）于1995年成立，为全球贸易和交流制定标准。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.topic: Modern World Events, Challenges, and Successes
items.en: Rise of China as industrial power
items.zh: 中国作为工业强国的崛起。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.topic: Modern World Events, Challenges, and Successes
items.en: China became world’s leading exporter of textiles, furniture, toys
items.zh: 中国成为世界最大的纺织品、家具和玩具出口国。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.topic: Modern World Events, Challenges, and Successes
items.en: China’s industrial expansion shifted focus to infrastructure in 1999; high-speed rail, highways, building materials, ships
items.zh: 1999年中国的工业扩张将重点转向基础设施；高铁、公路、建筑材料、船舶。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.topic: Modern World Events, Challenges, and Successes
items.en: China admitted into the WTO in 2001
items.zh: 中国于2001年加入世界贸易组织。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.topic: Modern World Events, Challenges, and Successes
items.en: Growing use of offshore, or foreign, labor; business leaders investing in developing countries such as India and China; workers paid less than workers in the United States and Europe
items.zh: 越来越多地使用海外（外国）劳动力；商业领袖在印度和中国等发展中国家投资；这些工人的工资低于美国和欧洲的工人。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.topic: Modern World Events, Challenges, and Successes
items.en: Developing countries had fewer safety and environmental regulations, favorable tax rates
items.zh: 发展中国家的安全和环保法规较少，税率优惠。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.topic: Modern World Events, Challenges, and Successes
items.en: Type of labor performed overseas changed; developing nations had improved systems of education; produced greater numbers of skilled workers and university graduates; caused increase in the amount of skilled labor that was outsourced to the developing world
items.zh: 在海外从事的劳动类型发生了变化；发展中国家的教育体系得到改善；培养出更多技术工人和大学毕业生；导致外包到发展中国家的技术劳动力数量增加。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.topic: Modern World Events, Challenges, and Successes
items.en: Internet communications technology connects billions of people; satellites; mobile phones
items.zh: 互联网通信技术连接了数十亿人；卫星；移动电话。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.topic: Modern World Events, Challenges, and Successes
items.en: Criticism of globalization; blamed for weakening national economic strength
items.zh: 对全球化的批评；被指责削弱了国家经济实力。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.topic: Modern World Events, Challenges, and Successes
items.en: Global financial crisis 2007-2009
items.zh: 2007—2009年全球金融危机。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.topic: Modern World Events, Challenges, and Successes
items.en: Global trade and travel contribute to spread of infectious diseases; COVID-19; vaccinations developed by international teams of scientists
items.zh: 全球贸易和旅行助长传染病的传播；新冠疫情（COVID-19）；由国际科学家团队研发疫苗。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Estimated 7.7 billion people lived on Earth in 2019; increase of 1 billion people since 2007 and 2 billion since 1994; growth slowing; birth rate decreasing
items.zh: 据估计，2019年地球上生活着77亿人；比2007年增加10亿人，比1994年增加20亿人；增长正在放缓；出生率下降。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: United Nations predicts world’s population will reach a peak of about 11 billion people by 2100
items.zh: 联合国预测，到2100年世界人口将达到约110亿的峰值。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Life expectancy increasing; aging population trends
items.zh: 预期寿命延长；人口老龄化趋势。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Larger global population and interconnected world economy have contributed to increased human migration
items.zh: 全球人口增加和相互关联的世界经济促成了人口迁移的增加。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Migration factors: economic, conflicts, wars, persecution, disasters in home countries; United Nations estimated in 2021, 26.6 million people in the world were refugees seeking safety from conflicts and disasters; increase in anti-immigrant rhetoric
items.zh: 迁移因素：经济、冲突、战争、迫害、本国的灾害；联合国估计，2021年世界上有2660万人是为躲避冲突和灾难而寻求安全的难民；反移民言论增多。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Major lingering issue from the end of the Cold War—the handling of the world’s nuclear weapons
items.zh: 冷战结束遗留的一个重大问题——如何处理世界核武器。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Conflicts in former Russian regions of Chechnya, Georgia, Crimea, Ukraine
items.zh: 前俄罗斯地区车臣、格鲁吉亚、克里米亚、乌克兰的冲突。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Following global financial crisis of 2007–9, wave of pro-democracy protests in North Africa and Southwest Asia in 2010–11; protests triggered by economic crises and demands for political reform; in Tunisia, President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali forced to resign in 2011; in Egypt, President Hosni Mubarak forced to resign in 2011; uprisings in Syria, Libya, and Yemen (Arab Spring)
items.zh: 继2007—2009年全球金融危机之后，2010—2011年北非和西亚掀起一波亲民主抗议浪潮；抗议由经济危机和政治改革诉求引发；2011年突尼斯总统宰因·阿比丁·本·阿里被迫辞职；2011年埃及总统胡斯尼·穆巴拉克被迫辞职；叙利亚、利比亚和也门也爆发起义（阿拉伯之春）。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Arab Spring largely unable to replace authoritarian leaders with democratic governments
items.zh: 阿拉伯之春基本上未能用民主政府取代威权领导人。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: In Syria, under government of Bashar al-Assad, rebel uprising turned into extended civil war; more than seven million Syrians have fled the country
items.zh: 在叙利亚，巴沙尔·阿萨德政府执政期间，叛乱演变为长期内战；超过七百万叙利亚人逃离该国。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: In Libya, dictator Muammar al-Qaddafi removed from power after European and U.S. forces gave military aid to Libyan rebels
items.zh: 在利比亚，欧洲和美国军队向利比亚叛军提供军事援助后，独裁者穆阿迈尔·卡扎菲被赶下台。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: The Islamic State of Iraq and Syria (ISIS) emerged between 2011 and 2014; at the height of its power, the Islamic State controlled 30 percent of Syria and 40 percent of Iraq
items.zh: 伊拉克和叙利亚伊斯兰国（ISIS）于2011年至2014年间出现；在其势力鼎盛时期，伊斯兰国控制了叙利亚30%和伊拉克40%的领土。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Changes in weather patterns; extremes; changing levels of individual gases impacts individual functions and capabilities of the atmosphere; carbon dioxide and methane
items.zh: 天气模式的变化；极端天气；个别气体含量的变化影响大气的个别功能和能力；二氧化碳和甲烷。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Deforestation in world’s rain forests (Amazon)
items.zh: 世界雨林（亚马逊）的森林砍伐。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Global initiatives have attempted to tackle issue by lowering emissions; making plans to transition to renewable, clean energy sources
items.zh: 全球性倡议试图通过降低排放来解决问题；制定向可再生、清洁能源过渡的计划。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Kyoto Protocol, signed in 1997, put into effect in 2005, committed industrialized nations to cut greenhouse gas emissions; requested developing nations also do so
items.zh: 《京都议定书》于1997年签署、2005年生效，要求工业化国家削减温室气体排放；并要求发展中国家也这样做。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Paris Agreement, signed in 2015, put into effect in 2016, commits all parties to reduction of emissions
items.zh: 《巴黎协定》于2015年签署、2016年生效，要求所有缔约方减少排放。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Revived interest in space exploration
items.zh: 对太空探索的兴趣重新兴起。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Robotic explorer rover, Curiosity, landed on Mars in 2012; began to transmit images and data from the red planet’s surface back to Earth; Curiosity mission followed by others; Perseverance, landed on Mars in 2021
items.zh: 机器人探测车“好奇号”（Curiosity）于2012年登陆火星；开始将这颗红色星球表面的图像和数据传回地球；“好奇号”任务之后还有其他任务；“毅力号”（Perseverance）于2021年登陆火星。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: China showing increased interest in its space program; in 2020, Chang’e-5 lander touched down on the moon’s surface
items.zh: 中国对其航天计划的兴趣日益增加；2020年，嫦娥五号着陆器在月球表面着陆。

items.subject: History and Geography
items.en: Medical breakthroughs in 21st Century helping to eradicate disease and illness around the world
items.zh: 21世纪的医学突破有助于在全世界根除疾病。

items.subject: Visual Arts
items.en: Teachers: In schools, lessons on the visual arts should illustrate important elements of making and appreciating art, and emphasize important artists, works of art, and artistic concepts. When appropriate, topics in the visual arts may be linked to topics in other disciplines. The following guidelines specify a variety of artwork in different media and from various cultures in order to expose students to a wide range of art and artists. While the list is robust, it may require teachers to narrow the selection in order to adequately address the works and related skills within an academic year. In studying the works of art specified below, and in creating their own art, students should review, develop, and apply concepts introduced in previous grades, such as line, shape, form, space, texture, color, light, design, and symmetry
items.zh: 教师提示：在学校的视觉艺术课程中，应阐明创作与鉴赏艺术的重要元素，并强调重要的艺术家、艺术作品和艺术概念。在适当的时候，视觉艺术主题可与其他学科的主题相联系。以下指导原则列出了不同媒介、不同文化的多种艺术作品，以让学生接触广泛的艺术和艺术家。这份清单虽然丰富，但教师可能需要缩小选择范围，以便在一个学年内充分讲清这些作品及相关技能。在学习下列艺术作品和创作自己的作品时，学生应复习、发展并运用前几个年级引入的概念，如线条、形状、形体、空间、肌理、色彩、光线、设计和对称。

items.subject: Visual Arts
items.en: The guidelines here continue the organizational scheme established in sixth and seventh grades, which combined art history with analysis of specific illustrative works. Timelines may help students situate the artists, periods, and schools. Note that the periods and characteristics are not absolute distinctions but generally helpful categories (to which there are always exceptions) often used in discussions of art.
items.zh: 这里的指南延续了六、七年级确立的组织框架，即将艺术史与对具体代表性作品的分析相结合。时间线有助于学生确定艺术家、时期和流派的位置。请注意，时期和特征并非绝对的区分，而是通常用于艺术讨论的、大体上有帮助的分类（总有例外）。

items.subject: Music
items.en: The Music guidelines for Grades 6–8 share a basic vocabulary of the elements of music that can inform the discussion, appreciation, and study of selected musical works. Following these guidelines are recommendations in each grade for a core of musical content, broadly organized as a history of music from early to modern times, with attention to specific periods, composers, and genres. While these guidelines focus on musical vocabulary, appreciation, and history, musical performance should be encouraged and emphasized as local resources allow.
items.zh: 6—8年级的音乐指南共享一套关于音乐要素的基本词汇，可用于指导对所选音乐作品的讨论、欣赏和学习。在这些指南之后，各年级都推荐了核心音乐内容，大致按从早期到现代的音乐史来组织，并关注特定时期、作曲家和体裁。虽然这些指南侧重于音乐词汇、欣赏和历史，但在当地条件允许的情况下，应鼓励并重视音乐表演。

items.subject: Music
items.en: These guidelines focus on influential modern musicians, but this list is not intended to be exhaustive. Review lyrics and/or video performances of any song by these performers prior to sharing with students to ensure it is appropriate with the culture and standards of your classroom. When introducing the individual/band and work, highlight how this artist was influential and what examples from his/her/their music inspired later musicians. Aretha Franklin The Beatles Bob Dylan Carol King Chuck Berry Elvis Presley James Brown Joan Baez Joni Mitchell Little Richard Miles Davis Nat King Cole Ray Charles
items.zh: 这些指导原则聚焦于有影响力的现代音乐家，但此名单并非详尽无遗。在与学生分享之前，请先审阅这些表演者任何歌曲的歌词和/或视频演出，确保其符合本校的文化与标准。在介绍个人/乐队及其作品时，要突出这位艺术家的影响力，以及其音乐中哪些例子启发了后来的音乐人。艾瑞莎·弗兰克林（Aretha Franklin）、披头士乐队（The Beatles）、鲍勃·迪伦（Bob Dylan）、卡罗尔·金（Carol King）、查克·贝里（Chuck Berry）、埃尔维斯·普雷斯利（Elvis Presley）、詹姆斯·布朗（James Brown）、琼·贝兹（Joan Baez）、乔尼·米切尔（Joni Mitchell）、小理查德（Little Richard）、迈尔斯·戴维斯（Miles Davis）、纳特·金·科尔（Nat King Cole）、雷·查尔斯（Ray Charles）

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Teachers: In learning the new concepts and procedures, students should use previously acquired mathematics to ensure that the procedures become automatic and habitual. Students should continue to master the use of measuring and drawing instruments, develop their mental arithmetic and their approximating abilities, become more familiar with deductive reasoning, and use calculators and computers in a thoughtful way. While teaching methods may vary, it is worth keeping in mind the psychological principle that the most effective method for learning mathematics emphasizes frequent, varied practice, and encourages multiple approaches to solving varied types of problems.
items.zh: 教师须知：在学习新概念和运算方法时，学生应运用已掌握的数学知识，确保这些方法变得自动化并成为习惯。学生应继续熟练掌握测量和绘图工具的使用，发展心算和估算能力，更加熟悉演绎推理，并审慎地使用计算器和计算机。虽然教学方法可以多样，但值得记住的心理原则是：学习数学最有效的方法强调经常的、多样化的练习，并鼓励采用多种方法解决不同类型的问题。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Know that there are numbers that are not rational, and approximate them by rational numbers.
items.zh: 知道存在非有理数（无理数），并能用有理数近似表示它们。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Know that numbers that are not rational are called irrational.
items.zh: 知道非有理数称为无理数。
details: Understand (informally) that every number has a decimal expansion.
Show that for rational numbers the decimal expansion eventually repeats.
Convert a decimal expansion which repeats eventually into a rational number.

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Use rational approximations of irrational numbers to compare the size of irrational numbers. • Identify approximate location on a number line diagram • Estimate the value of expressions
items.zh: 用有理数近似值比较无理数的大小。• 在数轴上标出无理数的大致位置 • 估算算式的值

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Work with radicals and integer exponents.
items.zh: 学习根式与整数指数。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Know and apply the properties of integer exponents to generate equivalent numerical expressions.
items.zh: 掌握并运用整数指数的性质，构造等价的数值表达式。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Use square root and cube root symbols to represent solutions to equations of the form x2 = p and x3 = p, where p is a positive rational number. • Evaluate square roots of small perfect squares. • Evaluate cube roots of small perfect cubes. • Know that √2 is irrational.
items.zh: 用平方根与立方根符号表示 x² = p 和 x³ = p（p 为正有理数）形式方程的解。• 求较小的完全平方数的平方根 • 求较小的完全立方数的立方根 • 知道 √2 是无理数。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Use numbers expressed in the form of a single digit times an integer power of 10 to estimate very large or very small quantities. • Express how many times as much one is than the other.
items.zh: 用“一位数乘以 10 的整数次幂”的形式表示数，以估算极大或极小的量。• 表示一个量是另一个量的多少倍。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Perform operations with numbers expressed in scientific notation.
items.zh: 对用科学记数法表示的数进行运算。
details: Use scientific notation and choose units of appropriate size for measurements of very large or very small quantities.
Interpret scientific notation that has been generated by technology.

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Understand the connections between proportional relationships, lines, and linear equations.
items.zh: 理解比例关系、直线与线性方程之间的联系。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Graph proportional relationships.
items.zh: 画出比例关系的图像。
details: Interpret the unit rate as the slope of the graph.
Compare two different proportional relationships represented in different ways.

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Use similar triangles to explain why the slope m is the same between any two distinct points on a non-vertical line in the coordinate plane. • Derive the equation y = mx for a line through the origin • Derive the equation y = mx + b for a line intercepting the vertical axis at b.
items.zh: 利用相似三角形解释：在坐标平面中，非竖直直线上任意两个不同点之间的斜率 m 都相同。• 推导过原点的直线方程 y = mx • 推导与纵轴交于 b 的直线方程 y = mx + b

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Analyze and solve linear equations and pairs of simultaneous linear equations.
items.zh: 分析并求解一元一次方程及二元一次方程组（联立线性方程组）。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Solve linear equations in one variable. Include problems where both decimal and scientific notation are used. • Give examples of linear equations in one variable with one solution, infinitely many solutions, or no solutions.
items.zh: 解一元一次方程，包括同时使用小数与科学记数法的问题。 • 举例说明一元一次方程有一个解、无穷多个解或无解的情形。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Show which of these possibilities is the case by successively transforming the given equation into simpler forms. • Solve linear equations with rational number coefficients.
items.zh: 通过逐步将给定方程化为更简单的形式，判断属于哪种情形。• 解系数为有理数的一元一次方程。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Analyze and solve pairs of simultaneous linear equations.
items.zh: 分析并求解二元一次方程组。
details: Understand that solutions to a system of two linear equations in two variables correspond to points of intersection of their graphs.
Solve systems of two linear equations in two variables algebraically.

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Estimate solutions by graphing the equations.
items.zh: 通过画出方程图像估算解。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Solve simple cases by inspection.
items.zh: 用观察法解简单的情形。
details: Solve real-world and mathematical problems leading to two linear equations in two variables.

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Define, evaluate, and compare functions.
items.zh: 定义、求值和比较函数。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Understand that a function is a rule that assigns to each input exactly one output.
items.zh: 理解函数是一种规则：对每个输入都恰好指定一个输出。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Compare properties of two functions each represented in a different way.
items.zh: 比较以不同方式表示的两个函数的性质。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Interpret the equation y = mx + b as defining a linear function (a straight line).
items.zh: 把方程 y = mx + b 理解为定义了一个线性函数（一条直线）。
details: Give examples of functions that are not linear.

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Use functions to model relationships between quantities.
items.zh: 用函数为数量之间的关系建模。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Construct a function to model a linear relationship between two quantities.
items.zh: 构造一个函数，为两个量之间的线性关系建模。
details: Determine the rate of change and initial value of the function from a description of a relationship or from two (x, y) values.
Interpret the rate of change and initial value of a linear function in terms of the situation it models.
Interpret the rate of change and initial value of a linear function in terms of its graph or a table of values.

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Describe qualitatively the functional relationship between two quantities by analyzing a graph. • Sketch a graph that exhibits the qualitative features of a function that has been described verbally.
items.zh: 通过分析图像，定性描述两个量之间的函数关系。• 根据对函数的文字描述，草绘出体现其定性特征的图像。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Understand congruence and similarity using physical models, transparencies, or geometry software.
items.zh: 借助实物模型、透明胶片或几何软件理解全等与相似。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Verify experimentally the properties of rotations, reflections, and translations:
items.zh: 通过实验验证旋转、轴对称（反射）和平移的性质：
details: Lines are taken to lines, and line segments to line segments of the same length.
Angles are taken to angles of the same measure.
Parallel lines are taken to parallel lines.

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Understand that a two-dimensional figure is congruent to another if the second can be obtained from the first by a sequence of rotations, reflections, and translations. • Given two congruent figures, describe a sequence that exhibits the congruence between them.
items.zh: 理解：若一个二维图形可经过一系列旋转、反射和平移由另一个图形得到，则二者全等。• 给定两个全等图形，描述体现其全等关系的一系列变换。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Describe the effect of dilations, translations, rotations, and reflections on two dimensional figures using coordinates.
items.zh: 用坐标描述伸缩（位似）、平移、旋转和反射对二维图形的影响。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Understand that a two-dimensional figure is similar to another if the second can be obtained from the first by a sequence of rotations, reflections, translations, and dilations. • Given two similar two-dimensional figures, describe a sequence that exhibits the similarity between them. Transforming into simpler forms until an equivalent equation of the form x = a, a = a, or a = b results. Including, equations whose solutions require expanding expressions using the distributive property and collecting like terms. Points of intersection satisfy both equations simultaneously. The graph of a function is the set of ordered pairs consisting of an input and the corresponding output. Represented algebraically, graphically, numerically in tables, or by verbal descriptions. Including reading these from a table or from a graph.
items.zh: 理解：若一个二维图形可经过一系列旋转、反射、平移和伸缩由另一个图形得到，则二者相似。• 给定两个相似的二维图形，描述体现其相似关系的一系列变换。将其化为更简单的形式，直到得到形如 x = a、a = a 或 a = b 的等价方程，包括解需要用分配律展开表达式并合并同类项的方程。交点同时满足两个方程。函数的图像是由输入及其对应输出组成的有序对构成的集合。可用代数式、图像、表格中的数值或文字描述来表示，包括从表格或图中读出这些信息。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Use informal arguments to establish facts about the angle sum and exterior angle of triangles.
items.zh: 用非正式的推理说明三角形内角和与外角的相关结论。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Use informal arguments to establish facts about the angles created when parallel lines are cut by a transversal.
items.zh: 用非正式的推理说明平行线被截线所截形成的角的相关结论。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Use informal arguments to establish facts about the angle-angle criterion for similarity of triangles.
items.zh: 用非正式的推理说明三角形相似的“角角（AA）判定准则”。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Understand and apply the Pythagorean theorem.
items.zh: 理解并运用勾股定理（毕达哥拉斯定理）。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Explain a proof of the Pythagorean Theorem and its converse.
items.zh: 解释勾股定理及其逆定理的一个证明。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Apply the Pythagorean Theorem to determine unknown side lengths in right triangles in real-world and mathematical problems in two and three dimensions.
items.zh: 在二维和三维的实际问题与数学问题中，运用勾股定理求直角三角形的未知边长。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Apply the Pythagorean Theorem to find the distance between two points in a coordinate system.
items.zh: 运用勾股定理求坐标系中两点之间的距离。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Solve real-world and mathematical problems involving volume of cylinders, cones and spheres.
items.zh: 解决涉及圆柱、圆锥和球体积的实际问题与数学问题。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Know the formulas for the volumes of cones, cylinders, and spheres and use them to solve real-world and mathematical problems.
items.zh: 掌握圆锥、圆柱和球的体积公式，并用其解决实际问题与数学问题。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Investigate patterns of association in bivariate data.
items.zh: 探究双变量数据中的关联模式。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Construct and interpret scatter plots for bivariate measurement data to investigate patterns of association between two quantities. • Describe patterns such as clustering, outliers, positive or negative association, linear association, and nonlinear association.
items.zh: 为双变量测量数据绘制并解读散点图，以探究两个量之间的关联模式。• 描述诸如聚集、离群值、正相关或负相关、线性关联与非线性关联等模式。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Know that straight lines are widely used to model relationships between two quantitative variables. • For scatter plots that suggest a linear association, informally fit a straight line, and informally assess the model fit by judging the closeness of the data points to the line.
items.zh: 知道直线被广泛用于为两个数量变量之间的关系建模。• 对于显示线性关联的散点图，非正式地拟合一条直线，并通过数据点与直线的接近程度来非正式地评估模型的拟合效果。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Use the equation of a linear model to solve problems in the context of bivariate measurement data, interpreting the slope and intercept.
items.zh: 在双变量测量数据的情境中，运用线性模型的方程解决问题，并解释斜率与截距的含义。

items.subject: Mathematics
items.en: Understand that patterns of association can also be seen in bivariate categorical data by displaying frequencies and relative frequencies in a two-way table. • Construct and interpret a two-way table summarizing data on two categorical variables collected from the same subjects. • Use relative frequencies calculated for rows or columns to describe possible association between the two variables.
items.zh: 理解：通过在双向表中显示频数与相对频数，也可以在双变量分类数据中看到关联模式。• 编制并解读双向表，汇总从同一批对象收集的两个分类变量的数据。• 用按行或按列计算的相对频数描述两个变量之间可能的关联。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Teachers: Effective instruction in science requires not only direct experience and observation but also book learning, which helps bring coherence and order to a student’s scientific knowledge. Only when topics are presented systematically and clearly can students make steady and secure progress in their scientific learning. The Science sequence for the middle school grades aims for more intensive and selective study of topics, a number of which were introduced in earlier grades. The Sequence continues the practice of studying topics from each of the major realms of science (physical, life, and earth science). Students are expected to do experiments and write reports on their findings.
items.zh: 教师须知：有效的科学教学不仅需要直接经验和观察，也需要书本学习，因为书本学习有助于使学生的科学知识连贯而有条理。只有系统、清晰地呈现主题，学生才能在科学学习上稳步而扎实地进步。中学阶段的科学知识序列旨在对主题进行更深入、有所侧重的研习，其中不少主题在更早的年级已经介绍过。该序列延续了从科学的各大领域（物理科学、生命科学和地球科学）研究主题的做法。学生应动手做实验，并撰写关于研究发现的报告。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Measures of motion:
items.zh: 运动的度量：

items.subject: Science
items.en: Speed: distance per unit of time
items.zh: 速度：单位时间内通过的距离

items.subject: Science
items.en: Velocity: distance per unit of time in a particular direction
items.zh: 速度：沿特定方向的单位时间内通过的距离

items.subject: Science
items.en: Changes in velocity can involve changes in speed and/or direction
items.zh: 速度的变化可能涉及速率和/或方向的变化

items.subject: Science
items.en: A force is a push or pull on an object.
items.zh: 力是对物体的推或拉。

items.subject: Science
items.en: A contact force is a push or pull on objects that touch each other.
items.zh: 接触力是相互接触的物体之间的推或拉。

items.subject: Science
items.en: A force has both direction and magnitude.
items.zh: 力既有方向，也有大小。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Newton’s mathematical expression of force; a newton is the measure of force in the metric system, pound-force in the English system.
items.zh: 牛顿对力的数学表达；牛顿（newton）是公制中力的单位，英制中则为磅力（pound-force）。

items.subject: Science
items.en: If an object is at rest or there is no change in its movement, then the forces acting on it are balanced.
items.zh: 如果物体静止或其运动状态没有变化，那么作用在它上面的力是平衡的。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Unbalanced forces result in changes of an object’s velocity.
items.zh: 不平衡的力会导致物体速度发生变化。

items.subject: Science
items.en: The kinetic energy of a moving object is related to its mass.
items.zh: 运动物体的动能与其质量有关。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Newton’s Third Law of Motion can be applied to collisions.
items.zh: 牛顿运动第三定律可应用于碰撞。

items.subject: Science
items.en: The forces acting on object in a collision, and the change the motion of the objects, involves the velocity of each object and its mass.
items.zh: 碰撞中作用在物体上的力以及物体运动的变化，涉及每个物体的速度及其质量。

items.subject: Science
items.en: The use of engineering design processes can help us design ways to minimize damage when objects collide.
items.zh: 运用工程设计流程可以帮助我们设计出在物体碰撞时尽量减少损伤的方法。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Difference between a sound and a sound wave: Sound is the result of sound waves. E.g., a ringing bell causes a sound wave, which a person recognizes as a sound.
items.zh: 声音与声波的区别：声音是声波产生的结果。例如，铃铛响动会产生声波，人将其感知为声音。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Vibrating objects establish sound waves when not in a vacuum.
items.zh: 在非真空环境中，振动的物体会产生声波。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Common vibrating objects: human voice box, siren, bell, parts of a cell phone or television
items.zh: 常见的振动体：人的声带、警笛、铃铛、手机或电视机的部件

items.subject: Science
items.en: Sound waves, when interacting with matter, can be reflected, absorbed, or transmitted.
items.zh: 声波与物质相互作用时，可能被反射、吸收或透射。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Because sound waves transmit energy, they can often interact with matter to cause it to move, such as making our eardrums vibrate.
items.zh: 由于声波传递能量，它们常能与物质相互作用使其运动，例如使我们的鼓膜振动。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Like all forms of energy, a sound wave can be transformed into another energy form— the engineering basis for many practical devices.
items.zh: 与所有形式的能量一样，声波可以转化为另一种能量形式——这是许多实用装置的工程学基础。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Characteristics of a sound wave include:
items.zh: 声波的特性包括：

items.subject: Science
items.en: Speed
items.zh: 声速

items.subject: Science
items.en: Frequency
items.zh: 频率

items.subject: Science
items.en: Amplitude
items.zh: 振幅

items.subject: Science
items.en: A force is a push or pull on an object.
items.zh: 力是对物体的推或拉。

items.subject: Science
items.en: A non-contact force is a push or pull on objects that do not touch each other.
items.zh: 非接触力是彼此不接触的物体之间的推或拉。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Examples: magnetism, electrical forces, gravity
items.zh: 例如：磁力、电力、引力

items.subject: Science
items.en: Non-contact forces involve fields that surround object, magnetic fields, electrical fields, gravitational fields.
items.zh: 非接触力涉及包围物体的场：磁场、电场、引力场。

items.subject: Science
items.en: If an object is at rest or there is no change in its movement then, the forces acting on it are balanced.
items.zh: 如果物体静止或其运动状态没有变化，那么作用在它上面的力是平衡的。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Unbalanced forces result in changes of an object’s velocity.
items.zh: 不平衡的力会导致物体速度发生变化。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Magnets exert a non-contact force on objects made of certain metals.
items.zh: 磁体对由某些金属制成的物体施加非接触力。

items.subject: Science
items.en: A metal object becomes magnetic when all its electrons spin in the same direction.
items.zh: 当金属物体中所有电子沿同一方向自旋时，该物体就带有磁性。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Some objects are naturally magnetic, others can be made by subjecting certain metals to an electrical field.
items.zh: 有些物体天然具有磁性，另一些则可通过将某些金属置于电场中而获得磁性。

items.subject: Science
items.en: All magnets have two poles, north and south.
items.zh: 所有磁体都有两个磁极：南极和北极。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Similar magnetic poles repel; opposite magnetic poles attract.
items.zh: 同名磁极相斥，异名磁极相吸。

items.subject: Science
items.en: The entire Earth is a magnet, and therefore surrounded by a magnetic field.
items.zh: 整个地球是一个磁体，因此周围存在磁场。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Electrical forces are the result of charged particles acting upon one another.
items.zh: 电力是带电粒子之间相互作用的结果。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Electrical and magnetic forces can be described by the activity of the field associated with each force.
items.zh: 电力和磁力可以通过与各自相关的场的活动来描述。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Gravity is a force that acts upon any two objects in the universe.
items.zh: 引力是作用于宇宙中任意两个物体之间的力。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Gravity results because any mass causes the space around it to curve.
items.zh: 引力的产生是因为任何质量都会使其周围的空间发生弯曲。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Newton’s law of universal gravitation
items.zh: 牛顿万有引力定律

items.subject: Science
items.en: Effects of universal gravitation on objects in the universe
items.zh: 万有引力对宇宙中物体的影响

items.subject: Science
items.en: Earth, the moon, and sun form a system.
items.zh: 地球、月球和太阳构成一个系统。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Earth revolves around the sun and the moon revolves around Earth
items.zh: 地球绕太阳公转，月球绕地球公转

items.subject: Science
items.en: Solar and lunar eclipses are the result of Earth, moon, sun system.
items.zh: 日食和月食是地球—月球—太阳系统运行的结果。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Day, night, and seasons are the result of the earth in relationship to the sun.
items.zh: 昼夜和四季是地球与太阳相对关系的结果。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Tides are the result of the interaction of Earth and moon.
items.zh: 潮汐是地球与月球相互作用的结果。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Solar system: at least one star and its orbiting objects
items.zh: 太阳系：至少一颗恒星及其绕行天体

items.subject: Science
items.en: Objects in a solar system include planets, moons, asteroids, and comets.
items.zh: 太阳系中的天体包括行星、卫星、小行星和彗星。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Origins of solar systems
items.zh: 太阳系的起源

items.subject: Science
items.en: Eclipses, lunar phases, and seasons: results of the cyclic patterns of movement of the sun, planets, and moons C. Stars and Galaxies
items.zh: 日食、月相和四季：太阳、行星与卫星周期性运动模式的结果。 C. 恒星与星系

items.subject: Science
items.en: The sun is a star.
items.zh: 太阳是一颗恒星。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Red giants and white dwarfs
items.zh: 红巨星与白矮星

items.subject: Science
items.en: Life cycle of the stars, including novae, supernovae, black holes, and quasars
items.zh: 恒星的生命周期，包括新星、超新星、黑洞和类星体

items.subject: Science
items.en: The apparent movement of stars is a result of the rotation of Earth.
items.zh: 恒星的视运动是地球自转的结果。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Constellations such as the Big Dipper and Orion, are visual groupings of stars into imagined images.
items.zh: 星座（如北斗七星和猎户座）是人们将恒星在视觉上组合成想象中的图像。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Definition of light year
items.zh: 光年的定义

items.subject: Science
items.en: Galaxy: enormous number of stars held together by gravitation
items.zh: 星系：由引力维系在一起的巨大恒星集合

items.subject: Science
items.en: About 125 billion galaxies in the universe
items.zh: 宇宙中约有 1250 亿个星系

items.subject: Science
items.en: Our knowledge of stars, solar systems, galaxies, and the universe is the result of observations and data collected by earth-based instruments, space-based instruments, and spacecraft.
items.zh: 我们对恒星、太阳系、星系和宇宙的认识，来自地面仪器、太空仪器和航天器收集到的观测与数据。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Gregor Mendel’s experiments with purebred and hybrid peas and subsequent discoveries about inherited traits
items.zh: 格雷戈尔·孟德尔（Gregor Mendel）关于纯种与杂交豌豆的实验，以及后来关于遗传性状的发现

items.subject: Science
items.en: Role of genes (segments of DNA on a chromosome) in inherited traits
items.zh: 基因（染色体上的 DNA 片段）在遗传性状中的作用

items.subject: Science
items.en: Traits of an offspring are the result of half of an offspring’s genes coming from the mother, and half coming from the father.
items.zh: 子代的性状源于其基因一半来自母亲、一半来自父亲。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Alleles, dominant and recessive
items.zh: 等位基因：显性与隐性

items.subject: Science
items.en: An offspring
items.zh: 子代

items.subject: Science
items.en: Role, structure, and organization of DNA
items.zh: DNA 的作用、结构与组织方式

items.subject: Science
items.en: DNA is the template for RNA, which in turn directs the development of proteins
items.zh: DNA 是 RNA 的模板，而 RNA 进而指导蛋白质的形成

items.subject: Science
items.en: A mutation is a structural change to a gene.
items.zh: 突变是基因结构上的改变。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Mutations can be harmful, neutral, or beneficial.
items.zh: 突变可能是有害的、中性的或有益的。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Mutations change the structure of DNA, which in turn can affect RNA and thus the formation of proteins.
items.zh: 突变改变 DNA 的结构，进而可能影响 RNA，从而影响蛋白质的形成。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Sexual reproduction results in offspring with a mixture of genes from each parent.
items.zh: 有性生殖产生的子代带有来自双亲的混合基因。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Sexual reproduction results in new combination of genes and thus results in variation of traits in offspring.
items.zh: 有性生殖产生新的基因组合，因而使子代出现性状变异。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Asexual reproduction is not the result of the combination of genes and thus does not result in genetic variation between parent and offspring.
items.zh: 无性生殖不是基因组合的结果，因此不会造成亲代与子代之间的遗传变异。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Definition of natural selection
items.zh: 自然选择的定义

items.subject: Science
items.en: Definition of population, and a knowledge of variation of traits among individuals
items.zh: 种群的定义，以及个体之间性状变异的知识

items.subject: Science
items.en: Percentages of genes and alleles in a population
items.zh: 种群中基因与等位基因所占的百分比

items.subject: Science
items.en: Abiotic and biotic changes in the environment and their favorable or unfavorable effects on individuals with certain traits
items.zh: 环境中的非生物与生物变化，以及它们对具有某些性状的个体的有利或不利影响

items.subject: Science
items.en: Survival and greater reproduction of individuals with favorable traits, or adaptations
items.zh: 具有有利性状（即适应）的个体得以存活并更多地繁殖

items.subject: Science
items.en: Others will not reproduce as effectively or will die; pass on their genes at a lower rate changing the genetic structure of a population over time.
items.zh: 其他个体则繁殖效率较低或死亡；它们传递基因的比例较低，从而随时间推移改变种群的遗传结构。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Many lines of evidence indicate all living things have a common ancestry.
items.zh: 多条证据表明所有生物都有共同祖先。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Fossil evidence, rock strata and chemical dating process show that the processes of evolution: from origin to extinction, were the same in the past as they are now.
items.zh: 化石证据、岩层与化学测年过程表明，进化过程（从起源到灭绝）在过去与现在是一样的。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Comparison of structural similarities and differences between fossils and between fossils and living organisms is one basis for the common ancestry of all living things.
items.zh: 比较化石之间以及化石与生物之间的结构异同，是支持所有生物具有共同祖先的依据之一。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Comparison of the DNA of differing organisms and other cellular chemical analyses indicate concept that all living things have a common ancestry.
items.zh: 比较不同生物的 DNA 及其他细胞化学分析表明，所有生物具有共同祖先。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Definition, theory, and process of evolution
items.zh: 进化的定义、理论与过程

items.subject: Science
items.en: Study of the process of evolution includes the comparing genetic makeup and biochemistries of large numbers of different organisms, comparing the anatomy of organisms living and past, and comparative embryology.
items.zh: 对进化过程的研究包括：比较大量不同生物的基因组成与生物化学特征，比较现生与远古生物的解剖结构，以及比较胚胎学。

items.subject: Science
items.en: The history of the study of how organisms are related goes back to the beginning of scientific thought.
items.zh: 研究生物之间亲缘关系的历史可追溯到科学思想的开端。

items.subject: Science
items.en: Charles Darwin, and his On the Origin of Species by Means of Natural Selection, or the Preservation of Favoured Races in the Struggle for Life (1859) and historical and scientific importance
items.zh: 查尔斯·达尔文（Charles Darwin）及其《物种起源：通过自然选择，或在生存斗争中保存有利种族》（On the Origin of Species by Means of Natural Selection, or the Preservation of Favoured Races in the Struggle for Life，1859），以及其历史与科学意义

items.subject: Science
items.en: Albert Einstein — advancements in the study of space, matter, energy, time, and gravity
items.zh: 阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦（Albert Einstein）——在空间、物质、能量、时间和引力研究方面的进展

items.subject: Science
items.en: Dorothy Hodgkin — structure of vitamin B12
items.zh: 多萝西·霍奇金（Dorothy Hodgkin）——维生素 B12 的结构

items.subject: Science
items.en: James Maxwell —the basic laws of electromagnetism
items.zh: 詹姆斯·麦克斯韦（James Maxwell）——电磁学的基本定律

items.subject: Science
items.en: Charles Steinmetz —the theory of electric power appendices
items.zh: 查尔斯·斯坦梅茨（Charles Steinmetz）——电力理论（附录）
